title: Senior Specialist, Talent Acquisition (Corporate)
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is one of the most exciting and valuable fintechs in the world. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Homebase, Henkel, Binance and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

description:

 Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer 
  Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial  
 Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. 
  This is not a conventional graphic-design role.  We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. 
 You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. 
 The work 
 You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. 
 Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. 
 
 Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. 
 Decide what each batch should test and why. 
 Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. 
 Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. 
 Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. 
 Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. 
 Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. 
 Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. 
 Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. 
 Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. 
 Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. 
 
 What you must be good at 
 
 Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy 
 Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation 
 Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit 
 Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page 
 Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production 
 Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation 
 Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools 
 Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish 
 Fast, organised batch production 
 Reading creative performance and choosing the next test

description:
Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive QA Engineer to own product quality across our AI robotics platform. In this role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and driving the overall testing strategy, building quality into every stage of our development lifecycle, and ensuring our robotic systems meet the highest standards before reaching customers. You will work across hardware and software boundaries, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and support teams in a fast-paced startup environment.

Your Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Quality Gates

  • Conceptualize, develop, and manage the overall testing strategy and quality gates for the product.

  • Define and enforce release criteria, ensuring that only thoroughly validated builds reach production.

  • Establish and maintain quality metrics and dashboards to provide visibility into product health.

QA Ownership

  • Own QA processes across both hardware and software, ensuring quality is built into the development lifecycle from the start.

  • Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test automation for new features and existing functionality.

title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

This is not a traditional accounting role focused on maintaining legacy systems.

At Volta, you will help build the finance function from first principles, contributing to the design of processes, controls, and reporting in a business deploying capital at global scale.

Working closely with the Senior Financial Accountant and the wider Financial Accounting and Transactional Function, you will play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting while supporting the build-out of a scalable, best-in-class accounting environment across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the execution of the monthly financial close

  • Prepare and post accrual, prepayment, payroll, capex, revenue, and FX entries, among others

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations for review

    • Cash, AR, AP, fixed assets, other payables and receivables, equity

title: Data Scientist - Audiobooks Analytics
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. You will work with the Audiobooks Analytics Lead to help shape our global audiobooks strategy and improve the experience for listeners, creators, publishers, and authors.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to evaluate some of the most important opportunities facing our audiobooks business. Your work will span content and catalog strategy, discovery and recommendations, subscriber growth, and new product and commercial initiatives. You will turn complex questions into clear recommendations and help senior leaders make confident decisions.

You will collaborate with a distributed team of analysts, data scientists, business leaders, product managers, editorial partners, and engineers. At Spotify, you will have access to rich datasets and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will help shape how the world listens to and discovers audiobooks.


What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies for audiobook catalog, content discovery, listener engagement, and subscriber growth.
  • Evaluate new product, content, licensing, and commercial opportunities through forecasting, scenario modeling, and impact measurement.
  • Partner with Editorial, Personalization, Product, Finance, and Business teams to improve title selection, recommendation quality, and the listener experience.
  • Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments, to measure the impact of product and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Monitor the health of the audiobooks business, identify emerging opportunities or risks, and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Develop reliable analytical datasets, tools, and reporting that make important insights accessible and repeatable.<

title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud
description:
About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys

description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

Privacy and compliance are central to how we build and maintain user trust, particularly for a global user base with a significant presence in Europe. As MZLA expands its products and services, this role will help ensure that data is collected, used, shared, retained, and governed responsibly, in line with Thunderbird’s values and user trust commitments. MZLA is a small, growing organization, and the right person will be a hands-on program manager who can create structure without overcomplicating the work. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

title: Engineering Manager - UK
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-dat

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

RevenueCat prices based on how much money a customer makes. That creates an unusually clear alignment of incentives: when our customers grow, we grow.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

And often, it means doing the unglamorous but critical work of keeping everyone aligned on context, priorities, next steps, owners, and follow-through.

That’s this role.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of managed RevenueCat customers and help them get more value from RevenueCat. You’ll become the person who understands where each customer is trying to go, what is getting in their way, how RevenueCat can plausibly help, and what needs to happen next.

You are not expected to be the best technical expert, paywall expert, lifecycle expert, paid acquisition expert, or pricing expert in the company.

You are expected to be a strong growth generalist: curious, commercially aware, product-fluent, organized, and credible enough to diagnose the right problem, bring in the right person, and own the follow-through.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat has grown quickly, and our customer base now spans everything from tiny indie apps to some of the largest mobile businesses in the world.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

title: Teammanager klantenservice
description: Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen.  Samen met een betrokken team lever je dagelijks een zichtbare bijdrage aan de excellente dienstverlening voor miljoenen klanten van de RDW.  Het aanspreekpunt zijn voor je team op de werkvloer en medewerkers bijstaan in hun ontwikkeling, maar ook samen resultaten behalen en die verantwoorden. Je coacht, motiveert en stimuleert jouw medewerkers om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Dat is het uitdagende speelveld waarin jij je als teammanager binnen de frontoffice bij de divisie Registratie en Informatie (R&I) in Veendam bevindt.   Interessant aan deze baan volgens teammanager klantenservice Paulien   Als teammanager binnen het KCC ben je de spin in het web. Je houdt je enerzijds bezig met de ontwikkeling van je medewerkers en anderzijds ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor alle ontwikkelingen op de unit. Dit alles om een optimale dienstverlening te creëren voor onze klanten. Kortom: een enorm dynamische en afwisselende functie!  Lees de verhalen van andere RDW’ers >   Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen   Binnen Divisie Registratie & Informatie, afdeling Frontoffice, is de unit KCC (Klant Contact Center) op zoek naar een gedreven Teammanager. Bij vragen over de registratie en informatie in en uit het kentekenregister is de unit Klant Contact Center het eerste aanspreekpunt. Dat kunnen heel uiteenlopende vragen zijn op het werkterrein van de RDW. Een team van 40 interne RDW collega's en 75 externe collega's staan garant voor een juiste en efficiënte beantwoording van vragen. Die komen per telefoon, brief, email, chat en aan de balie binnen. Met duizenden verzoeken om informatie per week is het de RDW er veel aan gelegen om de dienstverlening permanent te verbeteren. Op de locatie in Veendam werkt het interne KCC samen met een externe partner.  Als Teammanager draag je de verantwoordelijkheid om ervoor te zorgen dat jouw team optimaal is toegerust om het werk succesvol uit te voeren. Samen met een collega-teammanager geef je leiding aan een team van circa 40 medewerkers, waarbij je rechtstreeks verantwoordelijk bent voor de aansturing van ongeveer 20 collega's. Je zorgt ervoor dat de doelstellingen van het KCC worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken kaders van tijd, kwaliteit en budget.  Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het coachen, begeleiden en motiveren van je teamleden, zodat zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen en optimaal kunnen presteren. De resultaten van jouw team maak je inzichtelijk via managementrapportages. Door deze informatie te combineren met een continue monitoring en analyse van prestaties, krijg je scherp inzicht in kansen om productiviteit, efficiëntie, kwaliteit en effectiviteit verder te verbeteren.  Om goed aangesloten te blijven bij zowel bestaande als nieuwe projecten binnen de RDW, onderhoud je actief een breed netwerk van contacten binnen de organisatie en werk je nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders. title: Customer Service Manager - Galway
description: About EZ Living Furniture    EZ Living Furniture is one of Ireland's leading furniture retailers, dedicated to helping customers create beautiful homes through quality furniture, exceptional service, and a seamless shopping experience. We are the largest independent Furniture Retailer in Ireland employing over 370 people.     We are committed to delivering outstanding customer satisfaction at every stage of the customer journey, from purchase through to delivery and aftercare.    Role Overview    We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused   Customer Service Manager  to lead our Customer Service team and drive excellence across all customer interactions. This role will be responsible for managing a team of Customer Service Representatives while also providing data-driven insights and analytics on customer issues, complaints, and service failures that impact the wider business.  The successful candidate will play a key role in improving customer satisfaction, identifying root causes of recurring issues, and partnering with departments including Retail Stores, Distribution, Logistics, E-commerce, Buying, and Operations to implement continuous improvement initiatives.   Key Responsibilities     Lead, coach, motivate, and develop a team of Customer Service Representatives.   Oversee the resolution of customer queries, complaints, and escalations.   Monitor compliance with company policies and consumer regulations.   Act as an escalation point for complex customer issues.   Analyse customer contacts, complaints, returns, delivery issues, and service failures.   Identify key trends, root causes, and recurring issues impacting customers.   Produce regular management reports and KPI dashboards.   Present findings and recommendations to senior management.   Use customer feedback and operational data to influence business decisions.   Partner with internal stakeholders to reduce customer pain points.   Drive corrective actions arising from customer feedback and trend analysis.   Support process improvement initiatives across customer service and operational functions.   Monitor service performance and customer satisfaction metrics.   Drive initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience.      Skills And Experience     Minimum 3-5 years' experience in a Customer Service leadership role.   Proven experience managing and developing customer service teams.   Strong analytical and reporting skills with experience interpreting customer data.   Experience producing management reports and presenting findings.   Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.   Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.   Customer-focused mindset with a passion for service excellence.   Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.   Experience using CRM and customer service management platforms.      WHY JOIN US: Look us up on Glassdoor- rated 4.6/5     Benefits     Up to 23 days holiday per year  Fun, fast paced & high energy work environ

title: Team Lead til Fastholdelse i OK
description: Kan du lede et team med ét klart mål: at fastholde flere kunder? Som Team Lead for Fastholdelse får du ansvaret for at udvikle medarbejderne, løfte performance og skabe stærke kundeoplevelser.    Om rollen og afdelingen   I OK er vi i gang med at etablere et nyt Fastholdelsesteam, som skal rådgive privatkunder, der overvejer deres muligheder, og hjælpe dem med at finde den rette løsning.  Som Team Lead får du det operationelle ansvar for teamet og bliver en synlig og nærværende leder, der er tæt på både medarbejdere og den daglige drift. Du udvikler teamet, følger performance og bruger data, KPI’er og kundeindsigter til at skabe stærke resultater.  Teamets indsigter skal samtidig bidrage til at styrke kundeoplevelsen og OK’s samlede fastholdelsesindsats. Du bliver en del af ledergruppen i Salg og Kundeservice Privat og refererer til afdelingens Manager. Samtidig bliver du en del af et tæt og engageret samarbejde med de øvrige Team Leads, hvor I sammen sikrer retning, sparring og fælles fokus på tværs af området.   Dine opgaver      Lede, coache og udvikle medarbejderne gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.  Skabe en stærk performancekultur med tydelige mål og løbende feedback.  Følge op på KPI’er, kvalitet og fastholdelsesresultater.  Sikre gode og værdiskabende kundedialoger.  Bruge data og kundeindsigter til at identificere forbedringsmuligheder.  Planlægge bemandingen i samarbejde med Workforce Management.  Bidrage til udviklingen af OK’s churn- og fastholdelsesindsats.  Rekruttere og onboarde nye medarbejdere efter behov.      Om dig   Du har minimum to års erfaring med at lede et Fastholdelsesteam og kan dokumentere stærke resultater inden for fastholdelse og performance.  Som leder er du tydelig, nærværende og god til at skabe følgeskab. Du sætter retning, følger op og udvikler dine medarbejdere med blik for både resultater og trivsel.  Du arbejder struktureret og datadrevet og bruger KPI’er og kundeindsigter aktivt til at prioritere og forbedre teamets performance.   Det praktiske   Kundecentret har åbent alle ugens dage. Din primære arbejdstid vil typisk være fem hverdage kl. 08.00-16.00, men du skal regne med at være på kontoret kl. 12.00-20.00 én til to gange om måneden. Weekendarbejde kan forekomme i takt med, at funktionen udvikles.  Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt og senest den 30. august 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.  Tiltrædelse er snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat frem for at fremskynde opstarten.  Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutterende leder Marianne Jensen på tlf. 40 14 22 86-  Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö Gigantti Tammistoon
description: Gigantti syntyi halusta tarjota asiakkaille huippuluokan teknologiaa järkevään hintaan. Menestyksemme salaisuus on aina ollut osaava asiakaspalvelu, laadukkaat tuotteet ja kunnianhimo. Meillä on aidosti hauskaa töissä, ja se näkyy! Olemme uteliaita ja kiinnostuneita sekä tuotteistamme että asiakkaidemme tarpeista. Arvomme ohjaavat kaikkea mitä teemme: voitamme yhdessä, pelaamme yhdessä, kasvamme yhdessä ja olemme erilaisia yhdessä. Tervetuloa hakemaan Giganttiin! Haluatko johtaa asiakaskokemusta Suomen suurimmassa Gigantissa? Etsimme nyt kehityshaluista asiakaskokemuspäällikköä (Customer Experience Manager) Vantaan Tammiston myymälään johtamaan asiakaskokemusta, kehittämään palvelukulttuuria ja valmentamaan tiimiä kohti yhteistä tavoitetta: tarjota asiakkaillemme alan paras asiakaskokemus joka päivä. 💙💚   Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä asiakkaan matka Gigantissa tuntuu aina ensimmäisestä kohtaamisesta viimeiseen palvelutilanteeseen. Johdat laajaa ja monipuolista tiimiä ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tavaratalopäällikön ja muiden osastopäälliköiden kanssa. Johdat toimintaa tavoitteellisesti, kehität tiimisi osaamista ja viet käytäntöön Gigantin asiakas ensin -strategiaa. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen johtoryhmän sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittää uraasi Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti osana Elkjøp-konsernia.    Mitä Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö tekee?    Vastaat myymälän asiakaskokemuksen kannalta keskeisten toimintojen johtamisesta ja vastuualueesi tuloksesta sekä henkilöstöstä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, kassatoiminnot, maksuliikenne, palvelupisteen toiminta, tekninen tuki sekä asiakkaan sujuvan asioinnin varmistaminen kaikissa kohtaamispisteissä.   Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:    Asiakaskokemuksen johtaminen      Johdat ja kehität asiakaskokemusta Gigantin strategian mukaan.   Kehität palvelua ja toimintatapoja yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.   Varmistat, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvaa, asiantuntevaa ja ystävällistä palvelua.      Liiketoiminnan johtaminen      Vastaat oman vastuualueesi tuloksista ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta.   Huolehdit myymälän sujuvasta arjesta ja toimivista prosesseista.   Kehität toimintaa aktiivisesti osana myymälän johtoryhmää.      Ihmisten johtaminen      Valmennat, koulutat ja kehität tiimiäsi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita.   Luot ympäristön, jossa ihmiset viihtyvät, kehittyvät ja uskaltavat onnistua.   Johdat esimerkilläsi, olet aktiivisesti läsnä arjessa ja saat ympärilläsi olevat loistamaan.      Odotamme sinulta      Vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ja soveltuvaa koulutusta.   Näyttöjä tavoitteellisesta ihmisten johtamisesta, luottamuksen luomisesta ja vastuun jakamisesta.   Kokemusta vähittäiskaupasta, palveluliiketoiminnasta tai muusta asiakaslähtöisestä ympäristöstä.   Sujuvia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja suomeksi ja käytännön englannin kielen taitoa.   Sosiaalista tilannetajua sekä kykyä keskittyä ja kuunnella myös kiireisissä

title: Teamleitung Customer Service B2B (m/w/d)
description: Unsere Mission lautet protecting people. Mit innovativen Produkten schützt die uvex group seit 100 Jahren Menschen in Beruf, Sport und Freizeit. Weltweit. Dabei hat sich uvex safety als Markensystemanbieter mit internationaler Herstellerkompetenz in zahlreichen Branchen einen Namen gemacht.  Um zu den Besten zu gehören, gibt unser Team alles! Und in Zukunft wollen wir sie auch ein bisschen „grüner“ machen.  Für unsere Gesellschaft  UVEX SAFETY AUSTRIA GMBH  suchen wir genau SIE! Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team sorgen Sie für eine verlässliche Betreuung rund um unser Arbeitsschutzportfolio und tragen dazu bei, Menschen von Kopf bis Fuß bestmöglich zu schützen.   Mit Ihrem hohen Anspruch an Kundenorientierung gewährleisten Sie eine erstklassige Servicequalität über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg und schaffen langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen. Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Kenntnisse in SAP und CRM auf Key User-Niveau sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung.   Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, eine professionelle und pragmatische Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an operativen Themen zeichnen Sie aus. Kundenorientierung ist für Sie gelebter Bestandteil Ihres Arbeitsalltags.

title: Technical Customer Support Manager L1
description: Role purpose  The Support Center Manager is responsible for the day-to-day performance and management of a team of support agents, ensuring high-quality, timely and efficient handling of customer requests. The role combines people leadership, operational control & metrics continuous monitoring, and continuous improvement to deliver excellent customer experience while meeting SLOs, SLAs and productivity targets.  Key responsibilities     Team leadership & people management-Lead, motivate and organize a team of support agents, Support recruitment & onboarding  Coach & develop team members (objective definitions, feedback, development, training needs & plans   Operational supervision  Monitor real-time activity across all channels (phone, email, chat, portal) and adjust resources accordingly.   Ensure cases/tickets are properly triaged, routed, and prioritized according to defined rules.   Act as the first point of operational escalation for complex or sensitive customer issues.   Coordinate with Level 2 and Level 3 support and other internal teams to resolve escalated cases.   Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures, scripts, and knowledge base.    Customer experience & quality  Supervise the quality of customer interactions through regular call and ticket monitoring. Som Relationship Manager blir du en central del i att ge våra företagskunder strategiska råd och skräddarsydda finansiella lösningar som driver deras affärer framåt.  Collaboration. Ownership. Relationskompetens – Naturlig fallenhet för att bygga starka relationer med kunder och kollegor.  Drivkraft – Motivation att ta stort ansvar, inklusive strukturerad nykundsbearbetning och kalla samtal.  Utvecklingsfokus – Ambition att kontinuerligt utveckla din kompetens som finansiell partner.  Självständighet – Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i högt tempo inom ramen för våra riktlinjer och guidelines.  Teamanda – Vilja att dela kunskap, ge feedback och bidra till teamets utveckling.      Din bakgrund och kompetens innefattar:     Swedsec-licens.  Akademisk examen eller motsvarande erfarenhet.  Professionella kunskaper i svenska och engelska (i både tal och skrift).  Erfarenhet att jobba med företagskunder.      Vad vi erbjuder    Människor  kommer hit när de vill komma någonstans. För somliga är det att ta sin karriär till nästa nivå. title: Client Leader – Corporate Segment
description: At Aon, we help organisations make better decisions. As a Client Leader within our Corporate segment, you will play a central role in developing relationships with established corporate clients and creating new business opportunities across the Swedish market.  This is an opportunity for someone who combines commercial drive, curiosity and a genuine interest in building long-term client relationships. You enjoy taking initiative, bringing people together and turning an understanding of a client’s business into relevant advice and practical solutions.   The Role   As a Client Leader, you will own and develop a portfolio of corporate clients and prospects. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers, building a strong understanding of their business, priorities and risk landscape.  The role combines client leadership, business development and team coordination. You will drive client retention and growth, identify new business opportunities, and bring together the right expertise from across Aon to deliver value to clients.   Key Responsibilities   You will build and strengthen long-term relationships with clients and prospects while identifying opportunities for growth and value creation. You will be responsible for developing your portfolio through a combination of account development, prospecting and new business generation.  Working closely with colleagues across Aon, you will coordinate client teams, ensure effective execution of client plans and deliver a seamless client experience. You will also maintain an active pipeline, drive structured follow-up and contribute to the profitability and continued growth of the Corporate segment.   Who We Are Looking For   We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, relationship-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility. Your mindset, initiative and ability to create progress are as important as the number of years you have worked.   Experience     Proven experience, preferably from insurance and risk management, alternatively from consulting, sales, finance, or another client-facing corporate environment.  Experience of developing professional client relationships and driving initiatives forward.  An understanding of corporate clients and an interest in their business challenges, risks and opportunities.  Experience of coordinating stakeholders, projects or client teams is an advantage.  Experience of new business development, account development or complex B2B sales is beneficial.     Profile     Proactive and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in clients and business development.  Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships over time.  Curious and quick to understand different businesses and industries.  Structured and comfortable managing several parallel priorities.  Able to take ownership, create momentum and follow activities through to completion.  Collaborative and confident in involving colleagues with different areas of expertise.

title: Lead Account Manager- Clinical Services
description: Work Schedule   Standard (Mon-Fri)   Environmental Conditions   Office  As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.   What will you be doing?   Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Lead Account Manager and contribute to growth through consultative sales of our clinical research and laboratory services. You'll collaborate with decision-makers at pharmaceutical and biotech companies to position PPD as their preferred provider while contributing to global health. Through professional relationship building and strategic account management, you'll help advance the delivery of life-changing therapies to patients worldwide. We offer a dynamic environment where you can apply our comprehensive portfolio of services spanning clinical trials, laboratory testing, and real-world evidence solutions.   What will you need?      Masters Degree preferred plus sales experience in pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with demonstrated success in meeting/exceeding targets   Preferred Fields of Study: life sciences, business, or related field   Additional relevant certifications beneficial   Valid driver's license and ability to travel 50-75% of the time.   Strong scientific and technical knowledge of drug development, clinical trials, and laboratory services.   Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain executive-level relationships with key decision makers.   Excellence in consultative selling, proposal development, and contract negotiations.   Strong presentation and communication skills for engaging diverse stakeholders.   Fluent English required; additional language skills valuable     What's in it for you?     Excellent salary plus performance bonus.  Fully remote working opportunity.  Company car, laptop, mobile phone.  25 days holiday plus bank holidays.  Life assurance, employee assistance programme and many other benefits.  Progression and development opportunities with a market-leading, forward-thinking organisation.

description: Aurora Live Industrial Network   Are you ready to engage with top decision-makers, build long-term executive relationships, and help shape a completely new business area within Aurora Live? This might be your next career step.   Be Part of Building a New Business Unit   We are launching a new business unit:  Aurora Live Industrial , an exciting internal start-up project within our organisation.  We’re looking for a  Network Growth & Key Client Manager  to join our international team and play a key role from the very beginning.  In this role, you will help build and grow our executive network within the manufacturing sector — identifying and engaging C-level leaders and introducing them to the value of the Aurora Live Industrial community. You will also nurture key relationships and support our long-term client engagement strategy. À l’aise sur le terrain et avec les clients, vous aimez comprendre leurs problématiques et apporter des solutions concrètes. title: Sales Manager, talotekniikka ja LVI-ratkaisut
description: Haemme aktiivista ja yhteistyökykyistä myynnin ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ammattilaista taloteknisten ja LVI -ratkaisujen pariin!    Mitä toimenkuvaasi kuuluu?    Vastuullasi on rakennushankkeiden toimijoiden – erityisesti rakennusliikkeiden sekä muiden sidosryhmien – laaja-alainen kontaktointi ja yhteistyön kehittäminen. Johdat asiakkuuksiin liittyviä toimenpiteitä liiketoimintayksikkötasolla ja edistät ratkaisujemme tunnettuutta markkinoilla.  Työhösi kuuluu myös tarjottavien palveluiden ja asiakasratkaisujen jatkuva kehittäminen sekä aktiivinen yhteistyö myynnin, markkinoinnin, suunnittelun ja tuotehallinnan kanssa. Roolissasi pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten asiakkaamme näkevät ja kokevat tarjoamamme ratkaisut – olet siis keskeinen linkki asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja yrityksemme tarjonnan välillä.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?      Ymmärrät LVI-järjestelmien toimintaperiaatteita sekä osaat huomioida rakentamisen vaatimukset – esimerkiksi energiatehokkuuden, hiilijalanjäljen ja älykkäät talotekniset ratkaisut – ja reagoida niihin asiakastyössä.  Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva insinöörikoulutus ja näyttöä myynnin, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen tai asiakkuuksien hallinnan parista – erityisesti B2B-ympäristössä.  Ymmärrät rakennusalan toimintaympäristöä ja liiketoimintaprosessien eri vaiheita.  Hallitset nykyaikaiset myynnin ja asiakkuudenhallinnan järjestelmät ja näet digitalisaation mahdollisuutena työn tehostamisessa.     Lisäksi     Olet oma-aloitteinen ja pitkäjänteinen tekijä, joka viihtyy asiakkaiden parissa ja osaa edistää yhteistyötä tavoitteellisesti.  Olet tulostavoitteellinen, tartut rohkeasti toimeen ja viet asiat käytännössä maaliin.  Kykenet itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, mutta arvostat myös tiimityötä ja yhteisiä tavoitteita.  Sinulla on matkustusvalmiutta ja hyvä suomen sekä englannin kielen taito.    Eduksi katsotaan kokemus rakennuttaja- ja LVI-suunnittelijayhteistyöstä sekä kyky esiintyä vakuuttavasti erilaisissa asiakastilanteissa.   Mitä tarjoamme sinulle   Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän osana asiantuntevaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä. Pääset työskentelemään markkinoiden johtavien ratkaisujen parissa ja vaikuttamaan aidosti siihen, miten rakennusalan tulevaisuutta kehitetään. Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työvälineet, hyvät kehittymismahdollisuudet ja organisaation tuen tehtävässäsi menestymiseen.   Tehtävän toimipaikka on Helsingissä.   Lisätietoja  tehtävästä antaa myyntijohtaja Mika Tarvainen p. 050 540 9841 tai mika.tarvainen@georgfischer.com.   Hakuaika on 30.09.2026 asti, mutta paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.  Huomioithan että käsittelemme vain järjestelmäämme tulleet hakemukset.   Contact Person   Enna Cano Bernal Senior Specialist, HR enna.canobernal@georgfischer.com  Please submit your application via the ‘Apply’ button. The recruiter’s email is for enquiries only.

title: High End VIP Manager
description: MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE   （ジョブサマリー）   ハイエンドビジネスチームの一員としてVIP顧客との関係性強化、ブランドロイヤリティ向上によりハイエンドビジネスの持続的成長に貢献する。チーム戦略に連動したVIPリレーション施策の実行、ハイエンドビジネスを担っていく人材育成・開発を推進する。またカルティエアンバサダーとしてビジネスパートナー、各界著名人とCartierを繋ぎ、Cartier Japanのネットワーク拡大に寄与する。   Scope Of Responsibilities （役割責務）   ビジネスへの貢献範囲    VIPリレーションズシニアマネージャーと連携し、日本のVIP顧客戦略の立案・実行に貢献する。  海外VIPツアーまたは国内開催ディナーはリーダーとしてEvent Sales Promotionチーム(略称ESP)と連携し、ブランドの世界観、高品質で特別な体験の継続的な提供によりエンゲージメントを深める。  ハイエンドビジネスディベロップメントシニアマネージャーと連携をし、チーム管轄のVIP顧客向けA&Pの最大化を図る。    売上・組織規模    ハイエンドセールス, ハイエンド/VIP顧客基盤強化, ハイエンドコミュニティーを中心にコーチングにより人材育成に貢献する。    その他期待される成果    ブティックマネジメント、L&Dチームなどとも連携しコーチングによりハイエンドビジネスにとって重要となるブティックメンバーの顧客関係構築スキルの向上を図る。ビジネスパートナー・各界著名人とのネットワーク強化拡大。      KEY RESPOINSIBILITIES   （職務内容）   BUSINESS PERFORMANCES  【戦略的影響範囲】    既存VIP顧客のリテンション、アップグレード、リクルーティング強化のためにプロセス策定や最適化、エクスペリエンスの機会提供により顧客体験の向上・顧客との関係性強化をVIPリレーションズシニアマネージャー、ハイエンドコマーシャルシニアマネージャーと共にリーディングする。  VIP顧客情報の見える化とポテンシャルを加味したセールス実績に応じた適正な投資プランの計画・実行・効果検証まで一貫してブティックをサポートする。  中長期的な視点に立ち顧客関係構築力を高めることでハイエンドビジネスの持続的成長につなげる。    【アカウンタビリティと成果物】    ハイエンドセールス目標達成に貢献する。VIPツアーは顧客選定からプランニング、現地サポートまで一貫して実行する。  VIPプロジェクトデータベース、セグメントアップ策の実施により、VVIP・VIP顧客数を拡大させる。  インターメディアリーなど、社外のネットワークとのパイプを構築し、新規顧客の発掘、開拓を行う。    【意思決定】    VIP顧客関連における様々な施策の立案実行及び優先順位付けにおいてROIの観点を持ち意思決定をする。  VIP顧客用予算の費用対効果の最大化を目指す。  プロジェクトや業務の上で課題・障害が発生したときは問題を最小限に抑えタイムリーに解決する。複雑な問題に対処し、上長の指示を仰ぎながら意思決定を行う。    ORGANIZATION & PEOPLE  【組織開発】    ブティックとハイエンドチームの関係強化を促進し、VIP顧客のライフスタイルやマインドセットに対する理解をより深める。  コーチングを通じてインターナショナル及びローカルのハイエンドコミュニティメンバーを中心としたハイエンド人材の発掘・育成プロセスに深く関わる  インターナショナルプログラムにおける香港リージョナルオフィス、HQとのコミュニケーションを担い、橋渡しの役目を担う。    【チェンジマネジメント】    ラグジュアリーブランドやホスピタリティ業界、他ゾーンにおける顧客トリートメント施策、VIPリテンション施策の情報を収集分析し、戦略策定に活かす。  目標達成のための新たなアイデア・プロセスを考案・提案し実行する。    LEADERSHIP  【リーダーシップ責任】    ブティックメンバーの一人一人が個々のお客様に合ったクライアントジャーニーをデザインしていくというマインドセットを根付かせ、VIP顧客との関係性強化をリードする。  強化ブティックのVIP顧客対象にパーソナライズされた1to1トリートメントのプランニング、サポートをリードする。  VIPツアー及びHJイベントを軸としたVIP誘致イベントにおいて、BTQスタッフと協働で顧客満足度を高めることを目指し、ターゲティングから個々のトリートメント実施までサポートしターゲット達成する。  HQのハイエンドチームとの顧客関連のパイプ役の責任を担う。     【コラボレーション＆ステークホルダーマネジメント】    Strategic Planningチーム／ブティックマネジメントと連携してVIP顧客リストの可視化を行う（TOP150プロジェクト運用）。  各部門とのコラボレーション（セールス、マーケティング、クライアントチーム）と連携し、ハイエンドビジネスの開発・拡大、売上目標の達成に貢献する。  Event Sales Promotion(ESP)と顧客イベント、ディナーなどの年間計画プランニングを作成、実施のみならず、実施後のブティックフォローアップまで行う。  ガラディナーやカンパニディナーのプランニング・コンテンツのサポート、ご招待顧客のコーディネーション、シーティングプランをリードする。     Minimum Working Experience (実務経験)     実務経験10年以上、ラグジュアリーブランドでの経験が望ましい     Required Knowledge & Background（知識・経験）   【Must Haves】    クライアント・リレーションシップ・マネジメントの実務経験 （ラグジュアリーまたはハイエンドブランドでの経験があれば尚良し）  VIP顧客の対応経験、および売上目標の達成実績（プラス評価）  お客様一人ひとりに寄り添った、記憶に残る特別な体験を創造できる能力（重要）  顧客情報の管理、アプローチ履歴の把握、正確かつタイムリーなフォローアップを徹底するための、細部への細やかな配慮と高い管理・整理能力  ブランド独自の強み（ユニーク・セリング・ポイント）を言語化し、その提供価値をお客様へ効果的に伝えることができる能力    【Desirable if possible】    新規VIP顧客を能動的に開拓し、潜在的なハイポテンシャル顧客との関係性を構築・育成できること  CRM（顧客関係管理）システムまたは類似ツールの活用・操作スキル（あれば尚可）     Required Skills（スキル）   【Must Haves】    VIP顧客と効果的に信頼関係を築き、ニーズを深く理解し、長期的な関係性を確立するための、極めて優れた対人・関係構築能力  日本語および英語が流暢で

title: Junior Player Support Representative
description: Job Description   We're looking for a player-first, analytically curious  Junior Support Representative  who sees customer interactions as signals to understand, not just tickets to close. You'll be the internal voice of our players by spotting trends, anticipating issues early, and helping build a more empathetic, scalable support experience through automation, AI, and process optimisation.   What will you be doing at Miniclip?    Player Support & Communication     Handle player inquiries across accounts, purchases, gameplay, and technical issues with empathy, clarity, and efficiency  Adapt your communication style to players from diverse cultural backgrounds  Share information that's accurate, current, and genuinely useful - not just protocol-compliant     Trend Analysis & Critical Thinking     Go beyond resolution - spot recurring patterns, surface root causes, and turn player feedback into actionable insights for Product, QA, and Marketing  Anticipate emerging issues and trends from early signals (release notes, sentiment shifts, ticket spikes) and raise them proactively  Challenge response templates and protocols that no longer serve players, using data and feedback to propose better alternatives  Own a feedback loop between frontline support and internal teams, narrowing the gap between player reality and product decisions     AI & Process Experimentation     Use and evaluate AI-assisted tools (response suggestions, auto-tagging, sentiment analysis) to improve your workflow and player outcomes  Identify, prototype, and pitch automation or AI opportunities that reduce friction for players and agents alike  Run pilots for new support tools, giving structured feedback on what works and what doesn't     Agile Collaboration     Contribute to team retrospectives with player-facing observations and improvement suggestions  Work in an iterative, self-directed loop — test, measure, adjust, and share what you learn  Work with Support Operations to turn frontline observations into practical tooling and workflow improvements     What are we looking for?    Essential     1+ years of customer-facing experience, ideally in a tech or digital environment  Hands-on experience with automations, triggers, macros, or workflow rules in a support, CRM, or no-code tool.  Practical experience using AI-assisted tools in your work.  Analytical curiosity — you ask why players are contacting us, not just how to close the ticket  Comfort using data and observation to back up suggestions and ideas  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and critical judgment, and the confidence to challenge a process or a team when the evidence calls for it  Strong written and spoken English, with excellent communication across cultures  Familiarity with ticketing systems     Desirable     Experience in the gaming industry or passion for mobile games  Experience prompting, fine-tuning workflows around, or self-hosting AI customer-service tool

title: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy
description: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy     Haluatko työskennellä asiakkaiden kanssa ja olla mukana rakentamassa nopeasti kasvavaa suomalaista teknologiayritystä?      FreightOpt on B2B-yrityksille suunnattu digitaalinen kuljetuspalvelu, jonka avulla yritykset voivat vertailla, tilata ja seurata kuljetuksia helposti yhdestä paikasta. Kasvumme jatkuessa etsimme nyt tiimiimme  Customer Success Specialistia , joka auttaa uusia ja nykyisiä asiakkaitamme saamaan FreightOptista mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.    Mitä työ pitää sisällään?    Customer Success Specialistina vastaat erityisesti uusien asiakkaiden onnistuneesta käyttöönotosta sekä nykyisten asiakkaiden aktivoinnista ja käytön kehittämisestä.     Työskentelet asiakkaidemme kanssa aktiivisesti  puhelimitse, etätapaamisissa ja sähköpostitse . Tavoitteesi on varmistaa, että asiakkaat pääsevät nopeasti alkuun, löytävät FreightOptista heille sopivat palvelut ja ottavat palvelun osaksi päivittäistä toimintaansa.     Tyypillisiä tehtäviäsi ovat esimerkiksi:      uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja käyttöönoton tukeminen  FreightOptin esittely ja asiakkaiden opastaminen etätapaamisissa  nykyisten asiakkaiden aktiivinen yhteydenpito ja käytön kasvattaminen  asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen ja ratkaisujen löytäminen yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa  tiivis yhteistyö myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja muun FreightOpt-tiimin kanssa  asiakaspalautteen välittäminen eteenpäin palvelumme kehittämiseksi     Mitä odotamme sinulta?    Etsimme ennen kaikkea aktiivista, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy ihmisten kanssa ja uskaltaa tarttua puhelimeen.     Aikaisempi kokemus  asiakastyöstä, Customer Success -tehtävistä tai myynnistä  on eduksi, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Arvostamme erityisesti hyvää asennetta, kommunikointitaitoja ja halua oppia.     Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Ruotsin, englannin ja viron kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.    Mitä tarjoamme?    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin vahvasti kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja toimintatapojemme kehittämiseen.  Meillä saat:      mukavan ja rennon työilmapiirin  pienen ja ketterän tiimin ilman turhaa byrokratiaa  mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana  vastuuta ja vapautta oman työn tekemiseen  modernit työvälineet ja viihtyisän toimiston Espoossa  mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöskentelyyn      Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla, mutta toivomme sinun olevan myös  viikoittain mukana Espoon toimistollamme , sillä tiivis yhteistyö muun tiimin kanssa on meille tärkeää.    Kiinnostuitko?    Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus ja CV sekä kerro, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä voisi sopia sinulle.   Tule mukaan rakentamaan FreightOptin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta!

title: Customer Service & Product Specialist (m/w/d) 60-80%
description: Jobbeschreibung  Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.   Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. In regelmässigen Webinaren und im direkten Online-Austausch vermittelst du dein Wissen und kommunizierst stets adressatengerecht und stilsicher. Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Rollen mit intensivem Kundenkontakt (z. B. Customer Training, Consulting oder Success) – idealerweise im Schweizer SaaS- oder Treuhand-Umfeld.   Du besitzt eine hohe Affinität für Softwareprodukte (von Vorteil bereits bexio-Kenntnisse) sowie fundierte Buchhaltungskenntnisse. Yoga, Bootcamps, Massagen und legendäre Grill-Sessions.   16 Wochen Mutterschafts- und 3 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub.

title: Host Manager
description: Drifter is built for curious travellers, free spirits, and people who care about great spaces and great experiences. We run hostels and hybrid stays across Australia and New Zealand, alongside food and beverage venues that bring people together and give our properties their edge. The kind of places people remember, not just pass through.      We're opening our newest property in Wellington in December 2026, and we're building the entire leadership team from the ground up.      We're looking for a Host Manager to join that team and help bring the property to life. This is a rare chance to join before opening, help bring a new property to life, build your own team, and help create the culture, standards and ways of working from day one.          The opportunity         The Host team is often the first and last interaction guests have with Drifter, so this role matters. A lot.     As our Host Manager, you'll lead a team that sets the tone for the entire guest experience. From seamless arrivals and departures to solving problems, building connections and creating a welcoming atmosphere, you'll make sure every guest feels looked after from the moment they walk through the door.     You'll also be a key member of the leadership team, working closely with the General Manager and other Heads of Department to make sure the whole operation runs smoothly.     Starting in early November 2026, you'll have the opportunity to come in before opening, recruit and develop your team, and help set the standards for the guest experience from day one.      What it looks like day to day:      Leading, coaching and supporting the Host team   Creating a welcoming, high-energy environment for guests and team members   Managing front office and night operations   Handling escalated guest issues and finding practical solutions   Recruiting, onboarding and training new team members   Building rosters that work for both the business and the team   Monitoring labour costs, revenue opportunities and departmental performance   Looking for ways to improve the guest experience and operational efficiency   Working closely with Housekeeping, F&B and Maintenance to keep the property running seamlessly   Helping establish processes, standards and ways of working as part of the pre-opening journey          You’ll be a good fit if…      You're a hospitality leader who loves being part of the action. You know how to lead a team without standing on the sidelines, and you're just as comfortable jumping on reception during a busy check-in as you are coaching performance or reviewing labour costs.     You build strong teams, create great guest experiences, and know how to keep things running smoothly when the pace picks up.      You’ll likely bring:      Experience leading a guest services, reception or host team within a hostel, lifestyle accommodation, tourism or experience-led hospitality environment  Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, recruitment and performance

title: Senior Manager, Global Equity
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - US
 

    About Faire   
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. 
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.    About this role  
 Faire is revolutionizing wholesale and helping local retailers and their suppliers succeed in a technology-enabled era. As a Senior Manager, Global Equity, you will own and continue to evolve Faire’s global equity programs, building on an existing foundation while enhancing the structure, rigor, and scalability required to support public company readiness. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, brings strong judgment, and wants to shape how equity operates with true end-to-end ownership. 
  As a Senior Manager, Global Equity You Will  
 
 Own and scale Faire’s global equity programs end-to-end, spanning plan design, administration, accounting, compliance, and employee experience across all equity award types and jurisdictions. 
 Serve as the senior owner of equity operations, partnering with Finance, Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and People to build durable, audit-ready processes that scale with company growth. 
 Lead public company equity responsibilities, including SEC reporting support, insider trading programs, audit readiness, and the design and operation of equity-related internal controls. 
 Oversee the full equity lifecycle, including grant issuance, vesting, exercises, releases, share pool management, and reconciliations between the equity platform and general ledger. 
 Design, implement, and optimize equity systems and workflows, including Shareworks (or equivalent) integrations with payroll, HRIS, and financial reporting systems. 
 Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex employee, executive, and stakeholder equity matters, exercising sound judgment and discretion. 
 Proactively manage global regulatory, tax, and compliance risk, partnering with Legal and external advisors to ensure equity programs remain compliant as Faire scales internationally. 
 
  Qualifications  
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Law or equivalent practical experience 
 10+ years of experience in stock plan administration, including leadership in complex or high-growth environments 
 CEP certification strongly preferred

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Company Description  Kreality specializes in helping established B2B service businesses recover opportunities hidden in their existing lead databases. Many organizations have dormant inquiries, stalled proposals, and unfinished conversations sitting in their CRM, representing sunk acquisition costs and missed revenue. Kreality’s Lead Revival system reactivates this pipeline by identifying the right lead cohorts, rebuilding sales context, running personalized outreach, handling responses, and booking qualified calls directly into internal sales calendars. The commercial model is closely aligned with client results, combining a fee per qualified call with a success-based percentage on attributable collected revenue. Kreality primarily serves agencies, consultancies, managed IT providers, recruitment firms, and similar B2B service organizations with proven offers and robust sales capabilities.  Role Description  The Customer Success Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Melbourne, VIC. This role is responsible for onboarding new clients, guiding them through the Lead Revival process, and ensuring they achieve measurable outcomes from pipeline recovery efforts. Day-to-day activities include managing client relationships, understanding their CRM data and sales processes, coordinating campaign timelines, and communicating results and insights clearly. The Customer Success Manager will monitor key performance indicators, address issues proactively, facilitate feedback loops with internal teams, and support continuous improvement in service delivery. This role works closely with sales, operations, and technical teams to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term retention.  Qualifications     Strong customer service and customer satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering consistent value and positive client experiences.  Customer retention and relationship building capabilities to foster long-term partnerships and drive renewals and expansions.  Analytical skills to interpret CRM data, campaign performance metrics, and revenue outcomes, and to translate insights into actionable recommendations.  Experience managing B2B client accounts, ideally within agencies, consultancies, or other service-based environments.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex processes in clear, practical terms.  Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and coordinate multiple client projects simultaneously.  Comfort working with CRM systems and sales tools; experience with data reporting or dashboards is advantageous.  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description: Appierについて   Appier（エイピア）は、AIネイティブのAgentic AI as a Service（AaaS）企業です。  2012年に「AIの民主化」をビジョンに設立され、「Turn AI into ROI（AIをROIに変える）」をミッションとして掲げています。現在はアジア太平洋地域、ヨーロッパ、アメリカを含む17拠点を展開し、東京証券取引所（証券コード：4180）に上場しています。  Appierは、AI Agentを活用し、企業のマーケティングDX・データ活用・顧客体験（CX）の変革を支援する次世代AIプラットフォームを提供しています。   提供ソリューション    Appier AI Marketing Agent Platform   Appierは、AI Agentを中心としたオールインワンのマーケティングプラットフォームを提供しています。  企業が保有する顧客データをAIが理解・分析し、マーケティング施策の企画から実行、最適化までをAI Agentが支援します。  データ基盤、予測AI、マーケティングオートメーション、マルチチャネルコミュニケーション、生成AIによるクリエイティブ制作までを一つのプラットフォームで提供し、お客様のマーケティングROI最大化を実現します。   AIQUA（アイコア）   AI Agentを活用し、Web・アプリ・メール・LINE・Push通知など複数チャネルにおいて、一人ひとりに最適化された顧客体験を自動で実現するマーケティングオートメーションプラットフォームです。   BotBonnie（ボットボニー）   LINEをはじめとするSNSやWebチャットを活用し、AI Agentによる顧客コミュニケーションを実現するマルチチャネルマーケティングソリューションです。   AIRIS（アイリス）   AI Agentの意思決定を支えるPredictive Customer Data Platform（CDP）です。  顧客データを統合するだけでなく、AIによる予測分析を通じて顧客の将来行動やニーズを予測し、最適なマーケティング施策や顧客体験の実現を支援します。   AdCreative.ai（アドクリエイティブ・エーアイ）   生成AIを活用し、高品質な広告クリエイティブを自動生成・最適化するAIクリエイティブプラットフォームです。   ポジション概要   Customer Success Managerとして、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを導入いただいた日本国内の企業を担当し、お客様がプラットフォームから最大の成果を引き出せるよう、導入から定着、そして事業成果の創出までを伴走していただきます。  本ポジションは、問い合わせに対応するサポート業務ではありません。  お客様のマーケティング課題とKPIを深く理解した上で、AI title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides

title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) for telemedicine platform
description:
Your role at Ocumeda

As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

  • Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it
  • Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them
  • Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product
  • Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building
  • Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork
  • Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly


What makes you a great fit

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users

Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.
