title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Steuerberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jeder Abschluss folgt einem Ablauf – und die meisten dieser Abläufe wurden nie systematisch hinterfragt. Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen ihre Workarounds kennen, nicht weil sie durchdacht sind. Genau das ist der Hebel, der in dieser Branche noch niemandem gehört.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und entwickelt sie weiter, statt sie einzuschmelzen. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Das funktioniert nur, wenn darunter etwas steht, das trägt: Prozesse, die an jedem Standort gleich laufen, Technologie, die im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt wird, und eine Integration, die bei der fünften Übernahme schneller geht als bei der ersten. Diese Schicht baust du. Sie existiert heute nicht.

Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Aufbau operativer Systeme mit – aus einem B2B-Scaleup, einem Company Builder, einer Beratung mit eigener Umsetzungsverantwortung oder aus deiner eigenen Gründung. Du wechselst, weil dein Mandat kleiner geworden ist als deine Verarbeitungskraft: zu viel Abstimmung, zu wenig Hebel, zu viele Konzepte, die andere umsetzen. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil von beidem – Strukturen, die tragen, mit etablierten Mandanten und einer starken Wachstumsbasis, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest Operations bei Vogel in ganzer Breite: die Automatisierung der Abläufe im Kerngeschäft, die internen Werkzeuge und die Datenarchitektur, die IT- und Identitäts-Infrastruktur samt Endgeräten und Sicherheit, die technische Integration jeder übernommenen Einheit und die Abläufe rund um Eintritt, Vertrag, Systeme und Austritt unserer eigenen Leute. Du baust das Team, das diese Themen trägt, und verteilst die Schwerpunkte dari

Wer Beratungsunternehmen zukauft, kauft sich Konsolidierungskreise ein – und in den meisten mittelständischen Strukturen ist das Rechnungswesen dafür nie gebaut worden, sondern über Jahre gewachsen.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland – mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe und bauen daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand. Jeder Zukauf bringt eine neue Gesellschaft, eine Eröffnungsbilanz, eine Kaufpreisallokation und einen erweiterten Konsolidierungskreis mit. Damit das trägt, braucht es jemanden, bei dem niemand mehr nachrechnet, ob der Konzernabschluss steht.

Du bist bestellter Wirtschaftsprüfer oder stehst unmittelbar vor dem Examen, mit vier oder mehr Jahren Audit bei einer der großen oder der nächstgrößeren Prüfungsgesellschaften und echter Konzernabschluss-Tiefe. Du wechselst, weil die nächste Stufe in der Prüfungshierarchie mehr Review und weniger eigene Arbeit bedeutet – und weil du die Zahlen lieber verantwortest, als sie zu testieren. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen von Vogel – Konsolidierung und Konzernabschluss, das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften, dessen Automatisierung und das externe Reporting an Banken und Stakeholder. Du berichtest direkt an Joachim und Moritz Vogel; am Standort München entsteht die Finance-Funktion gerade erst, und du bist ihr fachlicher Anker. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn – oder, wenn du das willst, in den Aufbau eines eigenen Teams.

Deine Verantwortung

ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

title: Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.


Your future position

Join Kpler’s Chartering team as a Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering and play a key role in ensuring the quality and accuracy of the data that powers our Chartering products.

Kpler’s Chartering products rely on accurate vessel, ownership and market data to help charterers, shipowners and brokers make informed commercial decisions. In this role, you will work hands-on with the datasets behind these products, investigating inconsistencies, validating information and helping improve data quality at scale.

Your work will span a range of chartering datasets, from vessel ownership and characteristics to fixtures, cargo orders, vessel positions and shipping zones. You will use SQL and Python to extract, transform and analyse data, build validation checks and investigate potential issues. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of data, asking why something doesn't look right and finding ways to identify and solve problems systematically. You will work closely with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams, turning individual data issues into broader improvements across Kpler's datasets and products.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

 

Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

 

What You'll be Doing

  • Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics,

description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Sonatype is expanding its presence across Northern Europe, and we are looking for a Senior Account Executive to lead revenue growth across the Nordics and Baltics region. As software development accelerates through AI coding assistants and open source ingestion, software supply chain security has become a strategic, board-level priority for global enterprise organizations.

Joining one of Sonatype’s top-performing global sales teams, you will own a high-growth territory with a dual mandate: acquiring high-value enterprise new logos and expanding existing customer adoption. Using Sonatype Firewall as a high-velocity commercial wedge, you will partner cross-functionally to scale our market visibility while building trust-based, long-term customer partnerships. This role is ideal for an autonomous, commercially disciplined sales professional who thrives in a high-accountability environment and is driven to raise the performance bar.

description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

You will also play a defining role in productizing what we learn: building the implementation playbook and standing up our Delivery team to eventually own this work as CGCA reaches general availability.

title: Engineering Manager, Ads
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Ads Engineering organization at Mozilla builds privacy-respecting advertising systems that support Mozilla’s products and business while aligning with our mission and values. Our teams focus on reliable, scalable systems that enable advertising experiences across Mozilla products.

As an Engineering Manager on Ads Engineering, you will lead a team of software engineers working on Firefox Suggest Ads, the sponsored suggestion experiences within Firefox Suggest. This team builds and operates backend services, partner integrations, experimentation capabilities, and product-facing systems that help deliver relevant sponsored suggestions in Firefox while respecting user privacy and product quality expectations.

You’ll be responsible for building a healthy, effective team; partnering closely with Product, Data, Privacy, Policy, Revenue, and Firefox engineering stakeholders; and ensuring your team delivers high-quality software in support of Ads Engineering goals.

This role balances people leadership, execution, and collaboration, with a strong emphasis on mentoring engineers, navigating ambiguity, delivering results, and fostering a positive, inclusive team culture.

What you’ll do:

  • Mentor, support, and develop a team of software engineers, helping them grow in impact and craft
  • Lead your team through the delivery of Firefox Suggest Ads initiatives, including backend services, partner integrations, experimentation, measurement, reliability improvements, and product-facing integrations where requirements may evolve as privacy, policy, user experience, and business constraints become clearer
  • Partner with product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to navigate ambiguity, particularly where user data, privacy expectations, or policy considerations shape technical and product decisions

title: Asiakkuusjohtaja, OP Yrityspankki, Suuret yritysasiakkaat
description: Tule meille kollegaksi   Haemme OP Yrityspankkiin Helsinkiin toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Asiakkuusjohtajaa.   Tehtävästä   Vastaat OP Yrityspankin suurimpien yritysasiakkuuksien johtamisesta, asiakaskokemuksesta ja kannattavuudesta yhdessä työparisi kanssa. Johdat matriisissa ammattitaitoista asiakkuustiimiä vastaten OP Pohjolan tarjoamien pankkipalveluiden myynnistä sekä tuloksesta ja tavoitteiden toteutumisesta.  Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden sekä eri liiketoimintojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa varmistaen asiakkaiden tarpeisiin vastaavat kokonaisvaltaiset ratkaisut.  Tärkein päämäärämme on ratkaista asiakkaidemme tarpeet laadukkaasti ja kattavasti. Teemme töitä hybridimallissa joustavasti, asiakastyö ja työtilanteet huomioiden.   Millaista osaamista etsimme?   Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on monipuolinen ja vahva osaaminen rahoitusalalta sekä näyttöä työskentelystä suurten tai keskisuurten yritysasiakkaiden parissa. Osaaminen kauppa- ja energiasektoreilta katsotaan eduksesi. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto ja työskentelet sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi, ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.  Olet aktiivinen ja nautit työskentelystä lähellä asiakasta. Sinulla on vahvat analyyttiset taidot ja pystyt tuottamaan lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme – tunnistat ratkaisumahdollisuuksia sekä riskejä tarkastelemalla liiketoimintaa. Sinulla on kokemusta yritysrahoituksesta tai muusta suuryritysasiakkuuksiin liittyvästä liiketoiminnasta. Lisäksi sinulla on kokemusta laajojen asiakkuuskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta matriisimaisessa toimintaympäristössä.  Osaat rakentaa ja ylläpitää menestyviä verkostoja sekä toimia haastavissa neuvottelutilanteissa. Intohimosi on menestyä työssäsi ja saada tuloksia aikaiseksi yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.   Me tarjoamme   Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä OP Yrityspankin merkittävimpien yritysasiakkuuksien parissa sekä hyödyntää työssäsi koko OP Pohjolan laajaa asiantuntija- ja palveluverkostoa. Saat tueksesi kokeneet kollegat ja monipuoliset mahdollisuudet syventää osaamistasi suuryritysasiakkuuksien johtamisessa.  Vastuullisen työn vastapainoksi pidämme huolen työhyvinvoinnistasi ja tulevaisuuteen katsovista työjärjestelyistä. Tarjoamme sinulle vakaan ympäristön, jossa vastuullisuus, ihmisläheisyys ja yhdessä menestyminen ovat keskeisiä arvoja.  Saat käyttöösi monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme, johon kuuluvat mm. henkilökuntaehtoiset pankki-, vakuutus- ja lainapalvelut. Tarjoamme myös kattavan työterveyshuollon, laajan hoitokuluvakuutuksen sekä täysajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työssäjaksamiseen panostamme arjen tasapainolla ja joustavuudella sekä tarjoamalla käyttöösi lounas-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä mahdollisuuden edulliseen lomailuun OP Pohjolan lomaosakkeissa.   Lisätiedot ja hakuohjeet   Haluaisitko vaihtaa ajatuksia tehtävästä tai meillä työskentelystä? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa johtaja Sami Hussi, p. 050 344 5892 to 6.8. klo 11.30-13.00, pe 14.8. klo 08.00-09

title: Senior Account Manager, Partner Success
description: Who we are   We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.     Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. Collaborate with partners to define and refine a clear strategic roadmap, establishing measurable milestones and key objectives.  Take ownership of critical meetings, driving discussions, decision-making, and follow-through to ensure successful outcomes. Act as the main point of escalation for partner issues, proactively addressing challenges and ensuring swift resolutions to maintain strong, productive relationships.      Who you are    Ideally native or C2 level in German & English. Excellent written and oral communication skills with all levels of the organisation.  Highly organised with great attention to detail,

title: Partnership & Activation Manager (f, m, d)
description: Your playground   We are looking for a hands-on Partnership & Activation Manager to turn our signed B2B(2C) partnerships into real, engaged end users. Hello Inside works with strong partners – private & public health insurance, pharma and pharmacy, employers and platforms – who give us access to their members and customers. Your job starts where the contract is signed: you take each partnership live and then keep it working. You bring partners from signing into launch, design and run recurring activation campaigns through their channels, and make sure their members actually discover, sign up for, and stay with Hello Inside. You will monitor user engagement and health outcomes for our partners. For you, a signed deal is the starting line, not the finish. If you're excited to be part of a purpose-driven and winning team, Hello Inside is a great place to grow your career. title: Customer Onboarding Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 다른 플랫폼에서 비즈니스를 만들어온 고객사들이 아임웹을 사용하고 있습니다. Customer Onboarding Manager는 이전해오는 고객사의 오픈과 온보딩을 직접 책임지고, 고객사가 아임웹을 사업의 핵심 성장 도구로 사용하도록 돕는 역할입니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    신규 이전 고객사의 온보딩을 담당해, 오픈까지 걸리는 시간을 단축합니다.  킥오프에서 요구사항과 오픈 일정을 파악하고, 오픈까지 필요한 과제를 관리합니다.  데이터 이전, 도메인 연결, 결제 연동, 초기 세팅을 고객사와 함께 진행합니다.  도입 단계에서 반복되는 문의를 구조화해 유관 부서 및 AI 자동화를 통해 개선합니다.  도입 가이드와 온보딩 자료를 정비해 도입 방식을 표준화합니다.       [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 도입 지원, 온보딩, 영업 지원 등 2년 이상의 경력이 있으신 분  여러 고객사의 도입 건을 동시에 진행하며 일정과 과제를 관리해보신 분  제품의 기능을 고객의 업무 언어로 풀어 설명해보신 분  도메인, 결제, 데이터 이전 등 기술적인 설정을 고객과 함께 진행하는 데 거리감이 없으신 분  고객사 실무진, 사내 유관 부서와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  반복되는 문제를 가이드나 프로세스로 만들어 해결하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험  쇼핑몰 구축이나 플랫폼 이전을 직접 지원해본 경험  고객사 도입 프로젝트를 리딩해본 경험  도입 가이드나 교육 프로그램을 만들어 문의량이나 도입 속도를 개선해본 경험  반복되는 문제나 비효율을 AI 자동화를 통해 개선해본 경험       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Customer Care Manager
description: About us:   The Bread Factory is the UK's leading artisan bakery. Founded by Gail Meija in 1993, The Bread Factory, originally known as Gail Force, began by supplying some of London's most prestigious restaurants, including many with Michelin stars. More than three decades later, we continue to work closely with the best chefs, alongside grocers, foodservice partners and our own neighbourhood bakery, GAIL's.  The Bread Factory is synonymous with quality. We have been awarded more than 100 Great Taste Awards and have held a Royal Warrant since 2016, when it was first granted by Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. The result: delicious, carefully made baked goods that support a more sustainable and nutritious food system; bringing great bread to more tables every day.  As Customer Care Manager, you’ll lead and develop a high-performing team that delivers a consistently brilliant service to our chefs, bakeries, grocers and buyers every day. You’ll be responsible for achieving service, quality and customer KPIs, while driving customer retention, reducing customer effort and building an empathetic but honest culture of continuous improvement. title: Tiiminvetäjä, Tampere Veska
description: Kiinnostaako työskentely modernissa vähittäiskauppaketjussa, innostavassa ja lämminhenkisessä työyhteisössä, jossa pyritään yhdessä löytämään käteviä ja käytännöllisiä ratkaisuja asiakkaillemme?   Haemme nyt Tiiminvetäjää uuteen myymäläämme Tampereen Veskaan!   Tärkein tehtäväsi on ohjata ja kannustaa tiimiäsi tekemään tehokasta myyntityötä ja palvelemaan asiakkaita tavallista paremmin. Johdat ja delegoit myymälän päivittäisten tehtävien suorittamista sekä osallistut niiden kehittämiseen. Koulutat tiimiäsi, jotta saavutatte yhdessä erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun ja loistavat myyntitulokset. Varmistat myymälän kaupallisuuden yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa. Teet aktiivista myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyötä näyttäen esimerkkiä tiimillesi omalla tarmokkaalla toiminnallasi.  Olet kannustava esihenkilö, jolla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Olet tottunut suunnittelemaan, toteuttamaan ja seuraamaan päivittäisiä myymälärutiineja sekä myynnin avainlukuja. Omaat palavan innostuksen myyntiin ja johdat myyntiä kannustavalla otteella. Toivomme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta esihenkilötehtävästä tai vastuullisen myyjän tehtävästä vähittäiskaupassa tai palvelualalla. Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea ja englantia. Myynnin ammattitutkinto tai muu kaupallinen koulutus on plussaa.   Mitä tarjoamme?   Tulet osaksi lämminhenkistä ja avointa työyhteisöä, jossa vaalimme yrityskulttuurimme perustaa, Clas Ohlson henkeä. Me Clas Ohlsonilla arvostamme työtekijöitämme juuri sellaisina kuin he ovat. Tarjoamme jokaiselle mahdollisuuden kehittyä omassa roolissaan osallistuttamalla koko henkilökuntaa myymälän päivittäiseen toimintaan ja työskentelemällä aina yhdessä tiiminä. Henkilöstön hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää ja tarjoamme laajan työterveyshuollon, sekä ePassi sportti-, kulttuuri-, ja hyvinvointiedun kaikille työntekijöillemme.  Toivomme, että juuri sinä, omalla persoonallisuudellasi ja kokemuksellasi, haluat olla osa matkaamme, joka vie meitä eteenpäin vielä seuraavat 100 vuotta. Tähän matkaan on jokaisella mahdollisuus olla mukana vaikuttamassa.   Työsuhteen laatu, työaika ja palkkaus    Työsuhteen laatu:  toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, kokoaikainen 37,5 t/viikko   Työsuhteen palkkaus : Kaupan alan TES B-taulukkopalkka + 11 % vastuulisä. Esimerkki* kuukausipalkasta kolmen vuoden kokemuksella, 4:nnen vuoden palkalla n. 2700€/kk. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksetaan Bonus, kulloinkin voimassa olevan yhtiön ohjeen ja järjestelmän mukaan   Työsuhteen aloitus : syyskuu 2026 / sopimuksen mukaan   Joko kiinnostuit?   Hae mukaan jättämällä meille hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi 30.8.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja pyrimme lähettämään haastattelukutsuja jo hakuajan aikana, joten laitathan hakemuksesi hyvissä ajoin!    Ensimmäinen rekrytointivaihe on lyhyt videohaastattelu. Lähetämme kutsun sähköpostitse niille hakijoille, jotka etenevät rekrytointiprosessissa tähän vaiheeseen, joten pidäthän silmällä sähköpostiasi, jotta kutsu ei jää huomaamatta. title: Customer Support Manager
description: The client   Buddy Advisory is proud to be partnering with PaySauce to find their next Customer Support Manager. PaySauce makes payroll simple for small businesses across New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific. Their customers run cafes, build houses, milk cows and run retail stores; they're not payroll experts, they're experts in their own business. Payroll is time-critical and people rely on it, so being there when things go wrong matters deeply to the PaySauce team.  PaySauce is investing deeply in its Customer Experience function, both the operational side (the tools, data and overall management of how it delivers its service) and the people side, growing team capacity and capability as it heads into a period of significant product change.      The role   PaySauce is looking for a support leader who builds great customer care through a strong team and the systems and operations behind them. This is a leadership role owning PaySauce's Customer Support function, the inbound, reactive care customers come to them for, which sits alongside Customer Success, their proactive, outbound function. Together they shape the experience customers feel every day.  You'll lead the Customer Support team, report to PaySauce's Head of Customer Operations, and work across the wider Customer Experience group including Customer Operations, Customer Success, Onboarding and their dedicated Australian team. It's a team in a period of real growth and change, heading into a multi-year transition as customers move onto PaySauce's new products, and leading it well through that transition is a critical part of landing it.      The responsibilities    Lead the Customer Support team and build a collaborative, customer-first culture grounded in curiosity, teamwork and continuous improvement  Recruit, onboard and develop the team, working with everyone on their professional development and growing their skills  Balance workloads sustainably and ensure we're meeting expected SLAs across all inbound channels  Own the service model and how we deliver it, including through the upcoming migration of customers to a new payroll experience  Build a detailed understanding of service load to plan rosters and coverage, resource the team sustainably, and improve cost to serve over time  Track a balanced set of measures, including customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, and response and resolution times  Own escalation and issue management: clear escalation paths, senior stakeholder management, coordination with Development on urgent fixes and outages, and crisis communications  Embed quality assurance into day-to-day support work       The requirements    A highly capable people leader with lived leadership and coaching experience, helping others grow through trust and empowerment. We use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to provide opportunities for our customers and colleagues through global connectivity. We bring together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share. The Transaction Services Manager plays a key role in proactively ensuring an industry-leading customer experience across high-value GTS relationships. title: Night Manager - Sherwood
description: Night Manager – Sherwood Queenstown  Boutique Alpine Hotel   About EVT   Sherwood Queenstown is part of EVT, one of Australasia's market-leading experience creators offering careers that can take you wherever you want to go across entertainment, ventures, and travel. In a world of cookie cutter experiences, here at EVT we believe in changing the game. It's why we all call ourselves Daymakers, because each day is a chance to add the wow factor for our customers and continually grow in our own careers.  The Independent Collection is a curated selection of hotels, each of which lives up to an exacting standard to offer travellers the best of luxury, elevated, urban, comfort and social experiences. While every hotel celebrates its own unique brand and experience, together the Independent Collection shares a passion for one-of-a-kind experiences, service and quality.  EVT has an endless range of roles and career paths to explore across over 140 entertainment experiences like Event Cinemas and Moonlight Cinemas, 150 award winning restaurants and bars, and 80+ hotels, including QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo, Independent Collection and Australia's most loved year round alpine resort, Thredbo. Our ventures include a ~$2.3B property portfolio and hotel management, just to name a few. Once you're in, there's no limits on where your career could take you.   Role Overview   Sherwood Queenstown is a sustainability-led, boutique hotel set on the hillside overlooking Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables, awarded a Michelin Star in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide New Zealand. Blending rustic charm with modern comfort, Sherwood offers a unique retreat focused on wellness, creativity, and community.  Reporting to the Front Office Manager, the Night Manager acts as the manager of the hotel overnight in the absence of the General Manager, Front Office Manager and Hotel Manager, anticipating and meeting guest needs, overseeing the night audit process, and maintaining hotel security and established service standards through the night shift. You'll supervise the Night Team, resolve guest requests with warmth and urgency, and help protect the seamless experience Sherwood is known for around the clock. This is a rare opportunity to be part of something special, taking genuine ownership of the hotel during the night shift.  This is a full-time, permanent role with a minimum guaranteed hours of 40 per week. Driving customer engagement, monitoring account health, and proactively addressing retention risks  Leading membership renewals, onboarding new customers, and maintaining accurate CRM and membership records. title: Junior Account Manager Elisa Oyj (Oulu)
description: Rakennatko sinä seuraavan kasvutarinan asiakkaidesi kanssa?     Elisa on Suomen johtava tietoliikenne- ja digitaalisten palveluiden tarjoaja. Sen ratkaisut auttavat tuhansia yrityksiä kehittämään liiketoimintaansa, parantamaan tuottavuuttaan ja rakentamaan kilpailuetua nopeasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.    Bookers on ollut osa tätä menestystarinaa jo yli kahden vuosikymmenen ajan. Yhteistyömme Elisan kanssa alkoi 2000-luvun alussa, ja tänä päivänä vastaamme noin 4 500 suomalaisen yrityksen asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä ratkaisumyynnistä osana Elisan yritysmyyntiä.    Nyt etsimme Junior Account Manageria Ouluun liittymään noin 20 hengen asiantuntevaan myyntitiimiimme.    Tässä roolissa et myy yksittäisiä tuotteita. Toimit asiakkaidesi pitkäaikaisena kumppanina, tunnistat heidän liiketoimintansa tarpeita ja rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka auttavat heitä kasvamaan ja menestymään.    Mitä työ sisältää?   Vastaat nimettyjen pienten ja keskisuurten yritysasiakkaiden asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä pääkaupunkiseudulla. Tehtäväsi on kasvattaa asiakkuuksien arvoa, löytää uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia sekä saavuttaa kunnianhimoiset myyntitavoitteet.  Käytössäsi on koko Elisan yritysliiketoiminnan palveluvalikoima, jonka avulla voit rakentaa asiakkaillesi aidosti liiketoimintaa kehittäviä ratkaisuja. Työssä yhdistyvät nykyasiakkuuksien kehittäminen, ratkaisumyynti sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien aktiivinen tunnistaminen.  Työtä tehdään joustavasti hybridimallilla sekä kotoa että Elisan moderneissa toimitiloissa Oulussa. Asiakastyö edellyttää myös liikkumista asiakkaiden luona, ja oman auton käytöstä maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset.   Kenelle tehtävä sopii?   Menestyt tehtävässä, jos nautit tavoitteellisesta tekemisestä, haluat oppia myynnistä ja motivoidut mahdollisuudesta vaikuttaa omaan onnistumiseesi. Et tarvitse vuosien kokemusta asiakkuuksien johtamisesta tai ratkaisumyynnistä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on halu kehittyä, rohkeutta kohdata asiakkaita ja motivaatio tehdä tulosta.  Aiempi kokemus tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä auttaa sinua pääsemään vauhtiin, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne oppia uutta ja rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti omaa osaamistaan.  Sanomattakin lienee selvää, että tavoitteet saavutetaan yhdessä. Työ edellyttää oma-aloitteisuutta ja aktiivista otetta, mutta et missään vaiheessa jää yksin. Saat tueksesi kokeneen tiimin, kattavan perehdytyksen, vahvan valmennuskulttuurin sekä mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ja ICT-ratkaisumyynnin ammattilaiseksi. title: Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d)
description: Kundenbindung ist kein Support-Thema - es ist eine Wachstumsstrategie. Bei kununu bauen wir diese Funktion gerade neu auf und du gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit.  Als Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d) schützt du den Kern unseres Geschäfts. Du arbeitest eng mit Account Management und Customer Experience zusammen, trägst aber dein Ergebnis selbst. Dein Erfolg ist direkt in gesicherten Verträgen und zurückgewonnenen Kund:innen messbar.  Was dich erwartet: keine eingefahrenen Prozesse, kein fertiges Playbook, dafür echte Verantwortung, direkter Einfluss auf unsere Umsatzbasis und die Möglichkeit, etwas aufzubauen, das Bestand hat.      Deine Aufgaben    Umsatz sichern: Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, verstehst warum Kund:innen gehen und handelst, bevor der Vertrag verloren ist.  Kundenbeziehungen retten: Du führst schwierige Gespräche mit Entscheidungsträger:innen, findest individuelle Lösungen und bringst Verhandlungen zu einem Ergebnis.  Verlorene Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du baust das erste strukturierte Winback-Programm bei kununu auf und sorgst dafür, dass ehemalige Kund:innen den Weg zurück finden.  Das AM-Team stärken: Bei strategisch wichtigen Accounts, bei denen Churn droht, wirst du als Spezialist:in dazugeholt - du bringst die kommerzielle Expertise, die Retention braucht.  Marktanteile verteidigen: Du positionierst kununu überzeugend gegen Wettbewerber und Budget-Druck - mit Argumenten, die auf dem konkreten Wert für die Kund:innen basieren.  Retention messbar machen: Du etablierst die Grundlagen für eine datengetriebene Retention-Steuerung bei kununu und legst damit den Grundstein für ein wachsendes Team.       Das bringst du mit    Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B-SaaS- oder Subscription-Geschäft - idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Renewals, Account Management oder Customer Success.  Du führst schwierige Gespräche konstruktiv und bleibst sachlich, auch wenn die Gegenseite Druck macht.  Die Zufriedenheit deiner Kund:innen hat für dich höchste Priorität. Bei einer Kündigung analysierst du die Gründe und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungspotenziale ab.  Du verstehst dich als Stimme der Kund:innen nach innen: Du nutzt das, was du im Kundenkontakt hörst, um intern Prozesse, Produkt und Zusammenarbeit weiterzuentwickeln.  Idealerweise bist du bereits mit Tools wie Gong, Salesloft oder Salesforce vertraut und setzt sie routiniert in deinem Arbeitsalltag ein.  Digitale Sales Rooms sind für dich ein selbstverständliches Arbeitsmittel, kein Pilotprojekt.  KI und Automatisierung setzt du pragmatisch ein.  Für die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen im DACH-Raum verfügst du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Da wir international zusammenarbeiten, kommunizierst du auch sicher auf Englisch.       Deine Benefits    Bürohunde  Bis zu12 Wochen Workation  6 Wochen Urlaub  Mobile devices auch zum privaten Gebrauch  Sommer- und Weihnachtsparty  Drinks, Food & Goodies  Flexibles Home-Office  Restauranttickets und Mitarbeiterrabatte  Marktkonfo

title: Account Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

Handle payment issues, disputes, troubleshooting, and perform a variety of back‑office administrative tasks. Contribute to projects and support the development of products, processes, and documentation, including guides and translations.  Liaise with other departments across the business to ensure adequate knowledge of the business to enhance the service provided to the fan.  Adhere to all company and departmental processes, policies and procedures.   Work at events as needed.  Undertake other duties as required by management. title: Service Manager
description: Job Description   Are you a people-focused leader with a passion for delivering excellent public service? Te Haeata/The Opportunity    We are looking for a dynamic  Service Manager  to lead our our Family/Civil/Tribunals team at the  Nelson District & High Court . title: Teamleder til Service - Virum
location: Virum, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Teamleder til Service  Vil du styrke din lederprofil i en virksomhed, hvor vi er fælles om at levere en højere kvalitet?  Som teamleder har du det overordnede ansvar for serviceområdet, der inkluderer kiosken, posthuset og kasselinjerne. Her løser du mange forskellige opgaver på lige fod med dine medarbejdere, men dit vigtigste ansvar er at være rollemodel for dine kolleger.   Bliv en del af sammenholdet i føtex    Hos føtex deler vi en vinderånd og en stolthed over at gøre det hele lidt mere lækkert. Vi er sammen om at give kunderne en ekstra god service og tilbyde de bedste varer i en indbydende butik med højt til loftet. Vi er dog ikke større end, at alle kender alle, så du kan se frem til at blive en del af et stort sammenhold og få en masse nye kolleger.   Du driver salget, samarbejdet og den gode service    Nøglen til denne stilling er samarbejde. For godt nok er det dit ansvar at sikre, at vi leverer et højt serviceniveau og gode salgsresultater, men vejen til succes finder du gennem uddelegering, samarbejde og kommunikation, og som en integreret del af varehusets ledergruppe kommer du helt tæt på beslutningerne.   Dine opgaver inkluderer desuden at     tage del i service- og kassebetjening af kunder – primært i kiosken  håndtere planlægning af bemanding på tværs af servicelinjerne  sikre størst muligt salg og indtjening i brødudsalg og kiosk  varetage rekruttering, oplæring og MUS     Skab en karriere i en af Danmarks største varehuskæder    Vi ved, at når vores medarbejdere bliver dygtigere, så bliver føtex det også. Derfor bidrager vi hellere end gerne til din faglige udvikling, og hvis du mangler enkelte kompetencer eller har specifikke udviklingsønsker, tilbyder vi en lang række interne kurser som supplement til den daglige sparring.   Du er serviceminded og udadvendt    Vi ser gerne, at du har ledelseserfaring og trives med at sætte det gode eksempel, så du kan motivere og vejlede dine kolleger.    Du har lyst til at tage ansvar for din egen udvikling og levere resultater som en del af et hold og et fællesskab.  Du er udadvendt og serviceminded.  Du har et stort overblik og kan lide at have gang i mange opgaver på samme tid.  Du kan lide at arbejde med mennesker og samtidig varetage administrative og praktiske opgaver.    Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden.   Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.    I 1960 åbnede Herman Salling den første føtex i Guldsmedgade i Aarhus og startede med det samme en indkøbsrevolution, der stadig er i gang. I dag er vi godt 15.000 kolleger, der brænder for at levere service; hurtigt, høfligt, trygt og troværdigt. Du kan komme med på holdet i et af vores over 90 varehuse eller 11 føtex food convenience-butikker. Vores historie er din vækst.

title: Tiiminvetäjä (myymälä)
description: Tiiminvetäjä (myymälä), 37,5h      Etsimme tiiminvetäjää Konalan myymäläämme, Helsinkiin. Sykkiikö sydämesi ensiluokkaiselle asiakaskokemukselle? Oletko se innostava persoona, jonka energia tarttuu koko tiimiin? Johdat porukkaasi valmentavalla otteella ja nautit myymälän vauhdikkaasta arjesta, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme tekemään kestäviä ja parempia valintoja. Nyt sinulla on ainutlaatuinen tilaisuus hypätä mukaan rohkeaan ja omaperäiseen työyhteisöön, jossa asioita uskalletaan tehdä vähän eri tavalla. Jos tämä skene puhuttelee sinua ja uskot sopivasi kunnianhimoiseen mutta rentoon tiimiimme, jatkathan lukemista.      Keitä me olemme?   Varuste.net on suomalainen ulkoilu-, retkeily- ja vapaa-ajan varusteiden myyntiin erikoistunut yritys, joka työllistää jo noin 170 työntekijää. Pyöritämme kivijalkamyymälän lisäksi kansainvälistä verkkokauppaa. Tehtävänämme on auttaa ja innostaa ihmisiä tekemään parempia valintoja eikä niiden valintojen tarvitse jäädä varustetasolle. Näytämme omalla esimerkillämme, että metsäpolku voittaa aina sohvannurkan. Me uskomme, että kun ihminen uskaltaa tehdä parempia valintoja, hän saa elämästään enemmän irti. Kaikki toimintomme on keskitetty Helsingin Konalaan, missä myymälämme, varastomme ja toimistomme sijaitsevat kaikki saman katon alla. Me tähtäämme korkealle, joten tarvitsemme tiimiimme myös vahvaa osaamista, korvaamattoman hyvää asennetta ja rutkasti hulvatonta huumorintajua.      Tarjoamme:    Työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään esihenkilötaitojasi, innostamaan tiimiä ja kehittämään henkilöstöä.  Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi sekä olla mukana kehittämässä Varuste.netin johtamista ja toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.  Tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden esihenkilöiden ja päällikköiden kanssa.  Monipuolisen, rohkean ja rennon työyhteisön. Varuste.netillä saat takuulla nauraa työpäivien aikana ja pääset osaksi rentoa yrityskulttuuria.  Kannattavasti kasvava ja nopeasti kehittyvä yritys tarjoaa paljon mahdollisuuksia myös tulevaisuuden suhteen. Varuste.net Akatemia tarjoaa työntekijöillemme mahdollisuudet oppia uutta, kehittyä uudenlaisiin työtehtäviin ja hyödyntää omaa osaamistaan entistä paremmin.  Haluamme, että jokainen työntekijä panostaa siihen, että työ Varuste.netillä on kivaa. Sitä tukeaksemme, tarjoamme työntekijöillemme mm. loistavat henkilöstöalennukset, alan huipputuotteita lainaksi (esim. SUPit, teltat, lumikengät), hierontaa, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, sekä mökin Rukalla.       Tehtävänkuvaus:   Osana myymälän esihenkilötiimiä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä myymäläpäällikön ja kolmen muun tiiminvetäjän kanssa. Vastuullasi on varmistaa ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus ja tukea henkilökuntaamme heidän päivittäisessä työssään. Johdat myymälän arjen operatiivisia toimintoja, valmennat tiimiäsi menestykseen ja varmistat työskentelyn sujuvuuden sekä tasapuolisuuden. Olet avainasemassa luomassa ympäristöä, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus loistaa.      Työtehtävät:     Operatiivinen arjen johtaminen:  Vast

title: Supervisor Customer Support (m/w/d) 80-100%
description: Jobbeschreibung  Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an. Du steuerst die Abläufe vorausschauend, fängst Peaks flexibel ab und lässt das Team wie ein eingespieltes Orchester harmonieren -  fachlich orientiert und ohne administrativen Führungsdruck, sondern als motivierender Dreh- und Angelpunkt im Team . Du arbeitest aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mit und packst bei hohem Aufkommen selbst am Telefon und im Ticket-System mit an.   Du versteckst dich nicht hinter Zahlen, sondern gehst als Vorbild voran und zeigst dem Team durch dein tägliches Handeln, was exzellenter Support bedeutet.   Du analysierst tägliche Kennzahlen, leitest Massnahmen ein und optimierst Prozesse in Rücksprache mit der Teamleitung, um Kundenzufriedenheit und Effizienz zu steigern.   Du fungierst als wichtiger Inputgeber für das Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam und übersetzt Kunden-Insights in konkrete Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts.    Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle    Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre oder Ausbildung, vorzugsweise im KV, Detailhandel oder Kontaktcenter-Umfeld.   Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit, davon mindestens 2–3 Jahre im Customer Care oder Support bei einem Unternehmen mit grosser Kundenbasis.   Man kennt dich für dein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent, das Ressourcen effizient plant und auch bei vielen wartenden Anrufen blitzschnell die richtigen Prioritäten setzt.   Du bist ein absoluter Praktiker, behältst in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf und managst Anfragen effizient und in hoher Qualität.   Dir fällt es leicht, den Überblick zu behalten, du hast Drive und eine authentische Persönlichkeit,

Do you enjoy working closely with legal professionals, delivering strategic guidance, and driving customer success through adoption, retention, and growth? Join Thomson Reuters as a Customer Success Specialist and become a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them maximize the value of industry-leading legal solutions such as Westlaw, Practical Law, and LawnB.  As a Customer Success Specialist, you will be responsible for driving customer engagement, product adoption, and satisfaction across a portfolio of customers in Korea. You will serve as the primary point of contact, ensuring customers successfully onboard, realize value quickly, and achieve their strategic objectives. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams, you will help customers deepen their usage of Thomson Reuters solutions while identifying opportunities for retention, expansion, and advocacy.   About The Role   In this opportunity as Customer Success Specialist, you will:    Build Strategic Customer Relationships: Cultivate and maintain trusted partnerships with key stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact for customer engagement and success.  Develop and Execute Customer Success Plans: Design and implement tailored Customer Success Plans aligned to customer goals and business priorities, conducting regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).  Lead Customer Onboarding and Education: Guide customers through onboarding, training, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption and time to value.  Drive Product Adoption and Customer Health: Monitor usage trends, analyze adoption metrics, and proactively identify opportunities to improve engagement, satisfaction, and business outcomes.  Support Retention and Growth Strategies: Partner with Sales to support renewals and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities that create additional value for customers.  Champion the Voice of the Customer: Gather and communicate customer feedback to influence product enhancements, marketing initiatives, and customer experience improvements.  Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to align customer success initiatives with broader business objectives. Proficiency in Korean language as this role requires primary communication in Korean with customers in South Korea.  Minimum 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Servicing, Relationship Management, or Sales roles. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Join our  BtoB Customer Service  team at Helen of Troy and make an immediate impact on our trusted brands: OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Honeywell, PUR, Braun, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, Revlon, and Olive & June. Together, we build innovative and useful products that elevate people's lives everywhere, every day.   Position:  Customer Service Manager (BtoB)   Department:  Customer Service/Operations   Work Location:  London, England   Work Type:  Permanent, Full time, Hybrid (working 3 days onsite)   What You Will Be Doing   The Customer Service Manager leads the SOTL (Sports, Outdoor, Travel & Lifestyle) B2B Customer Service team, providing leadership, direction, and coaching in alignment with company policies, operational standards, and departmental objectives.  You will oversee the Customer Service operations for the Osprey and Hydro Flask brands within the SOTL European business, ensuring operational excellence by driving process efficiency, establishing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), and delivering high-performance service standards. The role also champions continuous improvement by leading initiatives and projects that enhance processes, tools, and overall operational effectiveness.  As a key representative of the Customer Service & Operations functions, the Customer Service Manager demonstrates strong decision-making, effective stakeholder management, and clear communication across the organization. The role promotes company objectives and team values while fostering a customer-centric culture that builds long-term customer loyalty through exceptional service and strong relationships. Leading and developing a team of eight direct reports by inspiring, coaching, and motivating through regular one-to-one meetings, team meetings, performance reviews, and ongoing feedback. Setting clear team and individual objectives aligned with business priorities.  Drive Customer Service team performance by ensuring excellence in order management, communication quality, and customer inquiry resolution. Establish, monitor, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve operational and service excellence.  Monitor order intake and coordinate order releases to the warehouse, working closely with Logistics and Warehouse teams to ensure timely execution and achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.  Oversee pre-season and call-off order management, ensuring effective planning, resource allocation, and team readiness to successfully manage peak order volumes. title: Customer Service Solution Manager - Customer Support
description: Responsibilities  About the team TikTok's Customer Support teams vision is to deliver industry-leading support for our users and creators to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-oriented individual to join the team at the forefront of this mission. title: Concierge Manager
description: Mandarin Oriental, Singapore is looking for a Concierge Manager to join our Concierge team.  Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.  Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.  Mandarin Oriental, Singapore is a sanctuary of luxury and sophistication overlooking the iconic Marina Bay.   About The Job   Based at the Mandarin Oriental, Singapore within the Concierge Department, the Concierge Manager is responsible for the effective and efficient operation of Concierge which includes Porter and Transportation in accordance with the objectives, performance and quality standards established by the hotel. To plan, organize, and motivate all colleagues to excel in delivering Legendary Quality Experience to all guests. The Concierge/Concierge Manager reports to the Director of Rooms. title: Manager, Customer Success
description: Description   Trintech is an award winning AI-driven Fintech SaaS organisation and we are seeking a customer-centric, inspiring, and commercially minded Manager of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Mid-Market & Commercial Customer Success team.  In this role, you will lead a high-performing, geographically distributed team across the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, and Norway, driving customer retention, product adoption, expansion opportunities, and long-term customer success. You'll coach and develop Customer Success Managers while partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Finance to deliver an exceptional customer experience throughout the customer lifecycle.  This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced people leader who is passionate about developing talent, building scalable customer success practices, and delivering measurable business outcomes.   What You'll Do     Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multi-country Customer Success team across the UKI and Nordics, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer obsession.  Drive customer retention, adoption, and expansion by ensuring the team proactively manages customer health, identifies risks, and uncovers growth opportunities.  Coach Customer Success Managers to deliver high-value Success Reviews and Executive Business Reviews (QBRs) that demonstrate business value and strengthen executive relationships.  Establish clear team goals, KPIs, and operational rhythms, monitoring performance against customer health, renewal, NRR, adoption, and customer satisfaction metrics.  Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and development planning to support career growth and build future leadership capability within the team.  Partner closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and drive successful customer outcomes.  Act as an escalation point for complex customer situations, ensuring issues are resolved quickly while maintaining strong customer relationships.  Oversee customer advocacy initiatives, including NPS and reference programs, using customer feedback and insights to continuously improve the customer experience.  Champion the adoption of Customer Success best practices, processes, and playbooks, driving operational excellence and scalability across the team.  Develop a deep understanding of Trintech's products and the Office of the CFO landscape to effectively coach the team and support strategic customer conversations.  Use customer and operational data to identify trends, forecast risk, measure performance, and inform strategic decisions.     Who You Are     5+ years' experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing SaaS environment.  2+ years' experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing Customer Success or Account Manage

title: Customer Protection Manager (소비자보호)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스증권의 Customer Protection Manager (소비자보호매니저) 는 Customer Protection Team (소비자보호팀)에 속해 있어요.  토스증권의 소비자보호팀은 소비자를 보호하기 위한 다양한 활동을 통하여 토스증권의 혁신적인 상품과 서비스가 금융소비자보호법령 하에서 만들어지고 판매될 수 있게 하는 팀이에요.  소비자보호팀은 제품의 개발부터 제품 판매, 제품 판매 후 민원 관리 및 제도 개선에 대한 부분까지 제품의 Life Cycle에 관여하며 소비자에게 더 좋은 제품을 제공하기 위한 업무를 진행하고 있어요.  팀 동료들은 각자의 전문 분야를 바탕으로 공통의 목표를 위해 서로의 경험을 공유하며 협업하고 있어요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요     민원처리 및 민원 예방 활동을 위한 발생 원인 분석과 팀원 교육 및 민원/VOC 처리 프로세스를 수립해요.  다양한 채널에서 수집되는 고객의 소리를 분석하고 사용자들의 개선의견을 바탕으로 더 좋은 제품을 제공할 수 있는 제도 개선 활동을 함께 해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     3년 이상 금융업에서 민원/ VOC에 대한 업무처리 경험이 필요해요.  금융감독원 민원을 처리해본 경험이 필요해요.  회사가 제공하는 다양한 금융상품에 대하여 다양한 의견을 제안해 보신 경험이 필요해요.  다양한 팀과의 협업을 위하여 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 스킬이 필요해요.  고객의 소리를 분석하고 이를 제도개선과 연결해 본 업무 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     증권사 리테일 서비스 및 모바일 비즈니스에 대한 높은 이해도를 바탕으로 다양한 민원/VOC 처리 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해 주세요.  업무 수행 과정에서 상품 판매와 관련된 내부통제 뿐만 아니라 가치를 창출할 수 있도록 프로세스를 개선한 사례가 있다면 개선 내용 및 개선의 효과를 중심으로 상세한 내용을 작성해 주세요.  금융회사에서 소비자보호팀의 역할에 대한 견해를 작성해주시는 것도 좋아요.       토스증권으로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 과제전형 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사       꼭 확인해 주세요     이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스증권 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.       함께할 동료를 위한 한마디   "두근거리는 열정을 찾고자 한다면 용기를 내 합류해 주세요!"    금융시장의 변화를 선도하는 토스증권! 함께한다면 그 변화를 같이 고민하고 토스증권에 금융소비자보호 문화를 정착시키는 선구자의 자부심을 느낄 수 있어요! 두근거리는 열정을 찾고자 한다면 용기를 내 합류해 주세요!  진정한 의미의 금융소비자보호는 고객의 불편함이나 기능 개선 요청을 제품에 빠르게 반영하는 문화에서부터 시작한다고 생각해요. 토스증권은 원팀으로 밀접하게 일하며 이런 문화를 가장 잘 실천하는 회사라고 자부해요.금융투자상품 투자에 있어 고객관점에서의 함께 고민하며 더 혁신적인 제품과 서비스를 만들어가는 여정을 함께 하고 싶어요.      합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요 - 토스증권의 Customer Protection Manager (소비자보호매니저) 는 Customer Protection Team (소비자보호팀)에 속해 있어요. - 토스증권의 소비자보호팀은 소비자를 보호하기 위한 다양한 활동을 통하여 토스증권의 혁신적인 상품과 서비스가 금융소비자보호법령 하에서 만들어지고 판매될 수 있게 하는 팀이에요. - 소비자보호팀은 제품의 개발부터 제품 판매, 제품 판매 후 민원 관리 및 제도 개선에 대한 부분까지 제품의 Life Cycle에 관여하며 소비자에게 더 좋은 제품을 제공하기 위한 업무를 진행하고 있어요. - 팀 동료들은 각자의 전문 분야를 바탕으로 공통의 목표를 위해 서로의 경험을 공유하며 협업하고 있어요. 합류하면 함께할 업무예요 - 민원처리 및 민원 예방 활동을 위한 발생 원인 분석과 팀원 교육 및 민원/VOC 처리 프로세스를 수립해요. - 다양한 채널에서 수집되는 고객의 소리를 분석하고 사용자들의 개선의견을 바탕으로 더 좋은 제품을 제공할 수 있는 제도 개선 활동을 함께 해요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 - 1년 이상 금융업에서 민원/VOC에 대한 업무처리 경험이 필요해요. - 회사가 제공하는 다양한 금융상품에 대하여 다양한 의견을 제안해 보신 경험이 필요해요. - 다양한 팀과의 협업을 위하여 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 스킬이 필요해요. - 금융감독원 민원을 처리해본 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요. - 고객의 소리를 분석하고 이를 제도개선과 연결해 본 업무 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요. 이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요 - 증권사 리테일 서비스 및 모바일 비즈니스에 대한 높은 이해도를 바탕으로 다양한 민원/VOC 처리 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해 주세요. - 업무 수행 과정에서 상품 판매와 관련된 내부통제 뿐만 아니라 가치를 창출할 수 있도록 프로세스를 개선한 사례가 있다면 개선 내용 및 개선의 효과를 중심으로 상세한 내용을 작성해 주세요. - 금융회사에서 소비자보호팀의 역할에 대한 견해를 작성해주시는 것도 좋아요. 토스증권으로의 합류 여정 - 서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사 꼭 확인해 주세요 - 직무 인터뷰 진행 전 사전과제를 요청드리고, 제출하신 사전과제를 바탕으로 인터뷰가 진행될 예정이에요. - 이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. - 토스증권 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. - 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요. 함께할 동료

title: Guest Experience Executive ~ Assistant Manager (Nationality : Chinese)
description: Organization- Park Hyatt Seoul    Summary      BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY WITH PARK HYATT SEOUL      Park Hyatt Seoul  is an art-inspired residential glasshouse hotel where contemporary luxury meets authentic Korean hospitality.  Nestled in the bustling heart of Gangnam, explore an array of entertainment and dining options, or simply unwind while soaking in breathtaking cityscapes. We offer innovative bespoke experiences and attentive service tailored to individual preferences.  Park Hyatt Seoul is renowned for a variety of exquisite dining experiences and exceptional service.   Guest Experience Executive - Assistant Manager    We are seeking unique and passionate individuals to join our team as we continue to provide rate and intimate experiences in the heart of Gangnam.   The Park Hyatt Seoul is looking for  the Guest Experience Executive - Assistant Manager   who will be responsible to assist with the efficient running of the department in line with Hyatt International's Corporate Strategies and brand standards, whilst meeting employee, guest and owner expectations. The Guest Service Manager is responsible To assist the Front Office / Assistant Front Office Manager in managing the guest service department as a successful independent profit center, ensuring maximum guest satisfaction, through planning, organizing, directing and controlling the Concierge operation and administration.   Qualifications      Ideally with a university degree or diploma in Hospitality or Tourism management.    Minimum 2 years work experience as Assistant Director of Rooms or Front Office Manager.    Good problem solving, administrative and interpersonal skills are a must.    Fluent both English and Chinese.    Korean proficiency is a plus, but not required.

title: Customer Experience Leader
description: Lead a customer service culture across all in-store touchpoints, ensuring a consistently positive and customer-focused experience.  Champion exceptional service within the dedicated Service department.  Ensure seamless and positive customer interactions across all eCommerce channels, including in-store support for online activities.     Working with Woolworths Supermarkets New Zealand | Te Mahi ki Woolworths Supermarkets New Zealand   With over 185 stores and 20,000 team members across Aotearoa, we've made it our mission to make Kiwi lives a little better every day.  We're friendly, down-to-earth, and energetic - we work hard but we have a great time doing it, and we love what we do. There is plenty of scope for new ideas, lots of room for you to add value, and importantly, you'll be working with a business that touches the lives of three million New Zealanders a week.  We embrace diversity of thought and love to take on challenges with a pragmatic and innovative approach. Our culture thrives on mutual respect, care, curiosity, openness, and a proactive attitude. We continually seek ways to pair, collaborate, support, and learn from each other as a team!   What you'll do | Hei mahi     Lead all aspects of the Service Department's daily operations, including cash management, cleanliness, and presentation of key customer-facing areas.  Oversee the accurate and timely fulfillment of online orders, ensuring freshness and meeting customer expectations.  Continuously monitor and improve customer satisfaction by analysing service metrics, gathering feedback, and resolving escalated issues.  Conduct regular performance health checks and identify areas for improvement within the department's functions.  Provide leadership support to the store, stepping in as Acting Store Manager when scheduled, and actively participating in team collaboration initiatives.     What you’ll bring | Hei koha     Adept at problem-solving and critical thinking, you also excel at establishing and maintaining collaborative partnerships across various functions and with stakeholders.  A strong and effective leader, you're skilled in delegation, progress monitoring, coaching, and providing constructive feedback to motivate your team.  You possess exceptional communication skills, clearly articulating tasks, timelines, responsibilities, and performance standards.  You can interpret insights and action data effectively, demonstrating a commitment to responsibility and accountability for timely and accurate delivery of work objectives.  Your behaviours consistently align with company values. Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. description:
Want to shape the future of renewable energy? Your ideas matter here. We are building the operating system for renewable energy and simplify the management of energy assets with Amperecloud Platform – for a world where green energy drives growth.

Your first PR ships in week one.

title: Quality Engineering – Automation (Playwright & GenAI)
description: Position Description  We are looking for a Quality Engineering – Automation professional with strong hands-on experience in modern test automation. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring four days per week onsite at our/client's office in downtown Toronto.  The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and enhancing automation frameworks using Playwright. The candidate should also have experience leveraging AI/GenAI tools to generate test cases, identify test scenarios, improve test coverage, and accelerate automation development.  Your future duties and responsibilities     Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable Playwright-based automation frameworks, preferably using TypeScript/JavaScript.   Create automated tests for functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.   Apply automation design practices such as Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, fixtures, data-driven testing, and parallel execution.   Use AI/GenAI tools to generate and enhance test cases and test scenarios, identify edge cases, and improve overall test coverage.   Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar GenAI solutions to assist with automation code development, debugging, test-data generation, and optimization.   Review and validate AI-generated test cases and automation code before implementation.   Integrate Playwright automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.   Perform API testing using Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or comparable tools, as well as SQL-based backend and test-data validation.   Execute smoke, functional, regression, integration, system, UAT, end-to-end, and cross-browser testing.   Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other Quality Engineering professionals in an Agile environment; analyze defects, document test results, contribute to quality metrics and release-readiness activities, and follow coding standards, automation best practices, and quality engineering principles.     Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role   Must-have:     3–5+ years of hands-on Quality Engineering / test automation experience.   Strong recent hands-on experience with Playwright automation.   Demonstrated ability to develop, enhance, and maintain Playwright automation frameworks, rather than only execute existing automated tests.   Experience using TypeScript/JavaScript for Playwright automation.   Strong understanding of automation framework concepts, including POM, fixtures, reusable components, data-driven testing, and test reporting. Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: Test Automation Engineer
description: Vill du ta din erfarenhet inom testautomation till nästa nivå och vara med och kvalitetssäkra framtidens fordon? DXC/Luxoft söker nu, tillsammans med Oddwork, en Test Automation Engineer som vill bli en del av deras växande team i Sverige.      Om DXC/Luxoft   DXC Luxoft är ett globalt mjukvaru- och teknikbolag som levererar lösningar inom bland annat automotive, finans och digital transformation. Inom Automotive samarbetar de med några av världens ledande fordonstillverkare och leverantörer och är särskilt kända för sin expertis inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Verksamheten i Sverige fortsätter att växa och här får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett internationellt team som utvecklar och kvalitetssäkrar nästa generations system för en fordonsindustri där uppkopplade, autonoma och elektrifierade fordon står i centrum.      Om rollen   Som Test Automation Engineer kommer du att spela en viktig roll i utvecklingen och kvalitetssäkringen av komplexa embedded- och infotainmentsystem inom automotive. Du kommer att utveckla, underhålla och köra automatiserade tester med Python och PyTest samt arbeta med funktionella tester, enhetstester och regressionstester.  En central del av rollen är att integrera automatiserade testsviter i CI/CD-pipelines och säkerställa smidiga testkörningar, uppföljning och rapportering. Du arbetar i Linux-miljö och använder verktyg som Git, Gerrit och Jenkins för versionshantering, code reviews och automatiserade processer.  Du kommer även att arbeta med kommunikationsprotokoll inom automotive, såsom CAN och Ethernet, samt verktyg som CANoe, CANalyzer och CAPL för simulering och analys. Tillsammans med utvecklingsteam som arbetar inom områden som Android Automotive OS bidrar du till att säkerställa hög kvalitet och stabilitet genom hela produktens utvecklingscykel.  Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar där du identifierar och löser problem, utvecklar teststrategier och kontinuerligt förbättrar automatiserade testramverk för att öka testtäckning, effektivitet och den övergripande produktkvaliteten.      Vi söker dig som    Har erfarenhet av testautomation och utveckling av automatiserade tester.  Har goda kunskaper i Python, gärna med erfarenhet av PyTest.  Har erfarenhet av enhetstestning, funktionell testning och regressionstestning.  Har förståelse för CI/CD och hur automatiserade tester integreras i pipelines.  Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Git, Gerrit och Jenkins.  Är van vid att arbeta i Linux-miljö.  Har kunskap om infotainment och embedded systems.  Har kunskap om kommunikationsprotokoll inom automotive, såsom CAN och Ethernet.  Har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om CANoe, CANalyzer och CAPL.  Har en kandidatexamen inom Computer Science, Electrical Engineering eller motsvarande relevant område.  Har god analytisk förmåga och trivs med felsökning och problemlösning.  Är strukturerad, noggrann och van vid att ta ansvar för kvalitet och leverans.  Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.  Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.  Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.  Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: QA Manager
description: 토스인컴을 소개해요     토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요.  토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요.  토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요.  토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요     맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요.  PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요.  신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요.  서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요.  필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요.  세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  제품 팀과 협업하며 여러 프로젝트의 일정과 테스트 커버리지를 효율적으로 관리해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA 프로세스를 구축하고 개선한 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.        이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     QA로서 본인이 기여하고 집중한 부분과 성과(또는 실패 이후의 개선 사례)를 알고 싶어요.  빠른 개발/배포 사이클 속에서 QA를 수행해보신 경험이 있다면 작성해 주세요.  다양한 기술 스택을 활용 했다면, 해당 기술을 실제 QA에 어떻게 활용했는지 작성해 주세요.  포트폴리오를 같이 제출하시는 경우 현/전 직장의 대외비(테스트 케이스)는 첨부하지 말아주세요.       토스인컴으로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격  직무 인터뷰 전형에는 '라이브 과제'가 함께 진행됩니다. 약 50분 동안 화상 인터뷰 툴을 이용하여 수행하시게 됩니다.        함께할 동료를 위한 한마디     “토스인컴 서비스의 신뢰를 보증한다.”  토스인컴의 QA는 단순히 버그를 찾는 역할을 넘어, 사용자가 안심하고 세무/소득 서비스를 이용할 수 있는 ‘신뢰’ 자체를 설계해요.  “원래 이렇게 테스트해왔으니까”에 머무르지 않고, 새로운 방식의 테스트, 자동화, 툴 도입 등을 자유롭게 제안하고 시도할 수 있어요.  돈과 세금이라는 도메인 특성상 작은 실수도 크게 느껴질 수 있기 때문에, 토스인컴에서 QA의 역할과 임팩트는 더욱 크게 드러나요.  토스인컴에서 품질과 신뢰에 대한 새로운 기준을 함께 만들어갈 분을 기다리고 있어요.      📢 소득 그리고 세금 환급과 관련된 모든 불합리함과 불편함을 해소해 나갑니다. >혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여온 토스처럼, '숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 도전하고 싶으신가요? >누구나 손쉽게 앱 하나로 세무 문제를 해결하는 미래를 상상해보세요. >초기 멤버로 팀의 성장과 혁신의 중심이 되고싶다면, ‘토스인컴’에 지원해보세요. >토스의 가장 신생 계열사인 토스인컴의 초기멤버로 합류하실 수 있는 기회를 놓치지 마세요. ########토스인컴을 소개해요 - 토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요. - 토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요. - 토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요. - 토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요. 합류하면 함께할 업무예요 - 맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요. - PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요. - 신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요. - 서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요. - 필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요. - 세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 - QA 관련 경험이 7년 이상이신 분이면 좋아요. - 제품 단위를 넘어 조직 전체의 QA 프로세스를 설계하고 운영해보신 분이 필요해요. - 복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요. - 배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA

title: [EnIT] IT Architect - Application Architect
description: 📃 누구나 마음 속에 이력서 한 장은 있으니까,  ⚡ 1분 컷 지원으로 현대오토에버로의 여정을 시작하세요. (이력서 자율양식)   ✅ IT Architect - Application Architect   🚀  합류하실 팀을 소개해요     기준정보시스템팀은 완성차 생산을 위한 CORE 정보인 BOM/Master Data/생기정보 등 기준정보를 관리하는 시스템을 개발/운영하는 팀입니다. 우리 팀은    기준정보의 무결성을 통해 완성차 전사시스템의 안정성 확보   IT 핵심역량을 보유한 최고의 전문가   긍정적/능동적인 마음가짐으로 행복한 직장생활 추구    라는 3대 목표를 가지고, 일과 삶에서 최선을 다해 행복을 추구하고자 노력하는 팀입니다!!  팀 내 운영 시스템은 RDBMS/X-FRAMEWORK 기반에 마이플랫폼으로 구현되어있으나, 현재 오픈소스기반 차세대 플랫폼을 준비하고 있어 팀 내 신기술 역량향상을 기대하고 있습니다.  💻  합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요     애플리케이션 설계 및 아키텍처 정의  API 아키텍처 설계  성능, 확장성, 보안을 고려한 설계  개발팀과 협력하여 기술 문제 해결  코드 리뷰 및 기술 표준 수립     🔍 이런 분과 함께 하고 싶어요     Java/Spring 기반 10년 이상 개발 경력  시스템 아키텍처 설계 경험 3회 이상  최근 2년 이내 본인이 직접 설계·구현한 프로덕션 코드 실적 보유    (PL/Architect 역할 수행 중에도 핵심 모듈 직접 구현 및 프로젝트 전 기간 상시 코드 리뷰·페어 프로그래밍 수행 필수)    코드 리뷰 문화를 직접 운영/정착시켜 본 경험  배치, 연동(ERP/MES/PLM 등 외부 시스템), API 설계 및 개발 경험  성능, 확장성, 장애 대응을 고려한 비기능 요구사항(NFR) 설계 경험  SOA 혹은 MSA 기반의 시스템 구축 경험    #시스템 구조 분석/설계 방법론 #아키텍처 이해 #아키텍처 구현/관리   🔍 이런 분이라면 더욱 좋아요     대용량 BOM 데이터(트리 구조, 버전 관리, 이력 추적) 처리를 고려한 DB/트랜잭션 설계 경험  Full stack 개발자  Oracle / MySql 기반의 DB 운영 경험     ⌛ 이렇게 합류해요     서류 접수 → 서류 검토 → 직무역량테스트(과제테스트) 및 인성검사 → 1차면접 → 2차면접     → 처우협의 및 채용검진 → 최종 합격🎉  ※ 상기 직무역량테스트 外 추가 역량평가가 진행될 수 있으며, 해당 결과는 종합적인 역량 검토를 위한 참고자료로 활용됩니다.    📍 만나게 될 근무지는 여기예요     서울 강남     📣 동료의 한 마디     안녕하세요, 기준정보시스템팀 A책임입니다! 우리 팀은 활발한 커뮤니케이션과 수평적 문화가 특징이에요. 팀원 개인 의견을 서로 존중하며 편안한 분위기 속에 개인의 역량이 최대로 발휘하여 개인과 조직의 성장을 함께 하고 있어요. 또한 업무에 필요한 역량 교육을 권장하는 문화 및 제도가 잘 마련되어 이를 업무에도 적극 활용하여 정체되지 않고 성장할 수 있답니다. 가끔은 팀원들과 같이 인근 산책 및 티타임을 하면서 좀 더 자유로운 의견 교류와 함께 서로에게 힘이 되어주고 격려하고 있어요. 우리 팀과 함께 하고 싶은 분들은 언제나 환영이니 많이 지원해 주세요 :)  (팀 리더) 기준정보시스템팀은 밝고 긍정적인 에너지로 채워진 기술/업무 전문가들로 구성되어 있으며, 많은 경력의 선배들이 후배들의 기술/업무 역량 향상을 위해 적극적으로 지원하는 팀입니다. 팀 내 주요 업무인 BOM/MDM/생기 정보는 완성차 근간에 CORE로 사용되는 정보로써 완성차 연구소/생산/판매등 다양한 부문과 인터페이스되며 전반적인 업무 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 우리 팀에 합류한다면 기술개발 뿐만 아니라, 완성차 기준정보 전문가로 발전하여 각 영역에서 활약하는 리더로서 성장 가능합니다.    📌  참고해 주세요     채용 시 마감되는 상시 채용 공고로 운영되며, 채용 절차와 일정은 변동될 수 있어요.  사회적 배려 대상자(보훈 취업지원대상자, 장애인)는 관계 법령과 내규에 따라 우대해요.  모집 분야 및 담당 업무에 따라 영어 구술평가, 레퍼런스 체크, 또는 기타 전형이 실시될 수 있어요.  지원자의 경험과 역량을 고려하여 다른 포지션이 더 적합하다고 판단되는 경우 지원 분야가 변경될 수 있어요.  배치 부서 및 근무지는 회사 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있어요.  아래의 경우, 합격이 취소되거나 전형 진행에서 불이익을 받으실 수 있어요.  지원서가 사실과 다르거나 증빙이 불가할 경우  해외여행 결격 사유가 있는 경우 (남성의 경우, 회사가 지정한 입사일까지 병역 필 또는 면제 필요)  최종 합격 후 회사가 지정하는 입사일에 입사 불가한 경우

title: QA Lead with Spanish (Madrid)
description: About the role:      We are looking for an experienced QA leader with deep testing expertise and the credibility to lead the QA function effectively in a complex project environment. You understand QA best practices, manage client expectations confidently, and provide strong people leadership. You are able to build trust with clients and colleagues, develop team capabilities, and establish a high-performing and scalable QA organisation.  You will:   Lead the QA function within the project environment, ensuring a strong, credible, and effective quality organisation.  Define and drive the QA strategy, test approach, governance, and quality standards across the project lifecycle.  Act as the main QA counterpart for clients, managing expectations, building trust, and providing clear quality leadership.  Lead, mentor, and develop QA team members, helping raise capability, confidence, and overall team maturity.  Build strong collaboration across business, delivery, and technical teams to embed quality throughout the delivery process.  Oversee test planning, execution, defect management, reporting, and quality risk management.  Ensure the QA area is not only operationally effective, but also seen as a trusted and value-adding function by both client and internal stakeholders.  Support UAT and coordinate with client stakeholders where needed, while maintaining ownership of the broader QA direction. Søk med CV og noen ord om hvorfor – vi vurderer søkere fortløpende.

description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요    토스플레이스 Technical Account Manager는 고객사의 요구와 상황에 최적화된 결제 시스템 연동을 지원하며 기술적 이슈 해결 및 전문 컨설팅을 통해 고객에게 안정감과 신뢰를 제공해요.  이용 중인 가맹점에서 발생하는 문제에 대해 기술적으로 분석하고 검증하며 이를 바탕으로 실질적인 해결 방안을 가맹점과 함께 논의해요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요    필요한 절차를 단계별로 설계 및 조율하며 파트너사와의 원활한 기술 협업을 통해 결제 연동을 성공적으로 끌어내고 있어요.  단순히 문제만 해결하는 것이 아닌 고객사의 의견을 들으며 필요 사항을 진단하여 제품 팀과 함께 전체적인 서비스를 개선해요.  불필요한 의사결정 단계를 지양하며 가맹점 연동에 필요한 기술 지원 및 커뮤니케이션에 집중하여 문제 해결의 실효성을 높이고 있어요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    새로운 기술에 대한 높은 관심과 학습 의지를 바탕으로 변화하는 기술 환경에 능동적으로 대응할 수 있는 분이면 좋아요.  고객사의 개발자와 깊이 있게 소통하고 기술적 문제를 빠르게 분석하여 해결하기 위한 방법을 쉽게 잘 설명해 주실 수 있는 분이 필요해요.  직면한 문제를 끝까지 풀어내는 끈기가 있는 분, 특히 팀으로 함께 문제를 해결해 나가는 과정을 즐기는 분이면 좋아요.  기술 파트너로서 고객과의 협업을 주도할 수 있도록 다양한 기술을 비즈니스 맥락에서 유연하게 적용해 본 경험이 있으면 좋아요.  VAN/간편결제사 등 결제사 경험이 있으시다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요    최신 개발 기술에 대해 경험해 보셨거나 프로젝트에 적용한 이력이 있으시다면 자세히 기술해 주세요.  직접 참여한 프로젝트의 기간, 역할, 기술 스택, 주요 기여 내용, 프로젝트 이후의 개선 효과 등을 중심으로 본인의 구체적인 기여도를 상세히 기술해 주세요.  경험했던 내용이 꼭 성공한 프로젝트 일 필요는 없어요. 최대한 많은 경험을 알려주세요.       토스플레이스로의 합류여정    서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사
