title: Customer Service Manager
description: Functieprofiel    Als  Customer Service Manager  bij  PTH Global  ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere ontwikkeling van de internationale Customer Service-afdeling. Vanuit Zwolle ondersteunt het team klanten van de merken VONROC, FERM, Blue Home en Waterocx in heel Europa, variërend van consumenten tot webshops, retailers en marketplaces.     De organisatie bevindt zich in een sterke groeifase. Niet alleen groeit het aantal producten en klanten, ook de verwachtingen rondom dienstverlening nemen toe. Klantbeleving is daarom een strategisch speerpunt binnen PTH Global. De Customer Service Manager speelt hierin een centrale rol door processen, mensen en prestaties continu verder te ontwikkelen.     Binnen PTH Global wordt gewerkt vanuit de overtuiging dat een uitstekend product pas echt onderscheidend wordt wanneer de totale klantbeleving klopt. Customer Service is hierin veel meer dan een operationele afdeling; het vormt een belangrijke schakel tussen de organisatie en de klant en levert waardevolle inzichten voor de verdere ontwikkeling van producten, processen en dienstverlening.     De Customer Service Manager geeft leiding aan een internationaal Customer Service-team van 20 medewerkers. De nadruk ligt daarbij niet alleen op het realiseren van operationele doelstellingen, maar juist ook op het ontwikkelen van medewerkers, het verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van een klantgerichte cultuur.     De rol vraagt om een leidinggevende die overzicht weet te combineren met betrokkenheid. Iemand die zichtbaar is op de werkvloer, eigenaarschap stimuleert en samen met het team bouwt aan een afdeling die klaar is voor de volgende groeifase. Je weet structuur aan te brengen, bent analytisch sterk en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.       Daarnaast ben je zichtbaar binnen de organisatie, maak je gemakkelijk contact en weet je medewerkers mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je hebt oog voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen en ziet technologische innovaties, waaronder AI, als een kans om de dienstverlening verder te verbeter

title: Responsable de la réussite client
description: Pour la version anglaise de cette description de poste, veuillez consulter le lien suivant / For the English version of this job description, please refer to the following link :     https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/appdirect/jobs/8737473002    À propos d’AppDirecte   Devenez un citoyen du monde à l’ère numérique et outillez une nouvelle génération d’entrepreneurs branchés aux quatre coins du globe. AppDirecte offre une plateforme d’abonnement permettant de vendre n’importe quel produit en tant que service, et ce, par n’importe quel canal et sur n’importe quel appareil. Nous alimentons des millions d’abonnements pour le compte d’organisations de partout dans le monde. Notre action est toujours guidée par nos valeurs et notre culture – une culture qui vous permet d’être vu, de rester authentique et d’exceller.   Votre profil   Devs.AI est une initiative stratégique d’AppDirect dédiée à créer la prochaine génération d'outils d'entreprise basés sur l'IA. Nous cherchons à combler notre tout premier poste de responsable de la réussite client, mais rassurez-vous, vous n'aurez pas à tout construire de zéro. AppDirect dispose déjà d'une infrastructure de soutien éprouvée (Zendesk), d'une équipe de soutien interne de niveaux 1, 2 et 3, et d’ententes de niveau de service établies. Votre rôle consistera donc à mobiliser ces ressources pour Devs.AI tout en étant responsable de la fonction de réussite client. Votre accorderez la plus grande priorité à nos principaux comptes stratégiques, en agissant comme partenaire de confiance pour favoriser l'adoption, s’assurer que la plateforme est utilisée à son plein potentiel et développer la relation au fil du temps. Vous superviserez également l'expérience de soutien pour les clients de Devs.AI, en collaborant avec les équipes de soutien internes d'AppDirect et en intervenant vous-même au besoin. Il s’agit d’un poste de type « couteau suisse » : en l’espace de quelques heures, vous pourriez passer d’une revue trimestrielle du rendement auprès d’un client clé, pour ensuite peaufiner une entente de niveau de service pour Devs.ai et finalement traiter un ticket de soutien dans Zendesk.   Ce que vous ferez et ce qui vous fera briller    Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie après-vente des comptes stratégiques : intégration, adoption, renouvellement et expansion.  Agir comme principal interlocuteur auprès de nos plus grands clients, notamment en organisant des revues trimestrielles de performance (QBR), en faisant des mises au point régulières avec la direction et en élaborant des plans de réussite.  Optimiser la rétention du chiffre d’affaires en générant des ventes additionnelles, des ventes croisées et une adoption approfondie du produit.  Superviser l’expérience de soutien pour Devs.ai, en collaboration avec les équipes de soutien de niveau 1/2/3 d’AppDirect.  Peaufiner et appliquer des ententes de niveau de service adaptées spécifiquement aux clients de Devs.ai, en adaptant le cadre existant d’AppDirect.  Travailler

title: Client Solutions Manager
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요   토스의 Client Solutions Manager는 광고사업부에 속해 있어요.  광고사업부는 동영상 광고, 배너광고 등 토스라는 플랫폼을 활용한 광고 사업을 담당합니다.  광고사업부는 다양한 광고 및 제휴 상품을 담당하면서, 광고주 대상 프로모션 전략과 다양한 혜택 기획, 수수료 협상 등 광고 사업에 관련한 모든 전략적인 의사결정을 이끌고 있어요.  광고사업부의 목표는 지속적으로 고객사의 토스 광고 상품 집행을 통해 매출을 증대시켜 나가면서, 동시에 토스와 고객사의 동반 성장을 도모하는 것이에요.   합류하면 함께 할 업무에요   주요 고객의 마케팅 목적과 캠페인 KPI에 맞추어, 토스의 광고 제품을 활용한 최적화 솔루션을 제안해요.  고객의 성공을 위한 데이터를 분석하고, 장기적으로 토스를 활용할 수 있는 전략을 수립해요.  Data Analyst와 협업하여 데이터 기반의 전략 솔루션을 개발하고, 고객에게 효과적으로 컨설팅해요.  토스의 광고 제품을 잘 활용할 수 있도록 고객들에게 토스 활용에 대한 Best Practice를 제안하고 실행해요.  트렌드를 반영한 새로운 광고 활용 방안을 발굴하고, 토스를 통해 성장할 수 있도록 지원해요.  토스의 고객들과 지속적인 피드백과 성과 리뷰를 통해 관계를 강화하고, 파트너십을 증진시켜요.   이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요   광고 산업에 대한 이해도가 높고, 광고/마케팅 경험이 5년 이상 필요합니다.  광고 분야에서 전략 수립과 업셀링을 통해 성과와 매출을 만들어본 경험이 있으면 더욱 좋습니다.  커뮤니케이션 역량이 뛰어나며 대외적 마케팅 및 홍보 활동 경험을 해보신 분이면 좋습니다.  데이터 분석 및 이해도를 바탕으로 업무를 수행하시고, 전략적 사고를 통한 문제 해결 경험이 있으신 분을 찾습니다.   이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요   성과를 내기 위해서 본인이 주도적으로 진행해 보신 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 적어주세요.  데이터 기반의 최적화 솔루션 제안을 통해 달성하신 수치적인 성과(예산 증액 등)가 있다면 구체적으로 적어주세요.   토스로의 합류여정   서류접수 > 전화인터뷰 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사   함께할 동료를 위한 한마디  “주도적이고 성장을 추구하는 역량 있는 분들을 환영합니다!!”

title: VIP Relationship Manager
description: About Gate   Founded in 2013, Gate is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving 50M+ users with a full suite of digital asset trading and wealth management services — ranked #3 globally among all exchanges. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team building the future of Web3 through innovation, collaboration, and speed. At Gate, we welcome everyone who dares to innovate, actively shares ideas, and grows alongside a fast-scaling global business.     Join us to help shape the future of crypto. 🚀      Why This Role Exists   Our VIP clients are among the most valuable relationships Gate has — and the bar for how we serve them needs to match that. As VIP trading volumes grow and client expectations become more sophisticated, we need someone fully dedicated to making sure our highest-tier users feel seen, prioritized, and well-served. This role exists to own that experience end to end: not just responding to requests, but building the systems and habits that turn VIP relationships into long-term loyalty.      What You'll Own    Be the primary point of contact for existing high-tier VIP clients — handling daily inquiries, resolving complex issues, and coordinating internal teams to ensure fast, quality responses.  Run a structured feedback loop: regularly gather client input on products and events, submit findings to relevant teams, and track improvements through to completion.  Drive engagement by introducing clients to platform features, promotions, and online/offline events that match their interests and trading behavior.  Build and maintain full-lifecycle relationship management practices — birthday touchpoints, holiday greetings, exclusive event invitations, and proactive outreach.  Monitor client asset levels and tier status closely; identify early signs of disengagement and act on retention before churn happens.       Who We're Looking For    Fluent in both Chinese and English — you'll be working across Chinese-speaking and global client bases daily. A strong command of Korean as a third language is a significant advantage.  2+ years of relevant experience in client relationship management, private banking, brokerage, or a similar high-touch service role.  Comfortable in the crypto and Web3 space — you understand exchanges, trading products, and the expectations that come with managing high-value crypto clients.  Experience hosting or supporting offline events and client presentations is a plus.  Willing and able to travel for business when needed.  Detail-oriented, proactive, and calm under pressure — you can manage multiple client relationships simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.       Nice to Have    Background in private banking, wealth management, or VIP client services at a financial institution or exchange.  Experience with crypto-native communities — candidates from outside the industry are welcome if they have direct crypto exposure or personal engagement with the space.  Familiarity with CRM tool

Tässä roolissa pääset johtamaan ja valmentamaan tiimiäsi arjen työssä sekä varmistamaan, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta, sujuvaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä palvelua jokaisella asiointikerralla.  Team Leadina toimit osana tavaratalon arkea ja vastaat omalta osaltasi myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja päivittäisten toimintojen sujuvuudesta. Rooli voi painottua esimerkiksi myymälän, kassan, asiakaspalvelun tai varaosamyynnin ja autoilun tuoteryhmien pariin valittavan henkilön osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vahvuuksien mukaan. Tärkeintä on, että sinulta löytyy aikaisempaa esihenkilökokemusta, kaupallista ajattelua ja halua saada tiimi onnistumaan.  🤝 Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen  👍 Työn luonteen vuoksi hakijoilta edellytetään 18 vuoden ikää  💰 Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan. Palkka määräytyy tehtävään valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.  Työssäsi johdat tiimiäsi valmentavalla otteella, tuet tiimiläisten osaamisen kehittymistä ja varmistat, että ketjuohjeistusten mukainen toiminta toteutuu arjessa. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua muun muassa myymälän yleiskunnosta ja esillepanoista huolehtimista, kampanjoiden, hinta- ja hyllymuutosten sekä sesonkivaihtojen toteutuksen varmistamista, kassatoimintojen ja rahaliikenteen sujuvuuden tukemista sekä varaosa- ja autoilumyynnin päivittäisten toimintojen edistämistä.  Team Lead osallistuu myös tavaratalon työhön kaikissa vuoroissa, ja tehtävään kuuluu joustavasti myös muita tavaratalon tehtäviä. Arjessa olet mukana asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityössä, toimit esimerkkinä tiimillesi ja huolehdit siitä, että tekemisessä näkyvät hyvä palveluasenne, aktiivinen myynti ja halu tehdä kauppaa.  Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sytyt myynnistä, asiakaskohtaamisista ja tiimin valmentamisesta. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy kaupallista nälkää, myynnillistä pilkettä silmäkulmassa ja aitoa halua kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi tekemistä. title: VIP Relationship Manager
description: About Gate   Founded in 2013, Gate is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving 50M+ users with a full suite of digital asset trading and wealth management services — ranked #3 globally among all exchanges. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team building the future of Web3 through innovation, collaboration, and speed. At Gate, we welcome everyone who dares to innovate, actively shares ideas, and grows alongside a fast-scaling global business.     Join us to help shape the future of crypto. 🚀      Why This Role Exists   Our VIP clients are among the most valuable relationships Gate has — and the bar for how we serve them needs to match that. As VIP trading volumes grow and client expectations become more sophisticated, we need someone fully dedicated to making sure our highest-tier users feel seen, prioritized, and well-served. This role exists to own that experience end to end: not just responding to requests, but building the systems and habits that turn VIP relationships into long-term loyalty.      What You'll Own    Be the primary point of contact for existing high-tier VIP clients — handling daily inquiries, resolving complex issues, and coordinating internal teams to ensure fast, quality responses.  Run a structured feedback loop: regularly gather client input on products and events, submit findings to relevant teams, and track improvements through to completion.  Drive engagement by introducing clients to platform features, promotions, and online/offline events that match their interests and trading behavior.  Build and maintain full-lifecycle relationship management practices — birthday touchpoints, holiday greetings, exclusive event invitations, and proactive outreach.  Monitor client asset levels and tier status closely; identify early signs of disengagement and act on retention before churn happens.       Who We're Looking For    Fluent in both Chinese and English — you'll be working across Chinese-speaking and global client bases daily. A strong command of Korean as a third language is a significant advantage.  2+ years of relevant experience in client relationship management, private banking, brokerage, or a similar high-touch service role.  Comfortable in the crypto and Web3 space — you understand exchanges, trading products, and the expectations that come with managing high-value crypto clients.  Experience hosting or supporting offline events and client presentations is a plus.  Willing and able to travel for business when needed.  Detail-oriented, proactive, and calm under pressure — you can manage multiple client relationships simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.       Nice to Have    Background in private banking, wealth management, or VIP client services at a financial institution or exchange.  Experience with crypto-native communities — candidates from outside the industry are welcome if they have direct crypto exposure or personal engagement with the space.  Familiarity with CRM tool

title: Senior Account Manager
description: Senior Account Manager. Stockholm, or remote on European hours.      Most account management in payments is waiting. You take the call, you scope the flows, then you wait two weeks for someone else to tell you what it costs. Habit, not necessity.      At Crosswire you price it on the call.  Same engine that runs the public calculator, no permission needed, no thread. The client has an offer the same day, and your week goes on the part that matters - whether the stack fits what they actually do.      The job:      Take a merchant or platform from first conversation to live. Understand the flows - where money comes in, where it goes out, what settles when. Match them to rails that will accept their vertical. Build the offer, walk them through it, hand them into onboarding, then keep the relationship.      Who it suits:   You've sold or managed payments infrastructure for a few years. You can hold your own on SEPA, SWIFT, IBANs, on and off ramps, settlement timing and why prefunding hurts. Crypto, iGaming, forex and the verticals most acquirers decline don't scare you, and you know why they decline them.      What this is not:   There is no SDR team feeding you meetings and no brand pulling inbound. There is an AI/ML PhD an Integrations Manager, a Chief Legal Officer and me, a pipeline, a network of licensed partners and a lot still to build. You would be the first commercial hire, which means you get to write the playbook and live with the mess of writing it.      If that reads like your kind of problem, message me.    Tell me about a deal you lost and what you would do differently.      crosswirepay.com

title: Key account manager
description: Menneskene er selve DNA-et i DNB. Siden 1822 har kloke hoder jobbet sammen for å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre. I dag er DNB mye mer enn Norges største bank – vi er en teknologidrevet finansinstitusjon som på stadig nye måter knytter mennesker og ideer til kunnskap og kapital.    Mangfoldig er noe vi er, og inkluderende er noe vi hver dag velger å være. Vi gir rom for deg og dine tanker, og vi lover å gjøre vårt aller beste for at du skal føle deg hjemme hos oss. En jobb i Norges største finanskonsern byr på faglige utfordringer i et spennende arbeidsmiljø med mange muligheter. Gjennom ansatte med ulik kompetanse og bakgrunn kan vi sammen skape en attraktiv og fleksibel organisasjon, tilrettelagt for utvikling og endring.    Key Account Manager – Vestland – Mobility Finance   Mobility Finance Norge er DNB Finans' område for bil- og mobilitetsfinansiering.  Vi søker en Key Account Manager med bosted i Bergen eller nærområdet. Ansvarsområdet omfatter forhandlersamarbeid i region Vestland med utgangspunkt i Bergen, med justeringer etter behov og kundestruktur.  Motiveres du av å bygge sterke relasjoner og skape resultater, kan dette være stillingen for deg. Som Key Account Manager blir du en del av et landsdekkende team med 22 dyktige kolleger. Vi jobber målrettet hver dag, både internt og sammen med vårt brede nettverk av bilprodusenter, bilimportører og bilforhandlere.  Mobility Finance Norge er kjent som en innovativ og tydelig aktør i bransjen, med moderne digitale løsninger og høy faglig kompetanse. Vi mener at kombinasjonen av teknologi, innsikt og mennesker er avgjørende for å lykkes.  I DNB Finans jobber vi for å sette kunden først og finne de beste løsningene sammen. Målet er å være en foretrukket samarbeidspartner for bilprodusenter, bilimportører og bilforhandlere. Kundeorientering, ansvarlighet, gjennomføringsevne og godt samarbeid er viktige verdier i vår hverdag, og vi ser etter deg som kjenner deg igjen i dette.  Stillingen passer for deg som trives med en variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag, og som jobber strukturert og målrettet. Det er en stor fordel at du er komfortabel med å holde presentasjoner, siden dette er en sentral del av arbeidet. This newly created opportunity sits at the heart of LHG's commitment to delivering exceptional experiences for residents, clients and their families. Reporting to the General Manager, Marketing and Communications, the Manager, Customer Experience (CX) will lead the development of LHG's CX strategy and framework, strengthening how the organisation listens to, understands and responds to customer needs while identifying opportunities to improve experiences across the customer journey. Key responsibilities include:      leading the development and evolution of LHG's CX strategy, Voice of Customer framework and service excellence approach;  mapping and improving customer journeys across Residential Care, Home and Community Support and Retirement Living services;  partnering with operational and clinical teams to enhance enquiry management, customer outcomes and conversion to admission;  leading customer feedback, complaints and compliments processes, ensuring concerns are addressed with empathy and insights drive improvement;  analysing customer insights, satisfaction measures and service data to identify trends, prioritise opportunities and inform decision making;  building organisational capability in customer experience, strengthening CRM utilisation and promoting a person-centred, values-based culture.      You will bring a track record of improving customer journeys, driving service excellence and managing sensitive customer interactions. Applicants with experience drawn from aged care, health, community services, member-based or comparable sectors with a strong focus on customer insight, service excellence and customer outcomes are encouraged to apply. You may have held a dedicated CX role or driven customer experience initiatives as part of a broader role scope. Most importantly, you will bring genuine empathy, highly developed stakeholder engagement skills and a passion for improving the experiences of older Australians in our community.     LHG offers a flexible and supportive work environment, genuine opportunities for growth, employee wellbeing initiatives and attractive salary packaging and staff benefits.       Don’t miss this outstanding opportunity to shape how older Australians, their families and carers experience care and support across a growing and values-driven organisation. title: Customer Solution Lead

title: Member Services Manager
description: About CoramBAAF    CoramBAAF  is the UK’s leading membership organisation for professionals working across adoption, fostering and kinship care. We provide information, best practice guidance, advice, training and resources to support our members and influence policy to improve outcomes for children and young people.  Our corporate members in England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland represent 94% of all local authorities as well as regional adoption agencies, health and social care trusts, independent fostering providers and voluntary adoption agencies, and cover 88% of all children and family social workers.  Our 600+ individual and associate members - comprising lawyers, health professionals, educational institutions, therapeutic and family support services, and more - reflect the multidisciplinary nature of our work.     Together, our members make up the largest network of organisations and individuals involved with children in their journey through the care system.      About the role   CoramBAAF’s membership is central to the organisation’s aims and activities. The  Member Services Team  provides a comprehensive service to corporate, associate and individual members and customers in all four nations of the UK. The team manages and tracks member renewals, enrols new members, implements recruitment and retention strategies, co-ordinates service delivery to members and handles a wide range of membership enquiries.     The team is also responsible for the licensing of CoramBAAF’s health and social work report forms, essential to practice in adoption, fostering, kinship care and other substitute care UK-wide. Activities to support the licence scheme include managing and tracking licence renewals, coordinating the release of new and updated forms, enrolling new licence holders and handling a wide range of queries.      The Member Services Manager  will provide leadership and line management across both membership and the forms licence scheme. The postholder will maximise income from CoramBAAF membership and ensure its continued reach and relevance. They will also maximise income from the forms licence scheme and actively promote its importance as a key member benefit. Importantly they will strengthen engagement with members to ensure retention whilst also increasing reach and awareness nationally to recruit new members.     Key responsibilities include:   Develop and oversee the implementation of a member engagement strategy to increase direct contact with staff/frontline workers in members agencies.  Have regular contact with member agencies (in person and online) to promote the benefit of membership and ensure that members are maximising their membership.  Gather data and maintain accurate records of current member agency engagement in order to identify opportunities for growth as well as areas of concern.  Take the lead, and in consultation with colleagues, agree the membership benefits and fees payable across the different categories

title: Customer Success Manager

title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own     The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. title: Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales Manager (APAC)

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What the work looks like

Building and operating platforms. You design, provision, and harden cloud data platforms end to end, covering storage and compute, networking, security and IAM, observability, and cost. You codify infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation and establish governance frameworks such as data catalogs, data contracts, RBAC models, and SLAs that let organisations scale data access without losing control. You build platforms that multiple teams and business domains can rely on, not just at launch, but as they grow.

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh

Together, we build data products and ML solutions that help Risk teams work smarter, faster, and more effectively — while keeping our controls robust, auditable, and compliant across products and markets.

We actively welcome applications from women and people from underrepresented backgrounds. Diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our systems more robust. If you're motivated by technical depth, real-world impact, and the challenge of making ML work reliably in a high-stakes environment, this role is built for you.

title: Junior QA Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
We are Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. the leading fertility and family-building benefits provider in the US.

Our shared mission? To make fertility and family-forming care accessible everywhere, breaking down barriers so that anyone can start a family, no matter where they are. With Progyny’s support, we're set to amplify our impact globally, reaching more individuals and families than ever before.

Come and join us for a diverse and inclusive workplace and use “Tech for Good”!

As a Junior QA Engineer, you’ll support software quality through both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend Engineers, Designers, and other QA colleagues to test new implementations and improve our testing processes.

Our product includes different systems and integrations working together, so curiosity, communication, and a willingness to learn are important. You won’t be expected to know everything from day one, but we’re looking for someone who can gradually take more ownership as they learn the product and our processes.

Tasks

  • Manually test new features, bug fixes, and existing product flows.

  • Write and maintain automated tests using Playwright.
  • Report, track, and retest bugs using Jira.
  • Review user stories and raise questions when requirements are unclear.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Product Managers throughout the testing process.
  • Support test automation within our GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Learn how different product areas and third-party integrations work together.
  • Explore how AI tools can support testing, documentation, and automation.

Requirements

  • Some practical experience with manual software testing, through work, an internship, training, or personal projects

title: Sales Director
description:
About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale.

More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technologies, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations. Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any Drone. Any Scale. Anywhere. We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

We are looking for a Sales Director to lead and scale our commercial organization in a fast‑growing defence technology company building cutting‑edge solutions for the drone era. This is a high‑impact leadership role responsible for shaping sales strategy, driving revenue growth, and building a world‑class sales team in a complex, mission‑critical environment.

You will operate at the intersection of advanced technology and global markets, working with sophisticated customers and stakeholders across defence, aerospace, and related industries. The role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, operational discipline, and hands‑on deal leadership, particularly in long sales cycles and multi‑stakeholder environments.

 

As Sales Director, you will define and execute go‑to‑market strategy, improve commercial performance, and ensure sales excellence across forecasting, pipeline management, and deal execution. You will also play a key role in scaling the organization, developing talent, and shaping how we engage with strategic customers and partners globally.

About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About Frontier Health

Frontier Health is building the system of action for healthcare: end-to-end AI co-workers that perform administrative jobs.

Healthcare has an administrative crisis breaking patient care — the WHO predicts a 10 million person workforce shortfall by 2030. Administrative staff are the invisible machinery powering healthcare systems, yet they're over capacity, under-resourced, and underfunded. Care coordination runs on shadow IT: spreadsheets, paper notes, phone calls, and outdated technology.

Frontier's AI co-workers fast-track the admin behind care decisions, designed to slot into the teams, processes, and tools already in place. Founded 18 months ago, we've experience deploying to over 40 hospitals. The team comes from Palantir, Google DeepMind, and Apple. We've raised $16M and were recently valued at $60M, backed by Tier One UK and international investors.

We’re an in person Company, valuing being in the office (Farringdon/Chancery Lane) 5 days a week, or onsite with the customer (as required). We’re also flat, valuing ownership and impact of hierarchy, process and structure. You’ll be collaborating with people across engineering and business functions, with functional leadership, where required, and close and regular touchpoints with the CEO.

Values

  • Outcome Orientation — we focus on results and delivering value to customers

  • Grit — we stick with hard problems and see them through

  • Kindness — we presume best intentions and treat each other with respect

  • Bias to Act

description:
About Us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

 

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming brand refresh
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each

title: QA Engineer
description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving:   Voor een groeiende technologieorganisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Medior QA Engineer die een belangrijke bijdrage wil leveren aan de kwaliteit van een eigen softwareplatform.  De organisatie ontwikkelt digitale oplossingen waarmee klanten verschillende operationele en administratieve processen kunnen beheren en automatiseren. De software wordt volledig in eigen beheer ontwikkeld en bestaat uit een uitgebreid webbased platform met verschillende functionaliteiten, gebruikersstromen en koppelingen met externe systemen.     Door de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform worden nieuwe functionaliteiten toegevoegd en bestaande onderdelen continu verbeterd. Hierdoor neemt ook het belang van kwaliteit, stabiliteit en gebruiksvriendelijkheid verder toe.     Je komt terecht in een compact technisch team met software developers en QA. Binnen het team wordt nauw samengewerkt en krijg je veel mee van het volledige ontwikkelproces: van nieuwe requirements en development tot testen, oplevering en verdere optimalisatie.     De organisatie kenmerkt zich door een informele en nuchtere werksfeer. De lijnen zijn kort en er is veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Tegelijkertijd wordt er veel samengewerkt en vinden collega's het belangrijk om elkaar te helpen. Er wordt hybride gewerkt, waardoor je werkzaamheden zowel vanuit huis als op locatie kunt uitvoeren.      Functie-informatie:   Als Medior QA Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken en verbeteren van de kwaliteit van het softwareplatform. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan alleen controleren of een functionaliteit technisch werkt. Je denkt vanuit de gebruiker, onderzoekt verschillende scenario's en probeert juist de situaties te vinden waarin software niet doet wat ervan wordt verwacht.     Je wordt vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Samen met developers bespreek je requirements en bepaal je welke scenario's getest moeten worden. Vervolgens stel je testcases op, voer je functionele en regressietesten uit en leg je bevindingen duidelijk vast.     Je krijgt binnen deze functie veel vrijheid om zelf te bepalen hoe je het testproces aanpakt. Daarbij wordt ook van je verwacht dat je kritisch kijkt naar de huidige manier van werken. Zie je mogelijkheden om processen slimmer, efficiënter of betrouwbaarder in te richten? Dan krijg je de ruimte om hierin initiatief te nemen.     Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:   Opstellen, uitvoeren en onderhouden van testcases  Functioneel testen van nieuwe en bestaande softwarefunctionaliteiten  Uitvoeren van regressietesten  Signaleren, analyseren en duidelijk documenteren van bugs  Bespreken van bevindingen met software developers  Meedenken over requirements en mogelijke gebruikersscenario's  Controleren of opgeleverde functionaliteiten aansluiten bij de gestelde eisen  Bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van QA binnen de organisatie  Signaleren van risico

title: Senior IREG & Network Test Engineer
description: The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.   Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.  Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.  At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.  When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works    This role is based in Espoo, Finland, one of Skylo's core engineering hubs and fastest-growing sites. You'll work onsite three days a week as part of a team that's scaling quickly. You will collaborate with a high-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones. We are hiring an automation-oriented Senior IREG & Network Test Engineer to own that gate—from initial attach and authentication through SGd, MAP, SMS, IP NIDD, and roaming sign-off. You will replace manual, partner-dependent execution with a repeatable test strategy, a scalable testing environment, and an automated regression pipeline.   Responsibilities     Develop Test Strategy: Define the comprehensive IREG test strategy, pass/fail metrics, network tracing protocols, and official sign-off processes for each partner MNO.  Execute Roaming Validation: Run end-to-end roaming testing across network registration, attach sequences, S6a/S6d authentication, SGd SMS-over-NAS, and IP/NIDD data paths.  Optimize for NTN: Execute the standard GSMA-defined Roaming test suite while ideating and introducing custom validation test cases built specifically for NTN (Non-Terrestrial Networks).  Build Automation Harnesses: Build and maintain an automation test harness and lab capable of running core GSMA and Skylo-specific routing scenarios consistently.  Trace Analysis: Analyze Diameter/SS7 traces along with device and network logs to cleanly isolate configuration issues across Skylo, IPX, and MNO domains.  Defect Management: Turn production and onboarding failures into repeatable regression test cases,

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)
description: About The Team & Mission   Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)는 SDV 아키텍처 전환 환경에서 차량 바디/편의 소프트웨어의 통합 기능·성능 검증을 수행하며, 제어기 간 연동을 포함한 시스템 완성도를 확보합니다. 도어, HVAC, 시트 등 주요 편의 장치와 제어 소프트웨어 간 상호작용을 통합 관점에서 검증하고, 시나리오 기반 테스트 설계 및 자동화 체계를 구축하여 검증 효율성과 정확성을 향상시킵니다. 또한 Linux/RTOS 기반 환경과 차량 네트워크를 이해하고, 로그 데이터 분석 및 CI/CD 기반 검증 프로세스를 통해 양산 전·후 품질 지표를 관리하며 지속적인 품질 개선과 내재화를 리딩합니다.   Responsibilities     검증 계획 수립   SDV 통합 소프트웨어 QA 엔지니어는 새로운 설계(zonal architecture 등)와 동작 방식에 기반한 통합 소프트웨어 검증 계획을 수립합니다.   검증 설계   테스트 케이스 설계와 테스트 환경/조건을 설계하고, 단일 소프트웨어가 아닌 통합 검증 관점에서 검증 수행을 준비합니다.   검증 수행   주요 마일스톤(릴리스나 게이트 등)의 품질 목표 달성을 위한 검증을 실행합니다.   소프트웨어 통합 검증 외에 제어기와 연동되는 테스트 벤치 조건 및 실차 환경에서 검증을 수행할 수 있습니다.   검증 자동화   자동화 도구를 개발 또는 적용하여 통합 검증 활동을 효율화합니다.   결과 분석   검증 결과를 문서화하고 분석 내용을 구조화합니다.  필요에 따라 분석 내용에 대한 대시보드를 구성하여 시각화할 수 있습니다.   프로세스 구축 및 개선   통합 소프트웨어 검증의 효율성과 정확성을 높일 수 있는 프로세스와 절차를 정의하고 개선합니다.     Qualifications     7년 이상 자동차 소프트웨어 기능/성능 평가 업무 경험을 보유하신 분  Linux와 RTOS와 같은 운영체제에 대한 이해가 높으신 분  자동차 네트워크 평가 툴(CANoe, CANape 등) 사용 경험이 있으신 분  자동차 평가 로그 데이터 분석 경험이 있으신 분  Agile 프로세스와 CI/CD 환경에서 검증 활동을 진행한 경험이 있으신 분  최신 기술에 관심이 많고 변화에 유연하게 대처할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분     Preferred Qualifications     임베디드 개발환경에서의 프로그래밍 언어(C/C++, Python, Rust 등)에 대한 높은 이해도  클라우드 환경(AWS, Azure 등)에서의 소프트웨어 품질 관리 업무 경험  제어기 또는 차량 평가 자동화 구축 경험 (HIL, SIL 등)  A-SPICE 또는 ISO 26262 적용 경험  Cloud service(fleet management 등)와 실차간 연동 경험  LLM을 이용한 검증 업무 자동화 진행 경험

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description: At AROA, our people come to work every day with passion and ideas that fuel our business and go home knowing they have made a real difference in the lives of others.     AROA, which is Maori for ‘understanding’, is proudly New Zealand born and based. We develop, manufacture, and export innovative wound care products, improving the lives of millions around the world by unlocking extraordinary outcomes for our patients. Our mission is to be the global leader in regenerative healing, making our products and services accessible to everybody.      About the role:   We’re looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer  to join our Quality team. In this critical role, you’ll provide technical quality oversight across validation, equipment qualification, risk management, and continuous improvement activities ensuring our systems, products, and processes meet the highest standards of compliance and safety. Other key responsibilities include:   Provide quality oversight and approval of validation activities and documentation.  Actively engage with production floor processes, equipment, and personnel to ensure quality standards are upheld throughout design transfer and manufacturing.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams and effectively support multiple projects, balancing priorities to meet deadlines.  Serve as a point of contact for QA technical issues, drive root cause analysis, and communicate quality concerns to cross-functional teams.  Contribute to AROA’s continuous improvement efforts by identifying areas for improvement in product quality and safety       What you'll bring:     Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or equivalent.  3+ years’ experience in Quality Assurance within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.  Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and cGMP.  Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.  Hands-on experience with process validation.  Strong technical writing skills, with experience reviewing documentation for compliance and clarity.  Experience with or interest in computer system/software validation is desirable.       What we offer:   At AROA NZ, we value our people and make sure working with us is rewarding, both professionally and personally. Here’s what you can enjoy as part of our team:    Health & Wellbeing  – Free on-site gym and fitness classes, plus an annual paid health and wellbeing allowance.   Birthday Leave  – A paid day off to celebrate your special day!   Convenient Location  – Free carparking onsite at our Airport Oaks sites with easy motorway access.   Sustainable Travel Support  – Fareshare public transport subsidy, WorkRide program, onsite bike shed, and electric bike charging stations.   Family-Friendly Benefits  – Generous parental leave entitlements to support you and your loved ones.   Social & Team Culture  – Join a social club and enjoy team events and activities in a supportive, inclusive workplace.   GROW

title: Senior QA Engineer – API Testing

With over 14 years of experience and a multicultural team of more than 100 professionals, we deliver projects for highly complex industries such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, healthcare, and consumer goods.  At our company, we value international talent, diversity, flexibility, and a collaborative environment that fosters both professional growth and personal well-being.   About The Role   At Nuvolar, we are looking for a  Senior QA Engineer  to join one of our  healthcare projects , working on digital health solutions that support complex workflows and critical software platforms.  You will become part of a technical team responsible for ensuring the quality of a platform that manages sensitive healthcare information, integrations, and services within a complex digital health ecosystem.This role is a great opportunity for a QA Engineer who enjoys understanding  complex products, defining quality strategies, designing meaningful test scenarios , and collaborating closely with developers and product teams to deliver reliable software. Perform backend and API testing using tools such as Postman and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.  Validate REST APIs, data consistency, error handling, authentication flows, and integration scenarios.  Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL to validate data integrity and support testing activities. title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Department:  AssetOps Engineering   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Description    About the role   Assets Ops is part of the osapiens HUB platform's Efficiency suite, helping enterprise customers manage maintenance, facilities, and operational workflows at scale. As a Senior Quality Engineer embedded in the Assets Ops team, you will own the quality strategy end-to-end — from defining testing approaches to shipping and maintaining automation frameworks that keep the product stable and reliable for thousands of users.  You'll work side by side with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle, not just at the end of it. That means fast feedback loops, meaningful test coverage, and a clear-eyed view of product health at all times.  You will be working in a hybrid work setup, with a collaborative and international team. You'll join a fast-growing company at the intersection of AI, compliance, and enterprise software — where the quality of what you ship genuinely matters to the customers relying on it.   What You'll Do    Quality strategy & ownership     Define, implement, and continuously improve testing strategies in close alignment with the product and engineering teams.  Serve as the team's subject matter expert on QA processes, tooling, and best practices — raising the bar for the whole squad.  Maintain clear, accurate, and actionable test documentation and reporting for both developers and business stakeholders.     Hands-on testing     Test newly implemented features using a diverse range of testing techniques, with a focus on uncovering gaps early.  Perform exploratory testing to proactively identify regressions and edge cases before they reach production.  Provide fast, reliable feedback on product health and stability to developers and stakeholders throughout each sprint.     Automation & tooling     Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites covering E2E and API testing for both web and mobile applications.  Perform root cause analysis on failing automated tests and drive their resolution.  Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality gates are in place (Azure DevOps preferred).  Contribute to AI-assisted development efforts and explore how emerging tooling can improve the team's quality workflows.     Collaboration & communication     Report bugs clearly and follow up on their resolution, monitoring the bug backlog to keep it actionable.  Support developers in investigating and reproducing issues, acting as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper.    Your Responsibilities    Test the products applying diverse testing techniques to uncover bugs  Report bugs and follow up their resolution  Develop new and maintain the existing automated end-to-end and API tests  Contribute in the AI assisted development efforts and tooling  Setup and maintain CI/CD pipelines  Perform root cause analysis of failing automated test

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description: About the role   We're looking for a Product Quality Owner to take ownership of a question nobody at Zendr owns today: what we validate before we ship, in what order, and why. As we roll out the next generation of our B2B freight platform through late 2026 - shipping continuously behind feature flags - you'll build and defend the risk model of our product, decide where validation effort goes, and stand behind every release decision with real evidence rather than gut feel or a completed checklist.     This is a strategy and ownership role with hands-on validation at its core. It's deliberately not a test-execution role, a QA engineering role, or a team lead role - our development teams own automated unit and integration testing, written and maintained with modern AI tooling. Your time goes to the judgment work automation can't do: risk thinking, release readiness, and deep exploratory and regression testing of the flows that matter most.  You'll work closely with the Head of Product and the Head of Engineering in a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and craft matter more than buzzwords. Your recommendation is what every release decision is based on, so this role comes with real mandate - and the accountability that goes with it. This is a role for someone who reasons analytically about risk and generates structure in ambiguity - not someone who waits to be told what to test.      Key responsibilities    Own and maintain the product's risk model - what can break, what it costs the customer, and where validation effort should go  Own release readiness: your recommendation is the basis for every release decision - you define what "ready" means per release and back each ship-or-hold call with documented evidence  Drive bug refinement on a regular cadence and keep the backlog honest and prioritised against real customer and business impact  Inventory, risk-triage and validate features shipped behind feature flags before they roll out to customer segments  Run exploratory testing of new functionality and regression on critical flows - carrier integrations, rates, labels and the messy real-world edge cases of a logistics product  Drive the regression automation you need through the development teams rather than building it all yourself  Bring risk thinking into product discovery, acceptance criteria and definition of done, before development starts       About you   You came up through testing and have since moved well beyond manual test execution into analytical, risk-based quality work, with genuine product sense. You reason about risk, impact and probability, and you can justify what deserves testing effort and what doesn't. You're comfortable owning decisions, setting your own testing agenda, and turning ambiguity into structure. You communicate clearly - making risk tangible for both technical and non-technical people - and you build trust across product and engineering as a force multiplier, never a bottleneck. title: Chief Architect
description: CatalystOne is building the next generation of HCM products for the Nordic and Northern European market. Our platform is built by 15 product teams across Scandinavia and India, and we are scaling on several fronts at once: product complexity, AI adoption, platform modernisation, and the integration work that follows growth.     Each of those is manageable on its own. Together, they need a single architectural owner who can see the whole picture and set the direction. That is why we are hiring a Chief Architect.      As a Chief Architect in CatalystOne, some of your day-to-day tasks will be:    Owning and evolving the overall product architecture and target state across our HCM platform, including platform direction, domain boundaries, integration patterns and long-term modernisation priorities.  Owning, maintaining and evolving our architectural north star, balancing long-term sustainability with near-term delivery needs.  Curating our Technology Radar, providing transparency and guidance on technology choices.  Taking ownership of our architecture toolset (principles, patterns, reference architectures, ADR practices and decision records) that gives product teams practical guardrails and decision support as they move toward the target architecture.  Enabling autonomous, agile teams by setting constraints that increase flow, predictability and compliance.  Stepping in where local choices carry system-wide consequences, such as shared platform services, data ownership, identity, security, AI infrastructure or the integration of acquired systems.  Acting as a strategic partner for the product trios, collaborating closely with Product and Engineering leadership.  Supporting architectural decision-making across teams by enabling fast, well-documented decisions close to where the work happens, and by building architectural capacity within the teams themselves.  Representing architectural perspectives in strategic discussions within the CTO leadership group and Executive Management Team.       What this role focuses on:   You own the long-term, product-wide architecture. Implementation stays with the teams, and your job is to give them the tools and guardrails that make their decisions easier and safer.     In practice, that means working across 15 small teams of four to six people, each with a PM, a UX designer and a Tech Lead. You'll spend your time with the Tech Leads on technology choices and trade-offs, and just as much with the Product Owners, because what we build matters a great deal for how it should be built. You lead through principles, clarity and trust rather than approval queues.     AI is changing how our software is built and operated, and you help us adopt it in ways that make us more effective without loosening our grip on quality, security and compliance. title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET

At our company, we value international talent, diversity, flexibility, and a collaborative environment that fosters both professional growth and personal well-being. You will become part of an engineering environment focused on improving how software is tested by  designing automation frameworks, reusable testing tools, and technical solutions that support QA engineers and development teams.   This role is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys combining software engineering and quality practices: building automation solutions, improving testing processes, working with modern technologies, and helping teams adopt more efficient ways of delivering reliable software. Build automation capabilities for backend/API testing, frontend testing, end-to-end workflows,  integration testing, and regression testing.  Create scalable and maintainable automation solutions using technologies such as Playwright, TypeScript, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks.  Develop reusable components and tools that help QA engineers and development teams improve testing efficiency.   Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows .  Collaborate with QA engineers to understand testing challenges and translate their needs into technical solutions.  Apply software engineering best practices to automation projects, including clean code, documentation, maintainability, and reliability. description: Job Description    Aarhus, Denmark   Are you an experienced AI/ML engineer who wants to help us shape how we build, test and operate AI? We're a strong software organization looking for someone to mature our AI practice across our products, while a talented team grows around you.  Stakeholder Intelligence is a unit within Rambøll, with SaaS products including SurveyXact, PeopleXact and Heart&Mind. These products help organizations across the Nordics and Europe understand and improve the lives of the people who matter most to them, whether customers, patients, citizens, employees or children. For some, that means listening to stakeholders and turning their feedback into insight they can act on. For others, it means giving managers what they need to improve the working lives of their teams, or supporting practitioners in daycare and schools in their work on quality and children's development.  We work with sensitive data, and keeping it safe shapes how we build: we primarily run models on our own GPU servers, on-prem. We're expanding our SaaS portfolio with AI-driven value creation, and we're looking for a senior engineer to help us do it responsibly and at scale.   Where you fit in   We're early in our AI journey. We have a mature software organization (50 developers and designers) with deep strength in traditional software engineering, and a Platform Engineering team that builds the shared platform our product teams build and run on. But ML and LLM work is new to us, and our practices for evaluating, testing and operating these systems are still forming. We've recently begun building a dedicated AI Engineering function; it's still small, and much of its work happens alongside Platform Engineering.  AI Engineering at Stakeholder Intelligence is a shared craft. Our AI Engineers are talented but early in their careers. Each is primarily attached to a product team and works closely with that team, while spending a significant portion of their time on shared methods and tooling across products. As our senior engineer, you'll spend even more of your time working broadly across products, and your job is to shape that craft.  You won't own product direction; that stays with the product teams and their Tech Leads. What you'll shape is how we do ML/LLM engineering: the methods, standards and practices for how we develop, test, evaluate, deploy and operate the AI parts of our products. You'll provide direction, bring proven experience, and represent AI engineering in cross-functional discussions with Product Managers, Tech Leads and other senior voices.  This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with real influence, scoped to the experience you bring.   What You'll Do      Define our evaluation practice: how we determine whether one model, prompt or system genuinely outperforms another, drawing on methods such as golden datasets, deterministic checks, reference-based metrics, LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation. This is central to the role.  Es

Du evner å arbeide systematisk og strukturert, og har kapasitet til å følge opp prosesser over tid med fokus på framdrift og kvalitet. Stillingen inngår i klinikkens stab og rapporterer til klinikksjef. I rollen vil du være en viktig støtte for klinikksjef, avdelingssjefer og ledergruppen. Derfor søker vi deg som er trygg i samarbeid med ledere og bidrar med faglige råd innen administrative styringsprosesser, kvalitets- og forbedringsarbeid. Med rundt 340 årsverk, et budsjett på ca 650 millioner kroner og lokal-, regional- og nasjonale funksjoner, tilbyr vi høyspesialiserte tjenester til pasienter i hele Midt-Norge. title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
Headquarters:  League City, Texas
      URL:   http://one.pet 
 

 OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets.

 
 We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains.

 
 This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction.

 
 Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy. 
  What You'll Do  
 Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic. 
 
 Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet. 
 Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions. 
 Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics. 
 Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost. 
 GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search. 
 Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results. 
 
 Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does. 
   
  How You'll Operate  
 You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute. 
 Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results. 
 You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes. 
 If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving. 
   
  How We'll Measure Success

Als Customer Success Manager bij Trustoo ben jij meer dan een aanspreekpunt; je bent de strategische partner die lokale ondernemers helpt hun business écht naar een hoger niveau te tillen.    Wie zijn wij?   Heb je ooit ervaren hoe uitdagend het kan zijn om snel en betrouwbaar een lokale dienstverlener te vinden zoals een schilder of boekhouder? Precies om deze uitdaging aan te pakken hebben wij in 2019 Trustoo opgericht. Trustoo is een online platform voor lokale ondernemers waar bezoekers heel gemakkelijk de beste bedrijven kunnen vinden. Denk aan een marktplaats voor hotels zoals Booking of een vergelijkingssite als Tripadvisor, maar dan voor lokale bedrijven.  Trustoo biedt in Nederland, Duitsland, België en Spanje aan zo’n 300.000 lokale bedrijven een podium om goed online vindbaar te zijn voor hun klanten. Dit kunnen wij uiteraard niet alleen: ons team bestaat uit meer dan 85 gedreven mensen die ervoor zorgen dat je elke dag met plezier naar je werk gaat. Al is het alleen maar om het potje tafeltennis of de vrijmibo.   Over de functie   Als Customer Success Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze partners. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor een portfolio van ondernemers en je bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. In deze rol zorg je ervoor dat partners het maximale uit ons platform halen. Je zorgt voor een succesvolle onboarding, geeft pro-actief advies over hun prestaties op ons platform, spot commerciële (cross- & upsell) kansen en denkt mee om processen te verbeteren om ons platform nog waardevoller te maken.   Wat ga je doen?     Je begeleidt onze nieuwe klanten in het systeem, van onboarding tot retentie, en zorgt ervoor dat zij vanaf dag 1 de waarde van het platform inzien.  Je pakt escalaties en complexe situaties op. Slimme AI agents worden ingezet voor het beantwoorden van eenvoudige ticket aanvragen.  Proactief contact onderhouden met partners: gesprekken, reviews, feedback ophalen.  Analyseren van data en KPI’s op klant niveau: waar lopen partners tegenaan, wat zijn kansen?  Je signaleert en springt in op commerciële kansen (Up- & cross sell) en herkent risico's en churn signalen waar je pro-actief actie op onderneemt.   Je werkt nauw samen met andere afdelingen zoals Sales, Product en Marketing om product- en partner ervaringen te verbeteren.   Je denkt mee in het verbeteren en automatiseren van interne processen met behulp van AI en automation tools.      Wie zoeken we?     Ervaring als Customer Success Manager, Account Management of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een B2B SaaS omgeving.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands

Du begleitest sie vom Vertragsabschluss über das Onboarding ihrer Objekte bis in den laufenden Betrieb und sorgst dafür, dass der versprochene Nutzen real wird: im Schnitt 11.750 € eingesparte Heizkosten und 16 Tonnen weniger CO₂ pro Gebäude und Jahr. Dabei gestaltest du eng mit dem Gründungsteam, wie wir unsere Customer-Success-Organisation aufbauen.  Aufgaben     Onboarding:  Du steuerst das Onboarding neuer Heizzentralen – Zugangskoordination, Terminplanung, Projektvorbereitung – und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Start.    Portfolio:  Du hast die operative Verantwortung für ein Portfolio von Bestandskund:innen und treibst Adoption, Zufriedenheit und Roll-Out voran.    Kundenerfolg:  Du dokumentierst Einsparungen und CO₂-Reduktion, organisierst alle Maßnahmen für den Kundenerfolg und löst Probleme wie Heizungsausfälle oder Ineffizienzen gemeinsam mit dem Umsetzungsteam. Zudem führst du regelmäßige Reviews – vom operativen Kontakt bis zur Geschäftsführung.    Wachstum:  Du erkennst Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Potenziale und treibst sie gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team voran.    Produkt:  Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback in konkrete Verbesserungen – gemeinsam mit den Produkt-, IoT- und Software-Teams.    Qualifikation    Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Vertrieb, Account Management oder Kundenbetreuung im B2B-Umfeld.   Nachweisbare Erfolge in Kundenbindung, -gewinnung, -zufriedenheit und Wachstum im Bestand.   Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungsstärke sowie eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.   Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch und Führerschein Klasse B.   Interesse an Digitalisierung, Energie und Nachhaltigkeit.      Starkes Plus:      Erfahrung in PropTech, EnergyTech, IoT oder SaaS-Scale-up; Vertrautheit mit der Immobilienwirtschaft; technisches Grundverständnis (Heizsysteme, IoT, KI/LLMs).    Benefits     Vergütung:  Attraktives Fixgehalt ab 45.000 € brutto/Jahr (je nach Erfahrung), plus leistungsabhängiger Bonus, gekoppelt an Kundenzufriedenheit, Retention und Portfolio-Wachstum.    Nähe zum Team:  Persönliches Mentoring und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Gründer- und Investorenteam.    Umfeld:  Modernes Büro im Herzen Wiens (nähe Schwedenplatz), hohes Tempo und ein leistungsorientiertes Umfeld mit Fokus auf messbaren Impact und gemeinsames Wachstum.    Wirkung:  Motiviertes, interdisziplinäres und internationales Team – und echter, messbarer Klimaschutz.     Bei Wohnio kannst du vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung übernehmen, deine Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns echte Wirkung erzielen. Wenn du Lust hast, jeden Tag dazuzulernen und an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft mitzuarbeiten, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  We are seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead escalations and incident management team. This role combines technical leadership with operational excellence to ensure seamless handling of complex customer escalations and major incidents. The ideal candidate will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for resolving critical technical issues across our satellite network infrastructure, while maintaining the highest standards of customer satisfaction.  As the Escalations & Incident Team Manager, you will partner in implementing incident response protocols, managing critical customer escalations, and ensuring rapid resolution of complex technical issues. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including, Engineering, and Product teams to drive technical solutions and prevent recurring issues. Your team will serve as the escalation point for our most challenging technical problems, requiring you to balance tactical incident response with strategic improvements.  This position demands strong technical acumen leadership skills, and the ability to make critical decisions impacting customer endpoints.  Success in this role requires a leader who can thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate technical expertise in satellite communications or networking (AWS TGW, VPC NETDEV), and maintain composure during critical incidents. You'll be expected to continuously improve our incident management processes, mentor team members, and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization.  Key job responsibilities     Lead and develop a team handling high-severity technical escalations and major incidents   Establish and maintain continuous escalation support with balanced workload distribution across all shifts, including escalation matrices, incident response protocols, and resolution SLAs.   Drive root cause analysis for critical incidents and implement preventive measures   Oversee incident communication processes and stakeholder management   Collaborate with NOC, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex technical issues   Manage incident response team capacity and skill development   Ensure timely resolution of escalated issues and high customer satisfaction   Develop and maintain incident management playbooks and procedures   Role requires flexibility to work in a 24x7 operational environment, including rotating shifts and participation in on-call rotation for critical escalations outside regular business hours   Must coordinate coverage across multiple time zones and be available for major incident management d

We are seeking a powerhouse  Customer Support Manager  to act as the ultimate strategic champion and primary face of Airbus for an elite portfolio of operators.  This isn't your average account management role. Operating as a high-visibility program lead in a matrix environment, you will hold the keys to a multi-million dollar portfolio where your decisions directly impact fleet availability, operational performance, and customer trust. Manage customer needs, performance and shared forecasting by building strong and long-lasting relationships with customers and establishing standard routines.
