title: Customer Success Manager
description: Xledger är ett molnbaserat affärssystem grundat 2000 och är idag etablerat i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, USA och Storbritannien. Xledger används av fler än 10 000 företag och har över 100 000 användare i +100 länder. Lösningen är designad för maximal automation, insikt och skalbarhet.        Customer Success Manager till Xledger inom ERP & SaaS      Vill du arbeta nära kund, affär och strategi i en roll där du verkligen gör skillnad?  Nu söker vi en driven Customer Success Manager som vill utveckla våra kundrelationer och bidra till långsiktig tillväxt tillsammans med oss.      Om rollen      Som Customer Success Manager hos oss har du ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla och stärka våra kundrelationer med ett tydligt fokus på värdeskapande, kundnöjdhet och långsiktig affär. Du arbetar proaktivt med din kundportfölj och säkerställer att kunderna får maximalt värde av våra lösningar, samtidigt som du identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och driver utveckling över tid. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med både kunder och interna funktioner för att skapa en stark, enhetlig och långsiktig kundupplevelse.  Du blir en viktig del av vårt Customer Success-team och bidrar aktivt till att vidareutveckla arbetssätt, erbjudande och hur vi skapar kundvärde. Du rapporterar till Director Customer & Partner Success.      I rollen kommer du att:    Äga och utveckla en egen kundportfölj  Driva kunddialoger med fokus på affär och kundnöjdhet  Identifiera och utveckla affärsmöjligheter hos befintliga kunder  Arbeta strukturerat med att tidigt identifiera risker och minska churn  Följa upp kundplaner, aktiviteter och affärsutveckling  Samarbeta nära andra funktioner för att säkerställa en stark och enhetlig kundupplevelse       Din profil      Vi söker dig som är affärsdriven, relationsskapande och strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt. Du har en god förståelse för hur lösningar skapar värde för kunden och drivs av att utveckla både kundrelationer och affär över tid.      Vi ser gärna att du har:    Minst 5+ års erfarenhet av affärsdrivet arbete, exempelvis inom Customer Success eller komplex lösningsförsäljning  Erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta med befintliga kundrelationer  Förmåga att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt  God kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska  Ett strukturerat arbetssätt med fokus på uppföljning och resultat  Meriterande med erfarenhet av SaaS, affärssystem eller ekonomibakgrund       För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:    Bygger förtroendefulla och långsiktiga relationer  Tar initiativ och driver arbetet framåt i en självständig roll  Har ett tydligt affärsfokus och kopplar aktiviteter till resultat  Är flexibel och kan anpassa arbetssätt efter situation och mottagare  Motiveras av att arbeta i en utvecklingsorienterad och framåtriktad miljö       Vi erbjuder      Hos oss får du arbeta i en växande organisation där Customer Success är en central del av vår strategi. Du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverk

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Working at Mercell    At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.  With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.  Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.   Your Mission    As a Customer Success Manager at Mercell, you'll own a portfolio of supplier customers across Europe with a focus on the Norwegian market, the businesses who rely on our platform to discover, access, and win public tenders. Your mission is to make sure they get real, measurable value from Mercell every single day.  That means building genuine relationships and becoming a trusted partner your customers turn to; spotting the early signals of churn and acting before it happens; and uncovering the moments where customers are ready to grow, so you can open the door to new opportunities. Above all, you'll be the person who ensures every customer in your portfolio realises the full potential of what Mercell can do for them helping them win more, work smarter, and see us as essential to their success.  If you're energised by ownership, thrive on building lasting relationships, and love turning satisfied customers into genuine advocates, this is a role where you'll see the impact of your work directly in retention, in growth, and in the success of the customers you champion.   Core Responsibilities     Own and resolve defined categories of customer issues raised via HubSpot, Jira, or similar systems (e.g. onboarding, billing questions, contract terms, access issues, product transitions).  Assess, prioritize, and resolve cases efficiently and consistently based on established processes.  Ensure cases are handled according to approved playbooks, policies, and best practices.  Deliver low-touch, structured customer engagement through standardized responses, templates, and automated touchpoints.  Guide customers to relevant self-service resources, documentation, and training materials to encourage independence and adoption.     Required Qualifications     Experience (ideally 2-3 years) in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, Operations, or another client-facing SaaS role.  Strong ability to build deep knowledge within defined functional or product areas.  Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely.  Experience working with ticketing systems, CRM tools, and digital workflows.  Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with clear processes a

title: Key Account Manager:in
description: Du hast Kundenkontakt – aber keine klare Perspektive?   Du betreust Kunden, gibst dir Mühe, lieferst ab – aber weißt nie genau, wie du dadurch wirklich mehr verdienst oder aufsteigst?   Dann lies weiter.   Bei Fourlead suchen wir Key Account Manager, die Bestandskunden strategisch betreuen und langfristig weiterentwickeln.   Kein klassischer Sales-Job.   Kein Neukundenabschluss.   Sondern Verantwortung, Beziehung und messbarer Impact.   Du übernimmst bestehende Kunden, baust die Zusammenarbeit aus und triffst strategische Entscheidungen, die dafür sorgen, dass deine Kunden bessere Ergebnisse erzielen.   Je erfolgreicher deine Kunden werden, desto höher ist auch dein eigener Verdienst.   Aktuell verantworten unsere Key Account Manager Kundenvolumen von 100.000–150.000 € –   darauf erhältst du 5 % Provision, zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt.   Was das bedeutet, kannst du dir selbst ausrechnen.  Aufgaben  Was dich bei uns erwartet:   ✅ Fixgehalt + starke, leistungsbezogene Provision   ✅ Ausschließlich Bestandskunden (kein Cold Calling)   ✅ Langfristige Kundenbeziehungen statt schneller Abschlüsse   ✅ Eigenverantwortung & strategischer Gestaltungsspielraum   ✅ Klare Entwicklungsperspektive statt Stillstand   ✅ Modernes Umfeld & professionelles Team  Qualifikation  Was du mitbringen solltest:     Kommunikationsstärke & Überzeugungskraft   Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung / Account Management   Du kannst klar sprechen und Verantwortung übernehmen   Du willst Ergebnisse verbessern – nicht nur verwalten   Eigenverantwortung & Lösungsorientierung (Probleme früh erkennen und lösen)   Struktur & Organisation (Deadlines, Aufgaben, Kundenprojekte im Griff)    Benefits    Fixgehalt + leistungsbezogene Provision   Arbeiten mit bestehenden Kunden   Klare Prozesse, direkte Verantwortung und messbarer Impact   Junges, professionelles Team mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität   Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit starken Kunden in ganz Österreich   Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in Völkermarkt mit langfristiger Perspektive     Wenn du weißt, dass du mehr kannst als „nur betreuen“   und endlich einen klaren Zusammenhang zwischen Leistung, Verantwortung und Einkommen suchst, dann sollten wir miteinander sprechen.

title: Marketing Success Partner
description: You’ve sat on the brand side of the table. You’ve launched campaigns, briefed research agencies, debated pack changes, defended budgets, and tried to convince retailers your product deserves more shelf space. You know how hard it can be to make fast, confident decisions when consumer insight is expensive, slow, or arrives too late to actually influence the outcome.       At Stickybeak, we’re changing that.       We’re a New Zealand-born consumer testing platform helping marketers test ideas with real consumers in days, not months - making it easier to validate decisions before committing to big campaigns, pricing changes, innovation launches, or creative directions.       We’re looking for a Marketing Success Partner (our version of the Customer Success Manager), someone who has genuinely lived in the shoes of our customers. An experienced FMCG marketer who understands how brands make decisions and wants to use that experience in a strategic, customer-facing role.       This is a rare opportunity to join at an exciting stage of growth where you'll work alongside our team of APAC Marketing Success Partners.       What you'll be doing    You’ll become a trusted partner to our customers, helping them get maximum value from Stickybeak and embedding consumer thinking into everyday decision-making.       That means:     Building strong, long-term relationships with FMCG and marketing customers    Guiding customers through onboarding and helping them build effective testing plans    Advising on research design, targeting, and best practice    Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations and stories    Helping customers move faster and make decisions with confidence    Spotting opportunities for growth, expansion, and deeper platform adoption    You’ll also play an important role internally, bringing the voice of the customer back into the business by sharing customer feedback and market insights with Product, Marketing, and Sales.        And because we’re a startup, we’re always looking for smarter ways to work. We’re especially excited by people who are AI curious - whether that’s using tools to identify patterns, improve customer communications, or deliver insight more efficiently at scale.       Who we're looking for    This role is ideal for someone ready for a new challenge beyond traditional FMCG marketing. Someone who loves insight, relationships, and strategic thinking, but wants broader impact and faster pace.       Ideally, you’ll bring:     5+ years in FMCG marketing, ideally at Brand Manager level    Hands-on experience working with consumer research and insight    Strong storytelling and communication skills - you can simplify complexity and make data meaningful    Confidence building relationships and becoming a trusted advisor    Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle multiple priorities    A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset    Comfort working in ambiguity and evolving environments    Curiosity about AI and new ways

title: Customer Service Manager
description: 🚀 Join the Wowcher Team - We're Hiring a Customer Service Manager 🚀       Location:  Derby (Embrace the office vibes – 4 days a week!)      Salary:  Up to £33,000 + Benefits     Are you a ready to dive into the world of WOW? Established in 2011, Wowcher is the ultimate destination for unbeatable deals and unforgettable experiences in the UK.     We’ve helped thousands of people learn dog grooming, steam clean their front rooms, obtain the latest gadgets, whiten their teeth, decorate their houses, eat more healthily and even be more experimental in the bedroom…! On top of this we’ve also partnered with some of the UK’s leading brands including Graze, Build-a-Bear Workshop, Odeon, Fitness First, Diet Chef, Very.co.uk, PrettyLittleThing, Random House, EasyJet and Ocado... to name just a few!     We’re entrepreneurs at heart and love to spot a great deal! If you’re interested in being able to have a major impact on a successful, fast growing company from day 1, then read on!      Your Mission:   This manager will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of our merchant services department. You will take ownership of all escalated queries and complaints into the department and will be responsible for handling the more complex tasks sent through the team, along with team reporting across a variety of channels. In this position, you will lead a small team and ensure that all departments are working together to achieve our goals. In addition to this you will help assist with the day-to-day team tasks across both teams, providing support to other team members, and assisting them with the day-to-day volume and queries. You’ll also be responsible for reviewing practices, identifying potential risks, maintaining team knowledge and reporting.      Your Tasks Include:    Conduct thorough analysis of refund data, leading meetings to address discrepancies and drive resolution.  Make strategic decisions to optimise customer satisfaction and service quality based on insights gained from data analysis.  Ensure strict adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within both merchant and customer services, ensuring timely and efficient issue resolution.  Develop and elevate Net Promoter Scores (NPS) for merchants, fostering strong relationships and loyalty.  Lead and manage a team of employees, providing guidance and support as needed.  Proactively identify and address potential gaps in service delivery through forward planning.  Analyse data and make recommendations for improvements to processes, procedures, and systems mainly including an overview of results within customer service.  Handle customer complaints promptly and professionally, aiming for swift resolution and customer satisfaction.  Collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to ensure that business needs are being met.  Assist sales teams during merchant meetings by addressing service-related inquiries or concerns, ensuring seamless support and alignment with business goals.

description: Faire vivre une expérience mémorable au public vous passionne? Vous aimez autant les chiffres que les relations humaines? Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre leadership, votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité à améliorer les façons de faire? Ce poste est peut-être pour vous!   Le Théâtre de la Ville est à la recherche d'un(e)** Responsable de la billetterie et de l'expérience client** afin de diriger les opérations de son service de billetterie et de contribuer à offrir une expérience client exemplaire à chaque étape du parcours de nos spectateurs.      Votre rôle   Vous assurez le bon fonctionnement de la billetterie, supervisez une équipe de préposé(e)s et veillez à offrir un service à la clientèle de grande qualité. Vos principales responsabilités   • Assurer la gestion quotidienne des opérations de billetterie et du service à la clientèle;  • Superviser, mobiliser et accompagner l'équipe de la billetterie;  • Coordonner les mises en vente des spectacles et événements;  • Agir comme personne-ressource pour le système de billetterie (Tuxedo);  • Analyser les ventes, produire des rapports et soutenir la prise de décision;  • Collaborer avec les équipes de programmation, communications, locations, philanthropie et accueil afin d'assurer une expérience client fluide et cohérente;  • Participer au développement de stratégies favorisant la fidélisation, l'abonnement et l'amélioration continue de l'expérience des publics. Vous vous démarquez par :   • votre leadership mobilisateur;  • votre excellent sens de l'organisation;  • votre capacité d'analyse et votre aisance avec les données;  • votre approche orientée vers les solutions et l'amélioration continue;  • votre intérêt marqué pour les arts de la scène et le service au public.  Une bonne connaissance des outils Microsoft Office est requise. L'expérience avec un logiciel de billetterie (notamment Tuxedo) constitue un atout, tout comme une connaissance du milieu culturel.      Conditions   • Poste permanent à temps plein (35 heures/semaine);  • Horaire principalement de jour, du lundi au vendredi;  • Présence occasionnelle requise en soirée et les fins de semaine selon les activités.  • Avantages sociaux distinctifs (dont des assurances et une généreuse politique de vacances)      Qui sommes-nous   Depuis 36 ans, le Théâtre de la Ville participe activement à la vie culturelle de Longueuil et de la Rive-Sud en proposant à la population une grande variété de spectacles. description: Om jobbet   Er du struktureret, serviceminded og god til at få kunder og processer til at spille sammen?  Hos Hudevad Radiator Design søger vi en Customer Service Manager til vores nye kontor og showroom i København.  Du bliver et centralt bindeled mellem vores kunder, salg og resten af organisationen og får ansvar for, at kundehenvendelser og ordrer håndteres professionelt og effektivt fra første kontakt til endelig levering.  Størstedelen af din hverdag vil være centreret omkring vores danske kunder, men da Hudevad også opererer internationalt, vil du desuden få kontakt med udenlandske kunder og håndtere eksportordrer.  Vores gode og faste kollega gennem mange år har søgt nye græsgange, og vi leder derfor efter dig, der har lyst til at tage over og samtidig være med til at forme og udvikle rollen.      Din rolle   Som Customer Service Manager er du en vigtig del af den daglige kundekontakt og det kommercielle team. Du trives med at have mange bolde i luften og kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når telefonen ringer, ordren skal følges op, og en kunde har brug for et hurtigt svar.  Du har stærke kommunikationsevner og naturlig flair for at skabe gode relationer. Du kan sætte dig i kundens sted og finde løsninger, men kan også stå fast og kommunikere professionelt, når situationen kræver det.  Samtidig er du IT-stærk og har nemt ved at sætte dig ind i nye programmer og systemer.      Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er at   • håndtere kundehenvendelser professionelt og personligt via telefon og e-mail  • koordinere og følge op på ordrer fra bestilling til levering  • hjælpe kunder med information om produkter, priser og leverancer  • håndtere internationale kunder og eksportordrer  • samarbejde tæt med salg og øvrige kolleger om kunder og projekter  • følge op på leverancer og løse eventuelle udfordringer undervejs  • bidrage til at optimere arbejdsgange og processer inden for kundeservice og ordrehåndtering.     Vi er en mindre organisation, så der vil også opstå opgaver, som ikke nødvendigvis står i jobbeskrivelsen. Det ser vi som en naturlig og spændende del af jobbet.      Hvem er du?   Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre afgørende end din erfaring og måde at arbejde på.  Du har sandsynligvis erfaring fra kundeservice, salgsadministration, ordrebehandling, intern salgssupport eller en lignende B2B-funktion.  Det vigtigste er, at du brænder for god kundeservice, arbejder struktureret og trives som det bindeled, der får kunder, administration, logistik og salg til at hænge sammen. The Client Relationship Manager (CRM) possesses a good understanding of financial products and services and focuses on delivering the full bank offering and driving primacy in relationships with our clients. They are responsible for identifying prospects in target markets and managing a client portfolio of standard to moderate complexity. This includes developing robust sales pipelines, engaging in client planning activities with partners, conducting sales calls and qualifying opportunities based on client needs and a high level of due diligence. The role is specific to the Growth segment of Canadian Commercial Banking, which includes clients with annual sales between $5MM-$25MM and credit authorizations from $1MM-$5MM.   Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:         Partner with Credit Solution Associate on credit portfolio for authorizations up to $5MM.   Partnering with Service team to ensure satisfactory onboarding of clients.   These clients will be both borrowing (under $5MM) and non-borrowing. Borrowing Clients typically have standard to moderate complexity financial solutions.   Have a strong business development and communication skills to manage client, market and internal partner relationships.   You will interact primarily with various internal partners which include Global Transaction Banking, Business Banking, Retail, Wealth Management, Global Banking and Markets, Cash Management Contact Centre, and could include other partners on occasion such as Global Risk Management, the Business Banking Operations, Enhanced Due Diligence Unit CRA, as well as the Canadian Commercial Banking Executive Office.   Promote the development and profitable growth of the Canadian Commercial Banking portfolio in the assigned market area.   As the CRM you will be responsible for conducting sales planning activities, executing on business development strategies and building relationships with partners and both existing and new clients. Also responsible for initial analysis and continuing to work in collaboration with credit team on completion of credit applications.      Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role?         If you have a strong proven experience pursuing a business development program within an assigned market area.   Previous work experience of at least two to four years, within commercial banking, and business development.   Have a proven record of strong sales/closing skills.   Have a strong market network.   Top notch negotiation skills.   Good commercial credit skills.   Strong knowledge of Bank’s commercial lending and deposit products and services, and customer profitability model, to provide integrated financial solutions.   Ability to travel within the assigned territory as well as having access to a vehicle.         What's in it for you?         Be part of

title: Account Manager - THG Commerce
description: About THG Ingenuity   THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.  Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.   Position: Account Manager – Commerce   THG Ingenuity Commerce play a key role in delivering world-class ecommerce solutions for globally recognised brands. As part of a fast-paced, high-growth environment, you’ll work at the intersection of technology, digital, and client services to drive performance and unlock commercial value. This is an opportunity to build strong client partnerships while shaping the future of online retail.   Key Responsibilities    Relationship Management:  Own a portfolio of Commerce client relationships, ensuring alignment on key partnership goals and objectives. Maintain regular, proactive communication, building strong trust with stakeholders and ensuring any challenges are surfaced and resolved transparently. Act as the strategic voice of the client internally.   Account Management & Growth:  Develop a deep understanding of each client’s ecommerce business to identify and drive organic growth opportunities across digital and platform services. Lead conversations around account expansion, renewals, and long-term partnership development.   Performance & Reporting:  Oversee performance across accounts, ensuring KPIs are tracked and communicated clearly to clients. Provide insight-led reporting that demonstrates value, identifies risks, and supports strategic decision-making.   Escalation Management:  Own senior-level escalations, ensuring issues are managed effectively and resolved in partnership with internal teams. Maintain client confidence through clear and proactive communication.   Change Management:  Oversee change requests, ensuring appropriate approvals, documentation, and commercial considerations are managed effectively.   Commercial Ownership & P&L Awareness:  Maintain a strong understanding of account commercial performance, including revenue, cost drivers, and margin. Proactively identify risks or opportunities and escalate where needed to protect and grow account value.   Data & Insight:  Leverage ecommerce data (e.g. trading performance, customer behaviour, conversion metrics) to provide strategic recommendations and strengthen client partnerships.   Internal Collaboration:  Work cross-functionally with technology, digital, trading, and finance teams to deliver best-in-class ecommerce solutions. Act as a senior bridge between client needs and internal delivery.   Requirements     Proven experience in Account Management / Client Services within ecommerce, digital, or related environments   Strong stakeholder management

title: Key Account Manager – Utility-Scale BESS
description: Job Title: Key Account Manager – Utility-Scale ME BESS    Location: Dubai, UAE    Reports to: Regional GM     Job Summary:   The Key Account Manager for Utility-Scale BESS is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic clients in the energy sector. The KAM will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying client needs and negotiating contracts to ensuring successful project delivery and after-sales support. The role involves close coordination with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored energy storage solutions that meet client expectations and align with company goals.   Key Responsibilities:     Client Relationship Management:   Build and nurture strong relationships with key decision-makers in targeted clients, including developers, IPPs, EPC firms, utilities, and the governmental sector.  Act as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, addressing their needs and ensuring customer satisfaction.   Sales and Business Development:   Identify new business opportunities, focusing on utilities, IPPs, EPCs, and developers in the renewable energy sector  Independently lead the entire sales cycle, from lead generation and proposal development to contract negotiation and closure.  Achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth by upselling and cross-selling additional products and services.  Early engagement with clients to understand their challenges and issues and convert it into opportunity   Product Knowledge and Technical Expertise:   Stay updated on BESS technologies, market trends, and regulatory changes affecting the energy storage industry.  Provide clients with detailed information about the technical aspects and benefits of BESS solutions, ensuring that products meet customer needs.  Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, and workshops to showcase BESS capabilities and advantages   Market Intelligence and Strategy:   Analyse market trends, client requirements, and competitor activities to shape sales strategies and product offerings.  Contribute to the development of strategic initiatives aimed at increasing market penetration and client retention.   Reporting and Documentation:   Prepare an account plan and present regular reports on account activities, sales forecasts, and customer feedback to senior management.  Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, client communications, and contractual obligations in CRM systems.   Cross-functional Collaboration:   Work closely with product management, pre-sales, marketing, and customer service teams to align client needs with business offerings.  Provide feedback to internal teams on customer demands and emerging market trends to support product development and innovation.    Qualifications:    Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Renewable Energy, or related field.  Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in sales, account management, or business development, preferably within the renewable energy or energy storage sect

title: Customer Success Manager (H/F)
description: À propos d'Avest      Avest est une solution SaaS dopée à l'IA alliant CRM et génération de leads.     En quelques années, notre produit a conquis  plus de 400 agences immobilières , en France, en Suisse, au Luxembourg et en Belgique, et  plus de 3 500 professionnels de l'immobilier  l'utilisent aujourd'hui au quotidien. Nous poursuivons une forte croissance pour consolider notre position de référence des solutions digitales des agences immobilières.     Nos fondateurs (Centrale Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, Berkeley) ont plus de 15 ans d'expérience, passés par des cabinets de conseil de premier plan (McKinsey, Roland Berger), par des startups à succès et par l'entrepreneuriat.     Nous sommes une vingtaine dans l'équipe, avec de nombreux profils expérimentés du secteur de la tech (ex-Doctolib, ex-Auto1, ex-Groupon) et de l'immobilier (anciens agents et directeurs d'agence).     Notre ambition ? Transformer (véritablement) l'immobilier grâce à la data et à l'IA.      🌟 Ton rôle      Tu rejoins l'équipe Success, au contact quotidien des agences qui utilisent Avest.     Tu prends la responsabilité d'un portefeuille de clients, aux côtés de 3 autres Customer Success Managers et  en lien direct avec Louis, cofondateur  : dans une équipe de cette taille, tu as un fondateur à portée de main.      L'enjeu du poste  : notre solution est au cœur de l'activité des agences qui l'utilisent. La façon dont elles s'en servent pèse directement sur leurs résultats, et c'est là que tu interviens. Tu as un rôle essentiel dans la réussite de nos clients.     C'est un poste de  relation dans la durée , pas de support : tu n'attends pas qu'on te sollicite, tu prends des nouvelles.      📋 Tes missions     Connaître tes clients pour de vrai  : leur marché, leurs équipes, leurs objectifs et leurs résultats.   Repérer l'agence qui n'obtient pas les résultats qu'elle mérite , comprendre ce qui coince, et l'accompagner jusqu'à ce qu'elle reparte.   Faire monter les équipes des clients en compétence  sur l'outil, par téléphone et en visio.   T'assurer que leur paramétrage sert leur réussite , et l'ajuster quand ce n'est pas le cas.   Porter la voix de nos clients  auprès des équipes produit et marketing, et contribuer à ce qu'on construit pour eux.       🔎 Le profil     Une première expérience réussie en Customer Success , en relation client B2B ou en gestion de portefeuille.   De l'aisance au téléphone face à des dirigeants de TPE et de PME.  C'est le cœur du quotidien, pas une compétence secondaire.   De l'autonomie et de la régularité  : en télétravail, un poste se juge autant sur la constance que sur les coups d'éclat.   De la pédagogie  : savoir expliquer un outil à quelqu'un qui n'est pas technicien, sans le perdre.   De la curiosité pour l'immobilier et pour la tech.  Avoir travaillé dans l'immobilier est un vrai plus, pas un prérequis.       🚫 Ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi si     Tu cherches un poste de support  où l'on traite des tickets entrants.   Décrocher to

title: Senior Direct Sales & Operations Manager
location: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for den operationelle motor i Coloplasts Fritvalgsordning og Direct-forretning?   Hos Coloplast Danmark, Consumer & Direct-teamet søger vi en Senior Direct Sales & Operations Manager, der kan sikre, at vores kunder oplever personlig, respektfuld og exceptionel service gennem hele deres rejse med os, samtidig med at vi skaber resultater gennem effektiv drift, stærke processer og høj operationel kvalitet.  Du får ansvaret for vores Fritvalgsordning-team og bliver en central del af Consumer & Direct-ledelsen. Sammen med teamet skal du sikre, at vores kunder oplever professionel, personlig og tryg støtte gennem hele deres rejse med os, fra første kontakt til ordre, levering og den løbende support i hverdagen. Samtidig skal du sikre, at vores processer, systemer og arbejdsgange understøtter både en exceptionel kundeoplevelse og forretningens mål.  Dette er en rolle for dig, der trives med at være tæt på driften, tage ansvar for resultaterne og skabe forbedringer gennem mennesker, data og stærke processer.   Velkommen til Coloplast Danmark   I Coloplast Danmark gør vi en reel forskel for mennesker med intime sundhedsbehov, og som markedsleder arbejder vi målrettet og innovativt for at løfte behandlingsstandarden.  Vi er det danske datterselskab i Coloplast-koncernen med ca. 50 ansatte fordelt på marketing, salg, udbud, finans og kundeservice. Vi er et motiveret og dynamisk team med en travl hverdag, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og kundefokus er centrale værdier.  Du får en central rolle i Consumer & Direct-teamet, som består af 18 engagerede og erfarne kollegaer, som arbejder hver dag med at skabe tryghed og løsninger for vores kunder. Du kommer til at referere til Head of Consumer & Direct og får base samt hovedarbejdssted i Humlebæk, hvor vi deler adresse med vores globale hovedkontor. title: 상담팀 리드 (토스플랫폼 전담팀)
description: 합류하게 될 포지션에 대해 알려드려요    토스씨엑스는 '토스'를 운영하는 비바리퍼블리카의 금융 상담 전문 계열사예요. 금융 상담부터 지식서비스 기반의 운영성 업무까지, 500명 이상의 동료가 함께 만들어가고 있어요.  코어CX팀은 토스 앱의 핵심 서비스 전반에 대한 상담을 전담하는 팀이에요. 스쿼드 단위로 상담 조직을 운영하고 있고, 새로운 동료가 빠르게 적응하고 성장할 수 있도록 촘촘한 온보딩과 피플매니징 체계를 갖추고 있어요.  이탈 발생 시 즉각적으로 대체 인력을 배치하는 신속 대응 프로세스를 운영하며, 변화가 잦은 환경에서도 안정적인 상담 품질을 유지하는 데 강점이 있는 팀이에요.    합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요    스쿼드 운영 및 인력 관리  스쿼드 단위 Action Plan을 수립하고, 업무 분장과 진행 상황을 관리해요.  적정 인원을 산정해 스케줄링·스태핑을 운영하고, 충원 및 인원 변동사항을 관리해요.  지표 관리 및 실시간 이슈 대응  인입호·응답률·생산성 등 실시간 지표를 확인하고 성과 추이를 분석해요.  실시간 발생하는 이슈를 파악해 대응 방향을 고안하고, 유의미한 이슈는 VOC로 전달 및 후속 조치를 취해요.  피플 매니징  스쿼드에 배치된 신규 입사자/전환자의 온보딩을 리딩해요.  1:1 코칭, 동기부여, 갈등 해결 등 정서관리를 수행해요.  상담 품질 관리 (모니터링)  1차 응대에서 해결되지 않은 민원을 이관받아 원인을 파악하고 해결 방향을 제시해요.  상담원의 응대 품질을 모니터링하고 구체적인 피드백으로 코칭해요.    이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    인하우스 혹은 BPO 상담/CX 조직에서 팀원 관리(피플매니징) 경험이 2년 이상인 분을 찾고 있어요.  지표 기반으로 팀을 운영해본 경험(KPI 모니터링, 스케줄링 등)이 있는 분을 찾고 있어요.  신규 입사자 온보딩 또는 1:1 코칭을 직접 리딩해본 경험이 필요해요.  2차 민원(에스컬레이션) 대응 경험이 있다면 좋아요.  QA·모니터링 기반 상담 코칭 경험이 있다면 좋아요.    이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요    피플매니징 경험을 구체적으로 작성해 주세요. 관리했던 인원 규모, 온보딩·코칭 방식 등을 함께 적어주시면 좋아요.  지표를 개선한 경험이 있다면, 어떤 지표를 어떻게 개선했는지 수치로 보여주세요.  2차 민원이나 이슈를 직접 해결한 사례가 있다면 꼭 포함해 주세요.  유사 도메인 경험이 없다면, 팀/조직을 운영하며 발휘한 문제 해결 방식 위주로 서술해 주세요.    꼭 확인해 주세요    신도림 본사에서 근무하는 포지션이에요. (신도림역 디큐브시티)  이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스씨엑스 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소 될 수 있어요.    토스씨엑스로의 합류 여정    서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종합격 및 입사    함께할 동료를 위한 한 마디   "팀원들의 성장, 그리고 조직의 생산성을 함께 고민해요."   팀원의 성장과 고객의 만족, 그 사이에서 균형을 잡는 일. 토스씨엑스에서 상담 조직의 새로운 기준을 함께 세워갈 코어CX팀의 리드를 기다립니다.

Dafür denken wir die Jobsuche neu - so wie sie mit heutiger Technologie denkbar geworden ist. #xingjob      Was Dich Bei Uns Erwartet    Eine sinnstiftende Rolle mit Impact: Du hilfst Teams, Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen besser zu arbeiten  Starker Wissenstransfer & strukturiertes Onboarding - du lernst viel, schnell & praxisnah  Schnelle Lernkurve im Bereich Business, digitale Produktkommunikation & B2B SaaS  Intensive Zusammenarbeit im Team: Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Sales, Customer Success & AE-Teams - auf Augenhöhe, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert  Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung mit Zugang zu internen Trainings & Learning-Angeboten  Ein kollegiales, offenes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum  Hybrides Arbeiten mit modernem Office  Ein transparentes, zielbasiertes Bonussystem      Egal, woher du kommst, an was Du glaubst und wen Du liebst - bei uns bist Du herzlich willkommen. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass uns Vielfalt, Diversität und Inklusion besser und kreativer machen. Am Ende zählt bei uns immer nur eines: Du als Mensch.      Deine Aufgaben    Als Customer Enablement Manager:in bei XING bist Du zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in und Schnittstelle für unsere Kund:innen - zwischen Kund:innen, Sales & Produktmanagement - rund um unsere Recruiting-Lösungen, mit Fokus auf Stellenanzeigen und den XING TalentManager.  Du betreust und berätst eigenverantwortlich ein festes Kundenportfolio (u. a. KMUs, Personaldienstleister und -berater) und stellst sicher, dass unsere Recruiting-Produkte optimal eingesetzt und genutzt werden.  Dabei begleitest Du Kund:innen über die gesamte Customer Journey und sorgst für eine langfristige, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit.  Du analysierst Performancedaten (z. B. Reichweite, Klicks, Bewerbungen) und triffst Ableitungen für konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen.  Du identifizierst Up- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales.  Systematisches Sammeln von Kundenfeedback und aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte sind ein Teil Deiner Aufgaben, immer mit dem Fokus auf die Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit       Das Bringst Du Mit    Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung  Berufserfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder in der B2B-Kundenberatung  Erfahrungen im Personalbereich oder in der HR- / Recruiting-Branche sind ein Plus  Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie Freude am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen  Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen  Analytisches Verständnis und sicherer Umgang mit datenbasierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen  Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise  Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse       Deine Benefits    Beratungs­leistun

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Working at Mercell   At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.  With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.  Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.      Your Mission    As a Customer Success Manager at Mercell, you'll own a portfolio of supplier customers across Europe with a focus on the Swedish market, the businesses who rely on our platform to discover, access, and win public tenders. Your mission is to make sure they get real, measurable value from Mercell every single day.  That means building genuine relationships and becoming a trusted partner your customers turn to; spotting the early signals of churn and acting before it happens; and uncovering the moments where customers are ready to grow, so you can open the door to new opportunities. Above all, you'll be the person who ensures every customer in your portfolio realises the full potential of what Mercell can do for them helping them win more, work smarter, and see us as essential to their success.  If you're energised by ownership, thrive on building lasting relationships, and love turning satisfied customers into genuine advocates, this is a role where you'll see the impact of your work directly in retention, in growth, and in the success of the customers you champion.      Core Responsibilities     Own and resolve defined categories of customer issues raised via HubSpot, Jira, or similar systems (e.g. onboarding, billing questions, contract terms, access issues, product transitions).  Assess, prioritize, and resolve cases efficiently and consistently based on established processes.  Ensure cases are handled according to approved playbooks, policies, and best practices.  Deliver low-touch, structured customer engagement through standardized responses, templates, and automated touchpoints.  Guide customers to relevant self-service resources, documentation, and training materials to encourage independence and adoption.       Required Qualifications     Experience (ideally 2-3 years) in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, Operations, or another client-facing SaaS role.  Strong ability to build deep knowledge within defined functional or product areas.  Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely. title: Programme Manager - Growth and Development Improvement Plan

Success in this role will require exceptional relationship-building skills, strong commercial and strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex environments where outcomes depend on influence, collaboration and shared ownership. title: Customer Service Co-ordinator
description: Customer Service Co-ordinator  £28,574 plus excellent benefits (Work Level 6C) Full-time, 37.5 hours (Monday to Friday) Scunthorpe (hybrid working - you'll spend a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with the remainder of the time from home. You'll work approximately 2 Saturdays per month and be on a bank holiday rota)     Co-op Wholesale is growing, and we're looking for talented people who want to help shape what comes next. As a Customer Service Co-ordinator in our Partner Support team, you'll look after the daily running of our Helpdesk. We'll look to you to manage our inboxes and delegate work effectively across the team, making sure we're equipped with the training and support needed to deliver a 'best in class' service to our wholesale partners.      Why this role matters      Exciting things are happening at Co-op Wholesale. We're growing fast, strengthening our offer for retailers, key accounts, and corporate partners, and we need great people to be part of our journey.     To make this offer the best it can be, we need to make sure we're supporting our partners in the right way, resolving issues and handling queries smoothly and effectively. We're proud of our 97% call pick-up rate, and you'll play a big part in helping us to be even better!      What you'll do       Manage our Helpdesk and reception inboxes, delegating tasks effectively across the team  Handle the more complex issues and queries raised by our wholesale partners  Support the training and development of team members to make sure we're always working in the best way possible  Look after the first stage of product recalls, and that all activity to resolve these issues are recorded  Monitor team performance to make sure we're always providing our partners with a high-quality service  Collaborate with our logistics partner, DHL, to investigate and monitor queries       What you'll bring      We're committed to making our roles as accessible as possible, so we only ask for the minimum criteria. To thrive here, you'll need to bring:      Experience providing excellent customer service  Experience training, mentoring, and/or coaching team members  Strong IT skills  Great problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities  The ability to create clear, user-friendly process guides  Good communication and relationship-building skills       Why Co-op? We're an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we're powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you'll also receive:      An annual bonus (based on personal and business performance)  28 days holiday (rising to 32 with service) plus bank holidays  A pension with up to 10% employer contributions  30% discount on Co-op products and 10% off other brands  Stream - early access to a percen

title: AI Support Delivery Manager: Customer Care
description: We power people’s progress.   At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.  We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.  Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.   Meet the team!   AI is no longer a side customer support channel at Preply, it is one of the main ones. Our customer-facing AI chatbot already handles most of our lower complexity support conversations, and we are doubling down on AI as the primary way learners and tutors get help. As AI becomes central to how support works, the shape of the team behind it has to change too: from one that answers questions to one that designs and continuously improves the system that answers them.  To do this well, we are building a dedicated AI chatbot team within Customer Care, structured around the four foundational roles needed to make AI agents perform: AI Operations, Knowledge Management, Conversation Design, and Support Automation. As AI Support Delivery Manager (Customer Care), you will lead this team end-to-end, the equivalent of an AI Operations Lead with full ownership of the function. You will report directly to the Director of Customer Care and manage AI Operations / Automation Specialists, AI Content Knowledge Managers, and also get direct support and coverage from the Customer Care product, engineering, and design teams.  This is a player-coach role. You will roll up your sleeves to analyze AI performance, refine content, and debug handoffs, while also coaching the team through an entirely new way of working. You will treat the AI Agent/Chatbot as a teammate to manage and a product to improve, not just a tool to monitor. Your immediate focus is to elevate the Customer Care chatbot, improving resolution and deflection, but above all the quality and customer experience of every AI interaction. Over time, you will expand into more proactive AI agents/chatbot (built on Intercom FinAI and similar platforms) for use cases beyond reactive support.   What You’ll Be Doing     Own the end-to-end performance of Preply's customer-facing AI agents/chatbot: resolution rate, deflection, and most importantly the quality and CX of every AI conversation  Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team across the four pillars of AI agent performance: AI Operations, Knowledge Managemen

title: Quality Manager
description: Job Summary   The  Quality Manager  is responsible for developing, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the organization’s healthcare quality and patient safety systems. The role ensures compliance with applicable  healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, clinical policies, quality indicators, patient safety requirements, and internal procedures . The Quality Manager works closely with clinical and non-clinical departments to identify risks, monitor performance, conduct audits, investigate incidents, implement corrective and preventive actions, and promote a culture of continuous quality improvement. Should be familiar with  DHA requirements  as well as relevant international accreditation standards. DHA maintains healthcare standards, inspection checklists, performance measures, and regulatory requirements for licensed facilities. Develop annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.  Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.  Maintain quality policies, procedures, guidelines, forms, and controlled documents.  Ensure effective document control and version management.  Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement across all departments.   Patient Safety & Risk Management  Lead patient safety initiatives and risk-reduction programs.  Monitor and analyze patient safety incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, complaints, and clinical risks.  Coordinate incident investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Prepare audit reports and follow up on action plans.  Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions. Analyze trends, variances, and performance gaps.  Present quality performance to senior management and relevant committees.  Use data to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. title: Business Development Director
description:
Do you have the right sales skills to win new business for LanguageWire and at the same time contribute to our growth trajectory? Yes? You should definitely read on!

The role you’ll play 

The Business Development Director will be a key factor in our current growth. The ideal candidate will work across our ecosystem of technology and services to deliver high value solutions to enterprise clients. You will have a consultative mindset and be comfortable managing the large volume of inbound requests we receive as well as cold contacting new prospects up to C-Level stakeholders. 

You’ll be given the training, tools and solutions to target and approach prospective clients, highlight the value of our ecosystem and convert them from prospect to customer.

You’ll have a crucial role in our LanguageWire Business Development Team for the DACH region and be a key driver of our business in your country. You’ll interact with local colleagues in your branch office, but you will also work with colleagues across our value chain up to the C-Team. 

 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by…

  • Creating leads by researching prospective clients through a mix of strategies 
  • Outreach & follow up prospects & new clients 
  • Representing LanguageWire at commercial events/trade fairs/thought leadership occasions 
  • Pipeline management & forecasting of revenues

title: Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
description:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.

Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Position Summary

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.

Je schakelt dagelijks met leveranciers, supply chain, purchasing en productie om ervoor te zorgen dat producten, specificaties, labels en documentatie voldoen aan alle kwaliteitseisen binnen food & supplements. title: Lead Quality Engineer
description: Duetto's quality engineering function is being built from the ground up — and this is the role that defines what it becomes. As Lead Quality Engineer, you'll architect the test automation infrastructure, quality gate logic, and shared tooling that make high-quality testing the path of least resistance for every engineering team. You'll be operating in a system actively in transformation: a live monolith-to-microservices migration, a consolidation to Playwright, and a codebase where 50–70% of code is AI-generated at scale. If you're a senior quality engineer who leads with coaching rather than gatekeeping and thrives on building things that last, this is your role.   What Makes Us Different?   Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.   What You'll Be Doing    You'll architect quality gate logic within GitHub Actions CI pipelines — defining coverage thresholds, mutation score gates, contract test enforcement, flaky test quarantine rules, and automated result reporting — and build DataDog quality dashboards tracking test health, coverage trends, and flaky test rates across the engineering organisation.  You'll spearhead the migration from Selenium and Cypress to a consolidated Playwright framework — owning the shared configuration, CI sharding strategy, and page object library design — while driving PR pipeline test execution toward the P90 target of under 15 minutes through systematic flakiness reduction and pipeline optimisation.  You'll design and implement Pact contract testing for service boundaries created during the monolith-to-microservices extraction — managing the Pact broker, establishing consumer-driven contract testing as standard practice, and owning API contract testing across service boundaries.  You'll design and maintain Testcontainers configurations for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, LocalStack, and RabbitMQ to support reliable, reproducible integration test environments across the engineering organisation.  You'll champion AI-augmented testing practices using Claude Code, CodeRabbit, and Augment — accelerating test generation, migration, and review at scale, and evaluating AI-generated test code for correctness, coverage gap

Vi går for en rettferdig

title: Loyalty Manager
description: Loyalty Lead hos BIBS Danmark      Vil du være med til at skabe verdens bedste kundeoplevelse for forældre og familier?     Hos BIBS søger vi en ambitiøs og kommerciel Loyalty Lead, som får ansvaret for at udvikle og drive vores globale loyalitetsprogram på tværs af markeder.  Rollen er central i vores Direct-to-Consumer-strategi og skal sikre, at endnu flere kunder vælger BIBS igen og igen gennem stærke medlemsfordele, personaliseret kommunikation og en enestående kundeoplevelse.     Du bliver en del af vores E-commerce-team og får stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi opbygger langsigtede relationer med vores kunder verden over.      Om rollen:   Som Loyalty Lead bliver du ansvarlig for at udvikle og eksekvere BIBS' globale loyalty-strategi. Du skal skabe et medlemsunivers, der styrker engagement og øger kundernes livstidsværdi.  Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med E-commerce, CRM, Marketing, Customer Care og vores lokale markeder for at sikre en sammenhængende og datadrevet kundeoplevelse.      Dine primære ansvarsområder   • Eje og udvikle BIBS' loyalty-program og medlemsunivers  • Definere og implementere loyalty-strategi på tværs af markeder  • Drive medlemsrekruttering, engagement og retention  • Udvikle medlemsfordele, kampagner og eksklusive oplevelser  • Sikre en stærk integration mellem loyalty-program, webshop og CRM-platform  • Analysere kundeadfærd og identificere muligheder for at øge Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)  • Udvikle segmenterings- og personaliseringsstrategier  • Definere KPI'er og rapportere på programmets performance  • Drive A/B-tests og løbende optimering af medlemsoplevelsen  • Være intern ekspert på loyalty, retention og customer lifecycle management      Hvem er du?    Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med loyalty, CRM eller retention marketing fra en international e-commerce- eller forbrugervirksomhed.  Du kombinerer kommerciel forståelse med stærke analytiske evner og motiveres af at skabe målbare resultater gennem kundeindsigt og personalisering.      Vi ser gerne, at du har   • 2-3 års erfaring inden for loyalty, CRM, retention eller customer lifecycle marketing  • Erfaring med e-commerce og DTC-forretninger  • Dokumenteret erfaring med at drive eller udvikle loyalty-programmer  • Stærke analytiske kompetencer og erfaring med datadrevet beslutningstagning  • Forståelse for kundesegmentering, personalisering og customer journeys  • Erfaring med at arbejde på tværs af markeder  • Flydende engelsk i skrift og tale      Hvad tilbyder vi?    Hos BIBS bliver du en del af en international vækstrejse med stærke ambitioner og et klart formål: at skabe produkter af høj kvalitet til de mindste og deres familier.      Vi tilbyder:   • En nøgleposition i vores globale DTC- og e-commerce-team  • Mulighed for at forme og udvikle et loyalty-program med stor strategisk betydning  • Et internationalt og entreprenant arbejdsmiljø  • Dygtige kolleger med passion for brand, digital vækst og kundeoplevelser      Om BIBS    BIBS er et dan

Du bliver deres faste kontaktperson og følger dem hele vejen – fra den kommercielle overdragelse og implementering til den daglige sparring, udvikling af samarbejdet og løbende optimering.  Du sikrer, at nye kunder og partnere kommer godt fra start ved både at konfigurere deres løsning, facilitere implementeringen og rådgive om den optimale opsætning. Samtidig arbejder du proaktivt med at skabe værdi, styrke relationerne og identificere nye muligheder for at udvikle samarbejdet.  Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i Sales, Support, Product og Engineering for at sikre, at kunder og partnere får en sammenhængende oplevelse – hver gang.   Dine Arbejdsopgaver   Du kommer blandt andet til at:    Onboarde nye kunder og partnere – fra overdragelse til Go Live. Være teknisk sparringspartner for både IT-afdelinger og forretningsansvarlige.  Understøtte integrationer og tekniske implementeringer samt koordinere komplekse leverancer.  Drive kontraktfornyelser samt identificere muligheder for mersalg og udvikling af samarbejdet.  Opbygge og udvikle stærke, langvarige relationer med både kunder og partnere.  Koordinere leverancer og sikre fremdrift på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter.  Følge op på kundetilfredshed og sikre, at kunder og partnere får maksimal værdi af Telavox. Kraftig vekst siden lansering har gitt oss 3,000 bedriftskunder i hele Norge  Kontor midt i Oslo sentrum sammen med resten av Dr.Dropin-gruppen (flytter fra Majorstuen til Posthuset i desember), med tette bånd til gründermiljøet i Askeladden & Co    Vi er et scaleup i høyt tempo, uformelt og med stor drivkraft. Her får du prege kultur og utvikling i en virksomhet med store vekstambisjoner. Vi bryr oss mer om hva du oppnår enn hvordan du kommer dit, gir deg stor frihet i arbeidsmetode og heier på deg hele veien.  Om Sykefraværshjelpen  Sykefravær er en av Norges største samfunnsutfordringer. Problemet ligger ofte i mangelfullt samspill mellom leder og ansatt: ansatte kjenner ikke sine plikter, og ledere unngår vanskelige spørsmål i frykt for å trå feil. Resultatet er lengre og hyppigere sykefravær enn nødvendig.  Sykefraværshjelpen er et digitalt, interaktivt verktøy som gjør oppfølgingen enkel for ledere og ansatte, med bistand fra sykefraværsspesialister rett rundt hjørnet.  Verktøyet er live, med flere store bedrifter som står på vent for onboarding.  Du blir primær kundekontakt for konseptet, og den som har stålkontroll på kundebehov og customer-facing rutiner. I tillegg vil du samarbeide tett med kommersiell leder, strategileder, utviklerne og salgsteamet. Rollen innebærer ikke personalansvar i dag.  Dine arbeidsoppgaver  Dette er et nytt konsept og en ny rolle - så her får du være med å forme begge deler og veien blir til mens vi går! Her får du eie en funksjon i en satsning fra dag én - om 2 år kommer mye av måten Customer Success fungerer på til å være bygget av deg. Du blir personen som eier kundeopplevelsen og den operative riggen av et helt nytt produkt - fra onboarding av de de største selskapene i Norge, til CRM, AI-automatisering og utvikling av måten vi jobber på. Er du lei av en irriterende rutine, forventer vi ikke at du lærer deg å leve med den - vi forventer at du forbedrer den. Du blir kontaktpersonen som ivaretar og følger opp daglig leder eller HR-ansvarlig hos store bedriftskunder, og får fullt ansva

Ibland innebär det att svara på en enkel fråga, ibland att sätta sig in i ett mer tekniskt problem som kräver förståelse för våra system, flöden eller integrationer. Du arbetar också aktivt med att utveckla kundrelationerna över tid. title: Lead - Customer Service Knowledge Management
description: In short   As the inaugural Knowledge Manager Lead for Customer Service, you are the architect of On’s global information ecosystem during a period of rapid expansion. This mission-critical role empowers you to build and scale our knowledge strategy for Customer Service from scratch, establishing a canonical source of truth that fuels both human expertise and next-gen AI automation. You will design the workflows that ensure a seamless, premium experience across every market, driving operational excellence and shaping the future of our service organization. We are looking for a tech-savvy builder ready to leverage cutting-edge tools and create a lasting legacy within our world-class supply chain and support network.   Your mission    Global Strategy & Governance     Own and structure On’s global Customer Service Knowledge Management architecture, setting standard workflows and review cycles for all markets and contact channels.  Govern the full knowledge lifecycle—from intake and approval to publishing, versioning, and retirement.  Partner with BPO operations to bridge the gap between BPO training and central On knowledge governance.     Content Architecture & Omni Channel Alignment     Create, curate, and maintain concise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and advisor guides.  Apply a one canonical source, multiple controlled renders model across BPOs, markets, channels, and customer touch points. Your story     Customer Service Background: Solid operational background in Customer Service environments.  AI Tooling Experience: Habitual and proficient user of AI as a daily productivity assistant.  Knowledge Management & Structure Expertise: Proven ability to build and structure knowledge bases (e.g., Salesforce Knowledge) across channels and countries. Governance & Lifecycle Management: Ability to establish ownership models, content standards, approval workflows, review cycles, version control, and retirement processes.  Stakeholder & BPO Management: Strong collaborative skills to work across internal functions and external BPO partners globally.

title: Eftermarkedschef
location: Kolding, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Bring dit gode lederskab i spil og vær med til at sikre videre udvikling af vores eftermarkedsaktiviteter, høj kundetilfredshed og stærkt samarbejde.         ANSVAR FOR EFTERMARKEDET    Hos Bayern Autogroup i Kolding søger vi en Eftermarkedschef, hvor du får til ansvar at lede den daglige drift af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere på tværs af indskrivning, mekanisk værksted, reservedelslager og service satellit i Sønderborg. Gennem professionel rådgivning og service vil I sammen sikre høj effektivitet, kvalitet og kundetilfredshed.   Som budgetansvarlig for eftermarkedet vil du i tæt samarbejde med vores erfarne værkstedschef på værkstedet og reservedelschef, stå for at kvalitetssikre de interne processer og det udførte arbejde. Du vil således blive ansvarlig for ikke blot at sikre opnåelsen af de fastsatte budgetmål, men også for at motivere teamet og bidrage til et stærkt samarbejde på tværs af afdelingerne.   Med reference til Eftermarkedsdirektøren for Bayern Autogroup, vil du ligeledes sammen med den lokale Salgschef, være ansvarlig for at drive lokationen og sikre stærkt samarbejde mellem salg og eftermarked.       TEKNISK STÆRK MED ET SKARPT OVERBLIK    Vi forestiller os du kommer fra en lignende stilling i autobranchen, hvor du har været vandt til at arbejde med planlægning og drift af en eftermarkedsafdeling. Alternativt kommer du fra en stilling som værkstedschef og er klar til det næste skridt i din karriere. Personligt besidder du et naturligt ledertalent og formår at samle og motivere et team til at præstere det ypperste for således at sikre høj effektivitet og god kundetilfredshed. Du er en synlig leder, og du forstår at udvikle både forretningen og medarbejdere.       HVAD KAN VI TILBYDE DIG?   Vores forhandlerkæde Bayern AutoGroup A/S har seks forretninger i Danmark, hvor målsætningen er at være de danske BMW & MINI entusiasters foretrukne bilforhandler. Din arbejdsplads vil blive i Kolding, hvor du vil blive en del af et bilhus med et godt internt samarbejde, og hvor dygtige og engagerede kolleger, ser frem til at tage godt imod dig.  Som medarbejder hos Bayern AutoGroup bliver du desuden en del af Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, en koncern i en rivende udvikling, hvor det daglige arbejde kredser rundt om biler og mobilitetsløsninger.   Sammen med dine cirka 1.600 kolleger i Danmark og Tyskland får du blandt andet adgang til:    Gode medarbejdervilkår med pension, sundhedsforsikring, flere årlige udviklingssamtaler og et arbejdsmiljø i topklasse   Uddannelse og træning - Vi investerer i vores medarbejderes fremtid med træningsprogrammer og mulighed for efteruddannelse  Teamkultur - Vi har en stærk teamånd, hvor samarbejde og kollegial støtte er i fokus og hvor vores værdier ordentlighed, ambition, sammenhold og passion skinner igennem, både i vores nærvær med kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere  Firmature og sociale arrangementer - Deltag i vores mange arrangementer, der styrker fællesskabet  Attraktive medarbejd

title: Customer Succes Manager Cashless
description: Ben jij klaar om je bureaustoel in te ruilen voor de mainstage?   De poorten gaan open. Tienduizenden bezoekers stromen binnen. Iedereen wil tegelijk naar binnen én een biertje halen. Het netwerk piept en kraakt, de spanning stijgt. Dit is het moment waar jij voor leeft.  Bij Weeztix zoeken we geen manager die vanaf de zijlijn toekijkt. Wij zoeken een Cashless Koning(in). Iemand die durft te pionieren met onze nieuwste features (Cashless, Access & Accreditatie) en zorgt dat onze klanten, van grote festivals en stadions tot intieme poppodia, vlekkeloos draaien.   Jouw Rol in de Spotlight   Dit is geen standaard kantoorbaan; dit is topsport. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het onboarden, trainen en ondersteunen van onze klanten in het midden- en grootsegment. Jij bent de reden dat organisatoren 's nachts rustig slapen.  Jij bent het gezicht van Weezpay op de vloer. In de zomermaanden is jouw kantoor daar waar het feest is. Je werkt in de weekenden, je lost problemen op on the spot en je viert het succes met de klant als de laatste bezoeker tevreden naar huis gaat. In de winter? Dan pak je je rust, geniet je van je opgebouwde uren en werk je aan strategieën voor het volgende seizoen.   Dit ga je doen:     The Pioneer: Weeztix breidt uit met Cashless en Access. Jij bent degene die deze nieuwe innovaties uitrolt bij onze klanten. Jij zet de standaard.  The Fixer: Jij bent op locatie aanwezig. Loopt er iets vast? Jij bent de go-to person. Jij blijft koel als anderen stressen en hebt affiniteit en kennis van de techniek.  The Builder: Je bouwt ijzersterke relaties op. Je snapt wat de klant nodig heeft nog voordat ze het zelf weten.  The Bridge: Jij vertaalt de feedback van het festivalterrein naar onze teams op kantoor. Samen maken we van Weeztix een geoliede machine.      Jij bent de Headliner als...   Jij energie krijgt van actie. Je bent ambitieus, ondernemend en niet te stoppen. Je snapt dat de evenementenindustrie een lifestyle is, geen 9 tot 5 baan.    Mindset: Je bent communicatief ijzersterk, gastvrij, maar durft ook risico's te nemen.  Drive: Je wilt bouwen aan iets nieuws. Je wacht niet af, je pakt aan.  Flexibiliteit: Weekenden werken op een festivalterrein klinkt voor jou als een droom, niet als een straf.  Skills: Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring in een rol waar klantcontact centraal staat. Daarnaast is technische kennis of affiniteit met de techniek een must in deze rol.      Welkom bij de Weeztix Family   Wij zijn Weeztix. Sinds 2015 de uitdager in de ticketingmarkt en sinds 2025 de game changer in cashless en access. Ons systeem draait in 102 landen en verwerkt miljoenen tickets. Dat doen we met 70 collega's.  We zijn jong, snelgroeiend en houden van gezelligheid. We werken hard voor onze successen, maar vieren ze nog harder. title: Customer Operations Manager
description: Customer Operations Manager | Atención al Cliente | Industria y Fabricación  ¿Te gusta ser la pieza que conecta comercial y producción?  ¿Disfrutas liderando equipos y resolviendo antes de que el problema llegue al cliente?  Entonces este reto es para ti.   Sobre la empresa   Te incorporarás a una empresa industrial con producción propia y una red comercial activa a nivel nacional e internacional, que trabaja bajo pedido para clientes exigentes y con procesos técnicos de diseño y fabricación de piezas.  Es una organización donde el servicio al cliente marca la diferencia: cada oferta, cada plazo y cada incidencia se gestionan con el mismo rigor con el que se fabrica.  Tu base estará en el departamento de atención al cliente, en contacto directo con dirección comercial, producción y departamento técnico.   Tu reto     Liderar y motivar a un equipo de entre 6 y 8 personas de atención al cliente, nacional e internacional, marcando el ritmo y el criterio del departamento.  Ser el nexo real entre comercial y fábrica: recoger la información técnica de cada nuevo proyecto y trasladarla con precisión al departamento técnico y de producción.  Calcular costes de fabricación junto al equipo técnico y dar seguimiento a las ofertas en curso hasta su cierre.  Supervisar el plan de entregas y anticiparte a incidencias de producción, transporte o plazo, manteniendo siempre informado al cliente.  Dar soporte directo a los comerciales en la gestión de presupuestos, apertura de nuevos clientes y seguimiento mensual de cuentas activas.    Aquí no se trata solo de atender. Se trata de sostener, con criterio propio, el punto donde comercial y fábrica se encuentran.   Lo que buscamos     Experiencia gestionando equipos de atención al cliente en entornos industriales o de fabricación.  Una persona activa, atenta y con actitud proactiva, que se anticipe en lugar de esperar instrucciones.  Firmeza y autocontrol para liderar un equipo de tamaño medio, combinados con cercanía real.  Visión de negocio: entender que cada decisión en el día a día tiene impacto directo en el cliente y en el resultado.  Valorable nivel de francés e inglés.     Lo que ofrecemos     Un puesto con impacto real y visibilidad directa ante Dirección General.  Una posición que no es administrativa: es la que sostiene la relación entre comercial, fábrica y cliente.     Por qué este proyecto es diferente   No es un puesto de soporte. Es el engranaje que hace que comercial y fábrica funcionen como una sola pieza, y que el cliente lo note.

description: About TimeLog    TimeLog  is a leading Professional Services Automation (PSA) software, dedicated to helping professional service organizations streamline business processes and boost productivity. description: Om Etteplan    Etteplan er en international ingeniør- og teknologivirksomhed, der hjælper kunder med at udvikle avancerede løsninger inden for engineering og software på tværs af brancher som industri, energi og sikkerhed. Om projektet    Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder på et stort software-system i et miljø med høje sikkerhedskrav. Du skal kunne forstå, hvordan forskellige dele af systemet hænger sammen, spotte risici og se kvalitet i et større perspektiv. Du kommer til at arbejde med både manuel test og testautomatisering på forskellige niveauer, blandt andet funktionel test, regressionstest, integrationstest og systemtest. Der er samtidig et stigende fokus på automatisering og CI/CD, så du bliver også en del af arbejdet med at udvikle og forbedre måden, vi tester på gennem hele udviklingsprocessen.   Hvorfor rollen er interessant, og hvordan vi arbejder     Test er ikke bare det sidste trin før en release. Det er en vigtig del af arbejdet med at bygge et system, hvor stabilitet og kvalitet virkelig betyder noget.   Du arbejder tæt sammen med softwareudviklere, system engineers, andre testere og tekniske specialister. En stor del af jobbet handler om at forstå systemet, stille de rigtige spørgsmål, finde risici og sammen med teamet finde ud af, hvordan vi bedst tester en løsning.   Nogle problemer løses bedst med automatisering. Andre kræver analyse, nysgerrighed eller god manuel test. Vi leder derfor efter en person, der kan se værdien i begge dele og vælge den rigtige tilgang til situationen.   Vi arbejder tæt sammen i teamet, deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at løse svære problemer. Domænet er komplekst og tager tid at lære, så du behøver ikke vide alt fra starten. Til gengæld er det vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at forstå, hvordan systemet faktisk fungerer.   Hvis du kan lide at gå et skridt videre end happy path, forstå hvordan komplekse systemer opfører sig og finde problemer, før de bliver til rigtige problemer, er der masser at tage fat på her. Arbejde med funktionel test, regressionstest, integrationstest og systemtest.   Bidrage til testautomatisering og løbende forbedring af automatiserede tests.   Identificere, dokumentere og følge op på fejl.   Verificere bug fixes og udføre re-tests.   Undersøge problemer og arbejde tæt sammen med udviklere og system engineers om at finde root causes. title: Kvalitetsingeniør
description: Vil du sette kvalitetsstandarden for fremtidens byggematerialer i tre?    Kvalitetsingeniør   20.09.2026  Fra tømmerstokk til ferdig byggemateriale skal kvaliteten aldri svikte. Det blir din jobb å sørge for det.  Hver eneste trefiber, plate og isolasjonsmatte som forlater Gjøvik, bærer et løfte: at kvalitet aldri er tilfeldig. Nå leter vi etter deg som vil ta eierskap til det løftet – og gjøre det enda sterkere. Hos oss blir kvalitet jobbet med systematisk hver eneste dag, i alt fra fabrikkgulvet til sertifiseringene våre, og du vil få kombinere struktur, revisjonsarbeid og forbedring i en industribedrift med store ambisjoner.   Om Hunton Fiber   Hunton Fiber AS er en norsk industribedrift som skaper verdi ved å produsere trefiberbaserte produkter og løsninger med minst mulig klimafotavtrykk. Siden etableringen i 1889 har vi vokst til å bli en av Nordens ledende produsenter av byggematerialer til hus, hytter, barnehager, skoler og yrkesbygg. I tett samarbeid med partnere driver vi aktivt FoU-arbeid for utvikling av nye og forbedrede produkter, løsninger og forretningsområder.  Vi er 180 ansatte. Hovedkontoret er på Gjøvik, med fabrikker på Gjøvik, Skjerven og i Olsfors (Sverige). I tillegg har vi salgskontor i Asker og Malmø, og et salgsteam i Finland. Vi er solide og har store ambisjoner for selskapet fremover, og skal kjennetegnes av kvalitet i leveranser og våre verdier: troverdig, fremtidsrettet og lagspiller.  Hunton Fiber AS er sertifisert etter ISO 9001, ISO 50001, PEFC og Miljøfyrtårn.   Om rollen   Som  kvalitetsingeniør  blir du en sentral bidragsyter i arbeidet med å videreutvikle kvaliteten vi søker å ha i våre produkter. Du rapporterer direkte til leder for HMS, kvalitet og bærekraft. description: 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
