Test Automation - Selenium, Appium, TestNG 등의 도구를 활용하여 자동화 테스트 스크립트를 설계 및 구현함으로써 수작업 테스트를 줄이고, 다양한 도메인(예: 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리)의 테스트 커버리지를 확대합니다.  Manual Testing - 자동화 테스트에서 놓칠 수 있는 버그 및 결함을 식별하기 위해 이커머스 플랫폼에 대한 수동 테스트를 수행합니다.  Report Defects - 테스트 과정에서 발견된 결함을 문서화하고 보고하며, 개발자가 이슈를 재현할 수 있도록 명확한 재현 절차를 제공합니다.  Test Data Management - 여러 도메인에 걸친 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.  Quality Assurance - 모든 테스트 활동이 회사의 품질 기준 및 규제 요구사항에 부합하도록 보장합니다.  Integrate Test Automation with CI/CD Pipeline - 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하여 고품질 소프트웨어 제품이 원활하게 배포될 수 있도록 합니다.  E2E Testing - 실제 사용자 시나리오를 기반으로 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 수행하여 로그인부터 결제까지 이커머스 플랫폼이 정상적으로 작동하는지 확인합니다.  Multiple Domain Testing - 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리 등 이커머스 플랫폼에 통합된 다양한 도메인을 테스트합니다.       자격 요건:    컴퓨터공학, 정보기술 또는 관련 분야 학사 학위 이상 (석사 또는 박사 우대)  QA 엔지니어링 분야에서 8년 이상의 경력, 이 중 이커머스 플랫폼에서의 경력 3년 이상  Selenium, Appium, TestNG 또는 Pytest와 같은 테스트 자동화 프레임워크에 대한 검증된 전문성  Agile, Scrum, Test-Driven Development(TDD)와 같은 테스트 방법론에 대한 높은 이해도  다양한 협업 조직과 원활하게 일할 수 있는 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력  Scrum 또는 Kanban과 같은 애자일 개발 방법론 환경에서의 업무 경험  주니어 QA 엔지니어를 관리 및 멘토링한 경험은 우대       우대 사항:    업무상 영어 또는 중국어 가능자  품질 엔지니어링 관련 자격증 (예: ISTQB)  클라우드 플랫폼(AWS, Azure, GCP), 컨테이너(Docker), 또는 마이크로서비스 아키텍처에 대한 경험  Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD 또는 CircleCI와 같은 DevOps 도구에 대한 이해 및 사용 경험  Globalization testing - 언어 번역 및 문화적 적응을 포함한 글로벌 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 대한 전문성  Internatio

title: Quality Manager
description: To lead and manage quality assurance across the Aftersales operation, ensuring that service, repair, warranty, and customer-handling processes consistently meet company and manufacturer/OEM standards. The role will focus on reducing repeat repairs, improving customer satisfaction, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining strong quality performance across the workshop and Aftersales functions.    Key Responsibilities     Develop and implement quality standards, procedures, and control processes for Aftersales operations.  Ensure all service and repair activities comply with manufacturer/OEM standards, technical procedures, and company policies.  Conduct regular quality audits and inspections across workshop, service, warranty, and related Aftersales operations.  Monitor vehicle repair quality and ensure vehicles are properly inspected before delivery to customers.  Identify quality issues, repeat repairs, technical defects, and process gaps and ensure timely corrective action.  Lead root-cause analysis using structured problem-solving methods and implement preventive measures.  Monitor customer complaints, feedback, CSI/NPS results, and quality-related concerns to identify improvement opportunities.  Work closely with Service, Technical, Parts, Warranty, and CRM teams to resolve quality issues.  Establish and monitor quality-related KPIs and provide regular performance reports to management.  Track repeat repair rates, first-time-fix performance, warranty issues, customer complaints, and service quality indicators.  Coordinate with OEM/Principal representatives regarding quality audits, technical concerns, campaigns, and corrective actions.  Ensure compliance with manufacturer audit requirements and prepare departments for periodic quality assessments.  Develop and maintain quality documentation, checklists, inspection reports, and standard operating procedures.  Conduct process reviews to identify inefficiencies and implement continuous improvement initiatives.  Monitor workshop housekeeping, safety, equipment condition, and adherence to required operating standards.  Train and coach Aftersales staff on quality standards, processes, customer satisfaction, and quality awareness.  Ensure lessons learned from quality issues are communicated across relevant teams to prevent recurrence.  Act as the escalation point for major quality-related customer complaints and operational issues.  Prepare management reports highlighting quality performance, trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions.

In this hands-on role, you’ll work with both early-stage prototypes and finalized modules, contributing to new development and sustaining projects. Ownership of the entire testing lifecycle, responsibility for reporting to Project and Product Managers, tracking of test performance against KPIs and responsible for ensuring defects are found early. title: Quality Assurance Manager

Samtidigt förväntas du kunna gå in operativt vid behov, exempelvis i kritiska projektfaser eller vid särskilda kvalitetsutmaningar, kund, - eller interna revisioner.  Du spelar en nyckelroll i att säkerställa att kvalitetsarbetet möter högt ställda krav i en mjukvarutung och tekniskt avancerad miljö, där arbetssätt kontinuerligt anpassas och vidareutvecklas med stöd av agnostisk AI och LLM. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:    Leda, coacha och utveckla ett team av Project/Product Quality Managers med fokus på kompetens, prestation och engagemang.  Säkerställa en kontinuerlig och hållbar bemanning av kvalitetsresurser i verksamhetens projekt genom nära samarbete med projektkontor och beställare.   Sätta riktning för och vidareutveckla vårt kvalitetsarbete, processer och metoder genom nära samarbete med andra kvalitetsfunktioner och stödfunktioner på BA och Group nivå.  Säkerställa efterlevnad av relevanta standarder, regelverk och interna krav som ställs på oss.  Driva förbättringsinitiativ med hjälp av AI och utveckla skalbara arbetssätt anpassade för en mjukvaruintensiv verksamhet och dess kundkrav.  Ansvara för övergripande revisioner, uppföljning och kvalitetsmätningar med regelbunden rapportering både på Business Unit (BU) och Business Area (BA) nivå, samt representera BUt i kvalitetsforum på BA nivå.  Fungera som ett strategiskt stöd till alla funktioner inom BUt i kvalitetsrelaterade frågor från tidigt offertarbete mot kund till domänspecifika frågor.  Vid behov gå in operativt för att säkerställa kvalitet i kritiska projekt leveranser.     Tjänsten är baserad i Solna. Resor inrikes och utrikes kan förekomma.  Din profil  För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en erfaren kvalitetsledare med tidigare personalansvar och med ett starkt driv att utveckla både organisationer och människor. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med ett nära och engagerat ledarskap.  Du har god förståelse för kvalitetsarbete i komplexa, gärna mjukvaruintensiva miljöer, och du är van att utveckla strukturer och processer som fungerar i praktiken.  So

title: DevOps & Security Engineer - AI-Native Healthcare SaaS
description:
Headquarters:  India
 

 About the Company  Zenara Health is a mental healthcare organization driven by technology, aiming to improve the accessibility and quality of mental wellness services. By integrating AI-driven platforms with professional clinical care, we deliver personalized and effective mental health solutions, creating a smooth digital experience for both patients and providers. We operate as a startup, distinct from a mere department.  Why This Role Exists   This position serves as the company's foremost line of defense.   You will operate under the assumption that systems are constantly under threat, crafting infrastructure that is resilient, auditable, and inherently secure. You will be the most risk-aware individual in the startup — and that’s exactly what we require. While others concentrate on feature rollout, you will prioritize the security of patient data, regulatory compliance, and system integrity.  About the Role   If your understanding of DevOps is limited to "I occasionally execute kubectl apply," this position is likely not for you.    This role is not suited for those who prioritize speed over safety or view security as an afterthought to be addressed later.  At Zenara, safeguarding patient data and maintaining system integrity takes precedence over rapid deployment.  Our team is in the process of developing a platform that manages clinical data, operates AI workflows, and processes insurance billing — all within a HIPAA-regulated environment catering to real psychiatric practices. Our infrastructure is operational; however, we lack an individual who will take ownership with a security-first perspective. We currently do not have a dedicated CI/CD owner, a comprehensive security posture, or monitoring that extends beyond simple uptime checks. If HIPAA auditors were to arrive tomorrow, we could withstand the scrutiny — but it wouldn’t be a pleasant experience.  You will be responsible for Zenara’s infrastructure, security posture, and compliance engineering — everything from the ground up. This includes CI/CD pipelines, HIPAA-compliant deployment automation, monitoring and alerting systems, cybersecurity measures and threat defense, access controls, and audit logging — the complete spectrum of "essential elements that ensure the safe operation of a healthcare company."  However, your role will go beyond mere maintenance. You will also develop infrastructure for our AI platform, encompassing model serving, scaling AI workloads, and supporting production AI pipelines. You will have a dual mandate: ensure the stability and security of the platform while also building the necessary infrastructure for AI at scale.   This represents a unique opportunity for greenfield infrastructure engineering within a healthcare AI company with genuine compliance obligations and real users.  You will devise systems from fundamental principles, make architectural choices, establish best practices to guide us through growth and compliance

title: Werkstudent (all genders) – Robuste Feed-Forward-3D-Rekonstruktion für dynamische Szenen
description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Feed-Forward-Modelle zur 3D-Rekonstruktion können Szenengeometrie direkt aus Bildern oder Videos vorhersagen, ohne eine aufwendige szenenspezifische Optimierung zu benötigen. Durch die Kombination von großskaligem Pre-Training, Multi-View-Reasoning und starken geometrischen Priors stellen sie eine effiziente Alternative zu klassischen Rekonstruktionsverfahren wie Structure-from-Motion, NeRF und optimierungsbasiertem 3D Gaussian Splatting dar.

Trotz aktueller Fortschritte reagieren bestehende Modelle weiterhin empfindlich auf anspruchsvolle reale Bedingungen. Verdeckungen, bewegte Objekte, wechselnde Beleuchtung, Nachtaufnahmen, Reflexionen, Regen, Nebel und Schnee können zu unvollständiger Geometrie, unzuverlässigen Korrespondenzen und zeitlich inkonsistenten Vorhersagen führen. Eine höhere Robustheit unter solchen Bedingungen ist daher insbesondere für autonomes Fahren und robotische Wahrnehmung von großer Bedeutung.

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du die Entwicklung robuster Feed-Forward-Rekonstruktionsmodelle für dynamische Szenen. Du untersuchst Methoden zur Behandlung von Verdeckungen, Beleuchtungsänderungen und widrigen Wetterbedingungen. Darüber hinaus erforschst du, wie große Rekonstruktionsmodelle als universelle geometrische Backbones für nachgelagerte Aufgaben des 3D-Szenenverständnisses eingesetzt werden können, insbesondere für Semantic Occupancy Prediction und 4D Occupancy Forecasting.


Diese Aufgaben interessieren Dich

  • Entwicklung und Evaluation von Feed-Forward-Modellen zur Rekonstruktion dynamischer 3D-Szenen aus monokularen oder Multi-View-Bildsequenzen.

Location: Berlin, Germany (office first) 

Team description

Our Platform Tribe builds Fleet, the infrastructure foundation that every engineering team at SumUp relies on to ship safely and quickly. Fleet gives teams a stable, self-service platform, built on AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform, so they can focus on their products instead of infrastructure bottlenecks. As part of the Cloud Infrastructure team, you'll take ownership of critical platform services, help modernise how we run Kubernetes at scale, and support engineers across the business as they build on top of what you maintain. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems that quietly power everything else, this is where that work happens.

What you'll do

  • Design and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure patterns that other engineering teams build on

  • Manage production Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, including performance tuning and service mesh implementation

  • Lead security and compliance work across frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC2, partnering with the Security team

  • Define and monitor service reliability metrics, take part in on-call rotation, and drive improvements after incidents

  • Improve developer experience through automation, better CI/CD pipelines, and clearer documentation

  • Mentor other engineers on the team and contribute to technical design discussions

You'll be great for this role if…

  • At least 8 years of experience in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development (Go preferred, but anyone would be good)

  • Experience designing and maintaining infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform

  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes in production, including cluster operations and troubleshooting

  • Hands-o

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter.

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.</

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: Quality Manager - Galway      Our client is an international medical device R&D and manufacturing organization with two sites in Galway.  This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-paced, small-scale manufacturing environment.  In this role you will lead and oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of QMS in Ireland.      In this role you will:       Act as the Management Representative for the Quality Management System (QMS).  Ensure the QMS processes and documentation are established, implemented, and maintained in compliance with ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and 21 CFR Part 820.  Report on QMS performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.  Serve as the primary liaison with customers and certification bodies for external audits.  Provide leadership and direction on all QA-related matters, including quality systems, compliance, and material disposition.  Ensure management review meetings are conducted in accordance with regulatory requirements.  Oversee control of documents and records related to products, manufacturing processes, and the QMS.  Plan, manage, and conduct internal quality audits to ensure compliance with applicable standards and internal procedures.  Handle and monitor CAPA, customer complaints, and feedback to ensure timely resolution and continuous improvement.  Review and approve suppliers of components, raw materials, products, and services impacting product quality, and support qualification of critical suppliers.  Be Quality point of contact on all Design Assurance activities.  Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QMS effectiveness and compliance.  Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including interviewing, hiring, training, performance management, and employee development.       Ideally for this role you will have:       5–10 years of progressive experience in quality assurance and control within medical device manufacturing or a related industry, with in-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes and quality systems.  Strong management and leadership skills.  Solid knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and/or Medical Device Directives.  Demonstrated proficiency in engineering and quality tools (e.g., FMEA, DOE, SPC, and statistical analysis tools).  Ability to support NPD and design assurance .  Willingness to travel as required for supplier assessments and other business activities. title: Pega Test Engineer
description: Bedrijfsomschrijving   collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet alleen technologie transformatie aandrijft, maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom staan mensen centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.  In Nederland werk je binnen RulesMatter. Een betrokken, inhoudelijk sterk team dat organisaties helpt hun processen slimmer en toekomstbestendig te maken met regelgebaseerde technologie. Binnen onze Technical Business Process Automation practice bouwen we met Pega oplossingen die niet alleen werken, maar ook betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar zijn.  We bouwen geen losse features. We bouwen processen die blijven staan.   The world is how we shape it.  Let’s shape it together.    Vacatureomschrijving   Als Pega Test Engineer zorg jij dat wat we bouwen ook écht goed werkt. Jij kijkt verder dan een geslaagde testcase. Je denkt mee over risico’s, kwaliteit en samenhang. Waar kan het misgaan? Wat missen we nog? En hoe maken we het beter voordat het in productie gaat?  Je werkt aan Pega-applicaties binnen complexe omgevingen. Samen met developers, analisten en architecten zorg je dat testing geen sluitpost is, maar vanaf het begin onderdeel van het ontwerp.  In deze rol houd je je vooral bezig met:    Het bepalen van een slimme testaanpak binnen Pega-projecten  Het ontwerpen en uitvoeren van testscenario’s op functioneel en technisch niveau  Het opzetten en verbeteren van testautomatisering waar dat waarde toevoegt    Je werkt hybride vanuit Groningen, gecombineerd met klantlocaties en thuis. Binnen RulesMatter werk je in een multidisciplinair team waar kwaliteit geen bijzaak is, maar vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van hoe we werken.   Functie-eisen    Dit zijn jouw sterktes   Je hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit en neemt geen genoegen met “het zal wel goed zijn”. Je stelt vragen, denkt vooruit en durft ook tegen te spreken als iets niet klopt. Je begrijpt hoe processen werken en weet waar risico’s zich kunnen verstoppen.   Wat we bij jou terugzien:     Ervaring als tester in complexe applicatieomgevingen  Ervaring met testautomatisering, bijvoorbeeld met Tosca, Selenium of Cucumber  Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende testniveaus en stakeholders  Je voelt je prettig in een Agile omgeving  Je spreekt Nederlands op minimaal B2-niveau    Ervaring met Pega is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Als jij de basis van testdenken goed beheerst en de motivatie hebt om je verder te verdiepen, helpen wij je daarbij.   Aanvullende informatie    Dit krijg je van ons   Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:    Een vast contract en een salaris afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en inschaling  Vakantiegeld van 8%;  Sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhou

title: Senior Exploratory QE Engineer
description: About Enfuce:    Founded in 2016, Enfuce is a female-founded and led global payments partner solving payments complexity for ambitious brands, banks and fintech leaders. Born in the Nordics and built for the world, Enfuce combines deep payments expertise with cloud-native technology to help customers launch and scale with confidence.  Enfuce is a strategic issuing and licensing partner delivering premium, flexible payment programmes across consumer, commercial and B2B use cases. Built for fast launch and trusted scale, Enfuce designs, launches and runs card programmes supporting debit, credit, prepaid, fleet and fuel propositions, alongside digital wallets and card scheme connectivity.  Enfuce combines cloud-native issuing, embedded compliance and fraud intelligence to deliver velocity with control. Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.  As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.  Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.       About The Role:    We're looking for a Senior Exploratory QE Engineer to strengthen how we find risk before our customers do. This is not a scripted test-case role. You'll use structured exploratory testing, charter-based sessions and deep product intuition to probe our card issuing and payment processing platform for the failure modes that automated suites and requirements documents miss: edge cases in transaction flows, race conditions, state corruption, security gaps and usability breakdowns. You'll work closely with automation engineers, developers and product owners, but your craft is distinct: you go where the tests don't, and you make the invisible risks visible.       What You'll Be Doing:    Design and run structured exploratory testing charters against new features, APIs and high-risk areas of the platform, guided by risk, not scripts.  Dig into complex payment and card lifecycle flows to uncover edge cases, state issues and integration gaps.  Partner with automation QE engineers to decide what should be automated, what needs a human eye, and feed exploratory findings back into the regression suite.  Perform risk-based test planning for releases, identifying the areas most likely to break and why.  Investigate production incidents and near-misses to find the underlying gaps in test coverage, then close them.  Champion a quality mindset across engineering, and raise the bar on what 'done' means.  Contribute to and evolve our exploratory testing practice: charters

Du vil være med til at realisere komplekse brugsscenarier, sikre høj datasikkerhed og yde teknisk sparring, der løfter det faglige niveau. Kort sagt er du med til at automatisere og effektivisere interne processer i DI og sikre, at vores medarbejdere altid har adgang og kendskab til de bedste generative AI-værktøjer, der hjælper dem i hverdagen.      Dine primære opgaver      ·      Udvikle og implementere generative AI-løsninger på Azure-platformen.  ·      Opbygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger og være med til at automatisere og understøtte interne arbejdsgange.  ·      Udvikle og understøtte AI-agenter med fokus på modulære og genanvendelige komponenter.  ·      Gøre det komplekse enkelt, fra proof of concept til produktionsklare løsninger.  ·      Dokumentere, teste, optimere og løbende forbedre AI-komponenter.  ·      Arbejde med den nødvendige cloudinfrastruktur omkring dine løsninger  ·      Samarbejde tæt med kolleger på tværs af kompetencer for at omsætte idéer til virkelighed.  ·      Sikre governance, compliance og høj datasikkerhed i alt dit arbejde. Du motiveres af at tage ansvar, både for at eksperimentere med nye teknologier, men også for at levere stabil drift. title: Customer Success Team Lead
description: Are you a Customer Success leader who loves building scalable ways of working? Do you want to help thousands of SMEs get real, measurable value from technology? Would leading a high-volume, fast-growing team energise you?  If you answered yes to every question, keep reading. You might be Groweo's new Customer Success Team Lead 🤩  We are looking for a Customer Success Team Lead to lead our Customer Success Associate team in a pooled, high-volume motion. This is a pure leadership role with no personal customer portfolio: you own your team's output, meaning customer retention, satisfaction, and measurable value deliver.   Who are you?   You know what good customer success looks like, and you know how to make it work at scale. Your team serves a large pool of customers, with each Associate managing 300+ accounts, so you think about efficiency, clarity, and repeatable processes as much as warmth. So she started a company offering cooking classes for locals and tourists. The venue is authentic and beautiful - her taste is unique and welcoming. The classes are thoughtfully designed. title: Customer Experience Manager
description: NZ Safety Blackwoods is looking for an experienced  Customer Experience Manager  to join our team based in  Wiri, Manukau . title: Customer Service Supervisor
description: About the Role   We are looking for a  Customer Service Supervisor  to lead customer support operations, ensure high service quality, and drive team performance against established service standards and KPIs. The role will be responsible for managing the customer service team, monitoring service levels, ensuring effective issue resolution, and handling customer escalations professionally.      Key Responsibilities    Lead and supervise the Customer Service team, including shift management and adherence to SLAs.  Monitor and evaluate calls and support tickets to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with company standards.  Handle and escalate material complaints, including regulatory, safety, fraud, and fund-related matters, to the Compliance Officer as required.  Monitor SLA dashboards, customer satisfaction metrics, and other key service performance indicators.  Ensure customer data and call recordings are handled securely and in compliance with the  Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) .  Coordinate with Operations and relevant technical teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.  Coach and train Call Center Officers on customer service procedures, including the  no-credit-promises  policy and restrictions on handling customer funds.  Identify service gaps and recommend improvements to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.  Prepare and communicate performance updates and escalate recurring service issues to management.       Qualifications & Skills    Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Customer Service, Communications, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience may be considered.  Proven experience in  customer service supervision, team leadership, or call center operations .  Strong ability to manage teams, shifts, service levels, and performance KPIs.  Experience in monitoring service quality and handling customer escalations.  Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and decision-making skills.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.  Strong understanding of customer service standards, quality assurance, and operational procedures.  Customer service or leadership certifications are an advantage but not mandatory.  Knowledge of  PDPL, compliance requirements, fraud prevention, or financial services operations  is an advantage.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Elixir)
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.

AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.

Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.

This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end across Sona's platform, from scoping through to delivery, including in the mobile app

  • Use AI development tooling as your primary workflow - directing and evaluating agent-

title: Condition Monitoring Application Engineer
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

What's the Opportunity

The primary function of the Condition Monitoring Application Engineer (CMAE) is to support the sales process by providing technical expertise and tribal knowledge to the sales team. As a CMAE you will be a main factor in engineering a solution for our customers with our offerings. This role works closely with sales, the condition monitoring team, and customers. You will:

  • Support solutions architects in the sales process as the subject matter expert in condition monitoring.
  • Establish credibility with customers to encourage higher opportunity-to-trial conversion rates.
  • Ensure high-quality asset lists to enable higher trial-to-subscription rates.
  • Assist in engineering a solution that best fits the needs of the customer.
  • Track the success of the asset review call and provide recommendations to enhance the same.
  • Track and suggest ways to improve the average monitoring point/trial.
  • Acquire extensive expertise in AssetWatch products, encompassing technical aspects, to effectively secure trials that incorporate a diverse range of AssetWatch offerings.
  • Analyze vibration and temperature data at client sites, customizing data processing to the client's asset and determining if maintenance is needed.
  • Attend tradeshows to assist the sales team with technical knowledge and lead capture.
  • Evaluate machinery health and condition through the detailed analysis of vibration data.
  • Expand AssetWatch's expertise in machine condition monitoring, beyond vibration analysis, to include other condition-monitoring technologies.
  • Work closely with the product development team to create high-value hardware and software solutions and expanded product offerings.
  • Provide high-quality, actionable information to clients (e.g., setting appropriate alarm levels with analytical tools, to alert customers of pending failures).

Qualifications

  • Strong communication skills and ability to discover pain points for the customer and drive towards a solution.
  • Valid Vibration Category II, MLA/MLT Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience with vibration data collection and analysis.
  • Strong mechanical background with industrial equipment — centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc.

As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. We are passionate about making healthcare easier, more affordable, and more accessible for everyone.

We are looking for an AI-forward Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy to serve as the strategic bridge between regulatory requirements and automated execution. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Clover’s clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring they are accurately interpreted, regularly updated, and seamlessly integrated into our claims environment.

You will act as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME), translating complex Medicare guidelines—including National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)—into actionable logic. You will also play a critical role in vendor management, partnering with external vendors to enhance policy oversight. Your mission is to accelerate Clover's transition toward a high-precision payment ecosystem where monitoring and research are highly automated, ensuring clinical and reimbursement policies are seamlessly and accurately operationalized.

  • Medicare Regulatory SME: Serve as the authority on Medicare guidelines, specifically interpreting and operationalizing NCDs, LCDs, and general national coding guidelines.

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

Building AI agents that can assist with any kind of enterprise work is a challenging, open-ended problem. One key piece of solving it is replicating real work environments as realistically as possible - filling them with hard tasks to solve, creating plausible input data, and defining clear rewards for completing the work the right way. We build many of these reinforcement learning (RL) environments, then drop our agents into them to evaluate or train them.

In this role, you are responsible for creating these RL environments, running AI agents inside them, and improving both the agents and the environments in the process. The results reach customers, whose feedback feeds back in - and the agent/environment improvement loop continues.

title: Data Scientist with focus Bioinformatics / Diagnostics (f/m/d - part/full-time)
description:
Your responsibilities will include

  • Analysis of multiomics data (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, metabolomics) in oncology / inflammation
  • Support non-clinical / clinical development in all phases, analysis plan (e.g. SAP), reporting
  • Implementation and reporting of exploratory biomarker analyses
  • Serving clients with ad-hoc data analysis requests and statistical consulting
  • Following quality and documentation standards in a GxP environment
  • Supporting the bioinformatics/statistics team, as well as independent work in diverse and exciting projects


Your profile

  • Master’s degree / PhD in bioinformatics, computer science, or equivalent education 
  • Experience in analysing multiomics and biomarker data (e.g., NGS data including transcriptomics); gene set analysis and clustering is a plus
  • Experience in setting up / executing bioinformatics pipelines using e.g. Nextflow, containerisation 
  • Solid knowledge and understanding of statistical concepts e.g. hypothesis testing, survival analysis, linear models, as well as experience in the application of advanced statistics visualizing, exploring and modeling multivariate data sets

  • Good overview of state-of-the-art bioinformatics tools and proven record of the ability to collect, combine and analyse complex types of data 
  • Fast comprehension, analytical thinking, teamwork and a high degree of initiative, willingness to learn
  • Creativity and joy in solving complex analytical questions and proactive working style

title: (Senior) Financial Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission

At Circus (Xetra: CA1), headquartered in Munich, we are pioneering global developments in on-demand autonomous food production. Everything from creation to production and operation – enabled by seamlessly integrated cutting-edge robotics and transformative AI technology.

Our foundation rests in the extensive developments of groundbreaking robotics driven by artificial intelligence, previously the missing link in achieving true autonomous food automation. This is the moment for a new status quo: Just as autonomous driving will disrupt how we build cities, organize our days, and live our lives, so will we shift our whole reality around food.

Our Team is backing a paradigm shift in one of humanity's most important sectors with the sharpest minds in Robotics, AI, Engineering and Culinary, collaborating closely with industry-leading partners to revolutionize every aspect of the food service experience.

Join us as we forge ahead, crafting a future where the art of cooking and the science of technology converge to create a world that thinks differently about food than it has for thousands of years—a world where food means something new.

We are looking for a motivated, professional Financial Accountant to become an integral member of our in-house Finance team. This is a key position responsible for managing core accounting functions and supporting major finance tasks liaising with external providers and our internal team.

title: Product Owner - momox Product Catalog (m/f/d)
description:
Our mission

We are on a mission to save our planet - one second hand product at a time.

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of the momox Product Catalog (MPC) - our central catalog system and single source of truth for product master data. MPC ingests, enriches and standardizes product data from external sources and distributes it to all downstream systems, including our buying platform, storefronts and marketplaces.

The Product Owner defines the product vision, strategy and roadmap for MPC and owns the end-to-end product data lifecycle - from ingestion, matching and enrichment to compliance and reliable data distribution.

Working closely with your engineering team, the role collaborates with Marketing, BI, Legal, the e-commerce onsite teams and marketplace operations to ensure a scalable, high-quality catalog that directly supports momox's growth.

Your mission

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Co-create a data-driven vision and product strategy and translate it into an actionable product roadmap. Define and prioritize initiatives based on business impact, customer value, and technical feasibility
  • Catalogue Sourcing & Distribution: Drive the discovery and onboarding of external data sources (e.g. full-catalogue feeds and API integrations), while ensuring a reliable, performant data flow from MPC to all consumers
  • Data Quality & Product Matching: Improve product matching across identifiers and ensure validity and correctness of product data and attributes
  • Internationalization & Localization: Scale catalogue coverage and multi-language enrichment to support European expansion including relevant regulatory logic
  • Analytics & Monitoring: Further develop and maintain product catalogue monitoring and reporting to track catalogue health

description:
Hello, we’re AMBOSS - and we’re looking for a Working Student in Accounting to join our Accounts Payable team!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a learning and clinical decision support tool striving to empower physicians across the globe to provide the best possible care. Our founders set out in 2011 to create a tool that they would have hoped to have as medical students and doctors. Since then we have grown to currently operate in 180 countries and have gained immense traction in Germany and the US. Currently, we are pursuing this mission with more than 500+ employees in our offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari.

Are you ready to join us at AMBOSS?

As a Working Student in Accounting, you'll contribute directly to the financial health and operational efficiency of AMBOSS. Your main focus will be on processing travel expenses, verifying transactions, and supporting accurate and timely accounting practices. This is an ideal opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in a meaningful context, gain hands-on experience with real-world financial processes, and grow alongside a supportive, experienced Accounting team.

Why join us in this role?

In this role, you'll play a key part in maintaining financial accuracy and ensuring compliance with internal policies. You’ll have the chance to develop your technical skills, collaborate with a diverse and motivated team, and see the real impact of your work as AMBOSS continues to scale. If you're excited to dive into financial operations, contribute your analytical mindset, and learn in a dynamic, mission-driven environment - this could be the perfect next step in your journey.

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Explore and apply a range of visual storytelling techniques within our course content, combining creativity with technical execution to bring medical education to life for medical professionals. You will collaborate closely with professionals from creative, strategic, and medical backgrounds, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives while owning the production process end-to-end — from pre-production planning through the final cut.

title: Werkstudent:in Video & Social Media (all genders welcome)
description:
Du willst mit der Kamera arbeiten und Sachen machen, die auch wirklich rausgehen? Bei mykori dreht sich alles um gesellschaftliches Engagement: Genossenschaftsbanken und Sparkassen fördern jedes Jahr Vereine, Schulen und Projekte in ihrer Region. Wir bauen die Software, mit der sie das an einer Stelle steuern und den Überblick behalten.

Für dich heißt das: Du bist dabei, wenn wir diese Projekte besuchen, und machst daraus unsere Videos.

Aufgaben

Der größte Teil deiner Zeit geht in Dreh, Schnitt und Aufbereitung. Planung und Ablage laufen nebenher mit.

  • Du drehst und fotografierst. Talking-Head- und Erklärformate mit dem Team im Büro in Bielefeld, Interviews mit unseren Kund:innen vor Ort, Material von Messen und Events.
  • Du schneidest. Aus dem Rohmaterial baust du Formate, die man auch zu Ende schaut: Schnitt, Untertitel, Grafik, Ton.
  • Du drehst unsere Erfolgsgeschichten. Unsere Kund:innen bewegen mit mykori eine Menge in ihrer Region. Diese Geschichten holst du mit uns vor Ort ab: Video, Bilder, Zitate und Kennzahlen für Website, LinkedIn und Vertrieb.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Du verfolgst, was auf LinkedIn funktioniert, und überträgst es auf unsere Zielgruppe, statt Trends nur nachzubauen.
  • Du hältst den Content-Plan am Laufen. Themen eintragen, Posts einplanen und das Material so ablegen, dass wir jeden Clip in einer Minute wiederfinden.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast schon eigene Sachen umgesetzt, von der Idee über Dreh oder Shooting und Schnitt bis zum fertigen Post. Ob für die Uni, einen Verein, nebenbei oder im Job, ist uns egal

title: Deputy Manager Defense and Automotive Products (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

We are smartmicro, leading specialist in high-performance radar sensor technology. We design, develop and manufacture sensors and systems for autonomous driving, intelligent traffic infrastructure, as well as defense and airborne applications. Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and to reliably and efficiently detect threats from drones and other aircraft.

We are looking for a deputy leader of our Defense and Automotive department, who will drive the development of our latest defense and automotive products, which are software-defined radar sensors, and contribute to delivering cutting-edge radar systems and solutions to our fast-growing customer base.

You will lead a team of ~15 engineers in the following fields:

  1. Smartmicro standard products mainstream development team (C-UAS sensors, altimeters and automotive sensors).
  2. Customer projects teams who make customer-specific C-UAS or altimeter products.
  3. Application-specific tracking, classification and sensor fusion software
  4. Software tool (i.e. for visualization and data logging).
  5. Data logging / system testing
  6. Languages and tools used: C, C++, bare metal, Linux, ROS2. You will play a key role in growing and developing the team. Over time, you will have the opportunity to take over full leadership of the department.

Your Tasks

  • You are supporting the department manager and take over certain tasks directly
  • You are responsible for coordinating projects and prioritizing tasks between the department and the embedded- and other software departments, with strong customer focus

title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own    The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.  API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.  End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.  AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point.  Failure triage that arrives with an answer: When the gate goes red, the team should get the failing assertion, the diff or deploy most likely responsible, and a first hypothesis — not a link to a log. Spec-Time Advocacy: Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.  Agentic Test Quality: Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.  Coaching & Culture: Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.  Fold Back and Compound: A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. title: System Integration And Test Engineer
description: u-blox is a global leader in automotive, industrial, and consumer markets, driving innovation through our cutting-edge positioning and short-range communication technologies. Understand new positioning and navigation feature requirements and determine how they can be verified at system level. description: As the new Director QA IT & Validation, you now have a unique opportunity to combine strategic leadership with hands-on quality oversight in an international, highly regulated environment where digitalization and business growth are high on the agenda. Reporting to the EVP, Global Quality, you will be a key member of the Global Quality Management Team, shaping the QA IT strategy and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements. Finally, you possess a proven leadership/management capabilities coupled with a strategic mindset and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.     You are a collaborative leader who communicates effectively across Quality, IT, and business functions and are comfortable advising stakeholders on complex compliance matters. title: Seksjonsleder Test og Kvalitet
description: Om oss   I Bane NOR har vi ett felles mål – å sette spor vi er stolte av, som kan drive samfunnet fremover. Derfor jobber vi hver dag med å utvikle og forvalte løsninger som bidrar til en trygg, effektiv og bærekraftig jernbane.  Det er kanskje ikke alle som vet hvor mye teknologi som ligger bak norsk jernbane. Hver dag støtter digitale løsninger alt fra trafikkstyring og kapasitetsplanlegging til kundeinformasjon og operative prosesser. Dette er tjenester som er avgjørende for at togtrafikken skal fungere sikkert og effektivt.  For å lykkes trenger vi sterke fagmiljøer og dyktige ledere. Nå søker vi en leder for Test og Kvalitet som vil være med på å styrke et viktig fagområde og bidra til at Bane NOR fortsetter å levere stabile og fremtidsrettede digitale løsninger.  Vil du lede og videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsfaget i Bane NOR?  Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du personalansvar for et fagmiljø på rundt 13 medarbeidere med kompetanse innen testledelse, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning.  Du får en viktig rolle i å videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsområdet i Bane NOR. Sammen med medarbeidere, leverandører og øvrige fagmiljøer skal du bidra til at vi utvikler og kvalitetssikrer digitale løsninger som er avgjørende for norsk jernbane.  Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer god faglig forståelse med trygt lederskap. Du vet hva som skal til for å utvikle mennesker, bygge fagmiljøer og sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene.  Dette er en rolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere personalledelse med faglig utvikling og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring på tvers av organisasjonen.   Om rollen   Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du ansvar for et etablert fagmiljø som spiller en sentral rolle i utviklingen og forvaltningen av Bane NORs digitale tjenester.  Du vil ha ansvar for medarbeidere som arbeider med testledelse, testgjennomføring, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning på tvers av produkter, prosjekter og tjenester.  Rollen kombinerer personalledelse, faglig utvikling og forbedringsarbeid. Du skal sikre at test- og kvalitetsområdet utvikler seg i takt med virksomhetens behov, samtidig som du bidrar til å videreutvikle metoder, standarder og beste praksis innen test og kvalitetssikring.   Om fagområdet   Test og kvalitet er en sentral del av Bane NORs digitale leveranser.  Fagområdet bidrar til at løsningene som understøtter trafikkstyring, kapasitetsplanlegging, kundeinformasjon, logistikk, operative prosesser og andre samfunnskritiske funksjoner holder høy kvalitet og fungerer som forventet.  Vi har ambisjoner om å videreutvikle testområdet gjennom moderne arbeidsformer, økt grad av automatisering, sterkere faglige fellesskap og tydelige standarder for kvalitetssikring på tvers av organisasjonen.  Som leder får du en viktig rolle i å drive denne utviklingen videre. description: CENORION is building a scalable technology platform for device financing, control and lifecycle management. We are at the foundation stage of building the platform engineering and product delivery capability, and we are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who can own quality across the platform and the devices it controls.     This is a builder role. You will work closely with backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps, architecture, product and security stakeholders to establish the test strategy, automation and release discipline for a customer-facing SaaS platform.     What you will own:  - Test strategy, test plans and coverage across the platform  - Functional, regression and exploratory testing of device financing, control and lifecycle workflows  - Automated test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines  - API and event-driven testing, including contracts, validation and error handling  - Asynchronous behaviour: queues, retries, duplicates and out-of-order events  - Mobile and device testing on real hardware, including offline and recovery behaviour  - Tenant isolation, access control, audit logging and data integrity verification  - Performance, load and resilience testing of critical workflows  - Defect reporting, triage and verified closure  - Release readiness assessment and production quality feedback  - Test documentation, test data and quality reporting     We are looking for someone with hands-on QA experience testing production software systems, ideally with exposure to SaaS or customer-facing platforms.  Relevant experience may include API testing and automation (Postman, REST Assured, pytest, Playwright or similar), SQL, CI/CD pipeline integration, mobile testing on physical devices, queues or event-driven systems, performance testing, and testing in fintech, telecom or device-management environments.     This role suits someone who can bring structure without bureaucracy: practical, disciplined, hands-on, and instinctively drawn to the failure case rather than the happy path.        #QAEngineer #SoftwareTesting #TestAutomation #QualityAssurance #SaaS #FinTech #MobileTesting #DubaiJobs #Hiring #CENORION

This role goes beyond traditional manual testing — we are looking for someone who is comfortable with coding, automation, backend systems, and using AI tools as part of their daily workflow. Familiar with using AI tools as part of your regular development or testing workflow. Where you’ll be doing it   You’ll join a technology organisation undergoing a  major transformation in how it builds and delivers software . You’ll help unify different delivery approaches (including SAFe, Scrumban and hybrid agile models) and bring a pragmatic, coaching-led approach to improving quality across the board.     It’s a rare opportunity to  influence culture, capability and engineering outcomes at scale . You stay hands-on and technical throughout.  Most of your quality leverage is upstream. Our pods spec features in depth and hand them to coding agents that build the feature and its tests together. Inside your pod you are the advocate, not the executor: the voice asking the awkward questions, pushing the failure modes nobody thought of, and making sure the spec and our shared testing skills are good enough that the agent produces the right tests, at the right level, catching the right things. Expect to be hands-on early while that foundation is still thin. Expect that to reduce deliberately over time as the skills sharpen and the pod's own quality thinking matures.   Key Responsibilities     QA Team Leadership:  Lead the three Quality Engineers who report to you. Set their goals, run their performance reviews, coach them day to day, and review their work. You are the senior voice they turn to on what good looks like and what to do next, and the first escalation point when they are stuck.   Spec-Time Advocacy:  Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.   Agentic Test Quality:  Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.   Coaching & Culture:  Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.   Fold Back and Compound:  A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This is what makes the role shrink rather than grow: every fold-back reduces how much intervention the next feature needs from you.

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner for både ledelsen og organisationen. Virksomheden udvikler og producerer specialiserede løsninger til kunder på internationale markeder og opererer i et kvalitetskritisk og reguleret produktionsmiljø med høje krav til kvalitet, produktsikkerhed, dokumentation og compliance.     Organisationen er præget af høj faglighed, samarbejde og korte beslutningsveje. Her får du mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor medarbejdernes kompetencer og engagement spiller en afgørende rolle i den fortsatte udvikling.     Virksomheden står foran en ambitiøs udviklingsfase, hvor kvalitet, bæredygtighed og løbende optimering er centrale fokusområder.      En bred rolle med stor betydning   Som QE Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for virksomhedens kvalitetsområde og bliver en central drivkraft i at sikre, at produkter, processer og systemer lever op til kundernes forventninger, internationale standarder og gældende lovgivning. En rolle for dig, der vil gøre en forskel   Den rette kandidat motiveres af et bredt ansvar og af at kunne se den direkte effekt af sit arbejde. title: QA Lead
description: We’re Heidi.  We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.  Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.  We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.  If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.   About The Role   We ship atoms daily. Two million patient visits a week run through what we ship, and a clinician mid-shift has no appetite for our bugs.  This role owns quality at Heidi. Not as a gate at the end, but as the thing that lets every engineer here ship fast and be right. You'll decide what good testing looks like across our stack, build the frameworks and infrastructure that make writing a good test the easy path, and make deploying to production a boring, verifiable event rather than an act of faith.  You'll lead the QA function and stay in the code while you do it. Release management sits inside this role, because the person who understands the risk should be the person who decides it's safe   What You’ll Do     Own the testing strategy across Heidi's stack, from web and mobile to our AI pipelines and EHR-connected enterprise deployments, and make deliberate calls about what belongs in unit tests, what needs integration coverage, what only a real end-to-end run will catch and what we're better off detecting in production.   Choose and build the frameworks. You'll select the tooling, write the harnesses and fixtures, and get our test suites to the point where engineers reach for them because they're fast and reliable rather than because a policy says so.   Make deployment safe by design. Quality gates in CI/CD, staged rollouts, canaries, feature flags and rollback paths that get exercised before anyone needs them, so a bad change is caught by the pipeline instead of by a clinic.   Raise the testing bar across the engineering team through code review, pairing and documentation, so quality is something every engineer owns rather than something they hand to you.   Own the quality signal end to end: escaped defect rate, change failure rate and time to detect, alongside the DORA metrics we already run on. You'll be the person who can say what our real quality is, with evidence.   Run release readiness and go/no-go, weighing coverage, change size, dependency risk

Erityisesti vähittäiskaupan toimialan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi. description: Locatie: Randstad / Amsterdam | 32–40 uur     Wil jij commerciële verantwoordelijkheid combineren met inhoudelijke impact?     Bij LTP werk je op het snijvlak van psychologie, data en organisatievraagstukken. Je bouwt aan strategische klantrelaties en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen die echt verschil maken.      Inzicht met impact   LTP is een toonaangevend psychologisch adviesbureau en marktleider in assessments. We combineren wetenschappelijke expertise met datagedreven oplossingen. Al bijna 100 jaar helpen we organisaties bij het nemen van betere beslissingen over talent en ontwikkeling.     We werken voor grote organisaties in zowel de publieke als private sector. Onze dienstverlening varieert van assessments en feedbackprogramma’s tot leiderschapstrajecten en teamontwikkeling, ondersteund door data en de nieuwste technologieën, zoals ons AI-powered assessment (ChatLab) of onze assessmentgame Frenzy Fest.     Onze ambitie is helder: organisaties beter laten functioneren door mensen beter te begrijpen.      Jouw rol   Als Medior Key Accountmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor een eigen portefeuille met strategische waarde. Je verdiept bestaande klantrelaties en bouwt deze gericht verder uit.  Je kent je klanten goed, hun context, stakeholders en opgaven, en vertaalt dit naar passende (maatwerk)oplossingen. Daarbij treed je op als regisseur van de klantrelatie: je verbindt interne expertise aan klantvragen en zorgt dat we consistent kwaliteit leveren én blijven verrassen. Je combineert commerciële scherpte met inhoudelijke interesse. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de klant en durft door te vragen. Je bouwt makkelijk relaties op en weet deze ook zakelijk te ontwikkelen. description: Who We Are:    Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure  for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.  Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.  Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.   Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. description: Customer Success Manager – Norge    Bliv Customer Success Manager hos WebLager og få ansvaret for vores norske kommunekunder. Rådgivning & mersalg   Identificere kundernes behov og præsentere relevante tillægsydelser, moduler og services, som skaber værdi for deres organisation.   Kundeudvikling   Afholde statusmøder, planlægge udviklingsforløb og sikre, at kunderne udnytter WebLagers muligheder optimalt.   Integrationer & implementering   Koordinere dialogen mellem kunden og vores tekniske specialister i forbindelse med integrationer, nye funktioner og videreudvikling af løsningen.   Samarbejde på tværs   Arbejde tæt sammen med udvikling, support, projektledelse og salgsorganisationen for at sikre den bedst mulige kundeoplevelse.   Repræsentere WebLager® i Norge   Besøge kunder, deltage i relevante netværk, konferencer og arrangementer og være med til at styrke WebLagers position på det norske marked.     DET BRINGER DU MED   • Du forstår og taler flydende norsk   • Erfaring med Account Management, Customer Success eller B2B-salg.  • Evnen til at opbygge tillid og skabe langvarige kunderelationer.  • Erfaring med offentlige kunder eller kommuner er en fordel.  • Teknisk forståelse og lyst til at sætte dig ind i digitale løsninger og integrationer.  • Gode kommunikationsevner på dansk samt professionelt norsk  • Selvstændig, struktureret og motiveret af at skabe værdi for kunder. title: Key Account Manager, Wholesale
description: We are currently seeking for a highly motivated and results-driven Key Account Manager to join our Wholesale Connectivity team. The position is in Helsinki, but you can work remotely according to our flexible work concept.  DNA is recognised as an excellent employer, and we are sure that you will enjoy working with us. Below, you can find reasons why you should choose us for the next stage of your career!   Your Key Job Description   You will become part of a team responsible for the Wholesale Customer retention and aqcuisition in the Connectivity segment at DNA and the Telenor Group. As a team, we are responsible for acquiring and keeping major Finnish and international Operator and Data Center customers. Through customer understanding, we create clear added value for new customers.  Key Account Manager will be responsible for driving customer acquisition in Wholesale Connectivity Customer segment. DNA has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Telenor Group since 2019, and the Wholesale Connectivity Sales Team is responsible especially for offering unmatched connectivity to our potential and existing Data Center Customers in Finland and wider Nordics.  Your key areas of responsibility will be:    Keep good care of your customer portfolio focusing on creating value and enhancing customers’ prospect of success.  Identify and generate new sales opportunities through networking, proactive prospecting, and strategic research.  Develop a deep understanding of Nordic Wholesale market and our customers’ strategies and businesses to effectively communicate value propositions to customers.  Navigate and engage with C-level executives to challenge and influence customers and establish long-term business relationships and secure contracts.  Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits while ensuring customers’ needs are met.  Collaborate, build sales strategies, and lead Nordic sales cases with Nordic colleagues and teams.  Network and build relationships with both internal and external stakeholders (technology vendors, consultants, etc.) and stay up to date with market trends.  Collaborate with the marketing team to create targeted campaigns and material for various conferences you will be participating that resonate with key demographics.     PREFERRED COMPETENCE IN THIS ROLE:   We are looking for a new colleague with master’s or bachelor’s degree in technology, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. You have minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise sales, preferably in technology, digitalization, IT or telecommunications sector and proven experience of successfully acquiring new business accounts. Previous experience in wholesale sector or working with high-capacity connectivity is a definitive plus.

Gestionamos un ecosistema de soluciones orientadas a profesionales sanitarios, combinando tecnología, análisis, interpretación, formación y otros servicios que permiten construir una relación continua con nuestros clientes.  Somos una empresa en crecimiento y buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo en  Lleida  una persona que quiera asumir un papel importante en el desarrollo y fidelización de nuestra cartera de clientes. Excelente capacidad de comunicación y facilidad para crear relaciones de confianza con clientes.  Orientación clara a  fidelización, recurrencia y crecimiento de cuentas .  Perfil comercial y capacidad para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio de manera natural.  Persona proactiva, organizada, resolutiva y orientada a resultados.  Capacidad para realizar seguimiento de indicadores de activación, uso, recurrencia, retención y crecimiento. Zudem planst, koordinierst und dokumentierst du nationale und internationale Serviceeinsätze unter Berücksichtigung aller relevanten Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen.    Servicevertrags- & Performance Management   Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Serviceverträge entsprechend der vereinbarten Leistungen erfüllt werden und überwachst die Einhaltung definierter Service Level Agreements. Darüber hinaus bearbeitest du Vertragsverlängerungen, Anpassungen und Kündigungen und fungierst als kompetenter Ansprechpartner für alle servicebezogenen Vertragsthemen. Durch die Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen wie Anlagenverfügbarkeit, Reaktions- und Lösungszeiten entwickelst du Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Servicequalität.    Technischer Support & Kundenzufriedenheit   Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Lösung technischer Fragestellungen und nutzt dabei vorhandene Wissensdatenbanken, Checklisten sowie standardisierte Lösungsprozesse. Nicht unmittelbar lösbare Anliegen leitest du strukturiert an den 2nd-Level-Support oder die zuständigen Fachabteilungen weiter und verfolgst deren Bearbeitung nach. Durch regelmäßige Rücksprachen stellst du sicher, dass unsere Kunden mit den erbrachten Serviceleistungen zufrieden sind und identifizierst Potenziale zur langfristigen Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses.    Serviceanalyse & Wartungsoptimierung   Du analysierst historische Service- und Wartungsdaten, erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder und leitest nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab. Auf Basis von Anlagenperformance und Servicedaten entwickelst du präventive und vorausschauende Wartungsstrategien weiter und trägst so zur Erhöhung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit bei. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du mit modernen IoT- und KI-gestützten Wartungslösungen, um Predictive-Maintenance-Konzepte weiterzuentwickeln sowie Reaktionszeiten, Ersatzteillogistik und Kundenzufriedenheit kontinuierlich zu optimieren.      DEIN PROFIL    WAS BRINGST DU MIT?      Studium/Ausbildung   Du verfügst über eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.    Erfahrung   Du hast bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im technischen Kundenservice, Service Management oder After-Sales-Service gesammelt. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination von Serviceeinsätzen im industriellen Anlagenumfeld sowie im Umgang mit Serviceverträge

title: Serviceleder VVS
description: Har du erfaring fra VVS-bransjen, god kjennskap til markedet og lyst til å skape vekst? Da kan dette være muligheten for deg.   Bravida satser videre i Kristiansand og søker en ambisiøs og markedsorientert serviceleder innen VVS. Du blir en sentral del av et etablert fagmiljø og får være med på å utvikle medarbeidere, kunder og virksomheten lokalt.  VVS-virksomheten i Kristiansand er i dag en del av Bravidas avdeling i Arendal. Sammen betjener vi kunder i hele Agder, med medarbeidere og aktivitet både i Arendal og Kristiansand. Ambisjonen er å vokse videre i Kristiansand og på sikt etablere virksomheten som en egen avdeling.  For deg som motiveres av ansvar, påvirkningsmuligheter og vekst, kan dette være starten på en spennende utviklingsreise.   Rollen   Som serviceleder får du ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen av en gruppe dyktige VVS-medarbeidere. Du vil samarbeide tett med dagens serviceleder i Kristiansand, og sammen skal dere sikre god oppfølging av medarbeidere, kunder og oppdrag.  Stillingen har arbeidssted i Kristiansand og rapporterer til avdelingssjef Arendal.  En viktig del av rollen blir å styrke Bravidas posisjon i markedet. Vi ser derfor etter deg som kjenner VVS-bransjen på Sørlandet, er god til å utvikle kunderelasjoner og ser muligheter for nye oppdrag og samarbeid.  Du vil bidra i den økonomiske oppfølgingen av egne oppdrag og være tett på driften. Selv om det overordnede budsjett- og resultatansvaret ligger hos avdelingssjefen, får du gode muligheter til å påvirke virksomhetens utvikling. I takt med veksten i Kristiansand kan det også åpne seg muligheter for et bredere ansvar over tid.   Dine viktigste oppgaver     lede, støtte og følge opp medarbeidere i det daglige  planlegge bemanning, oppdrag og ressursbruk  følge opp eksisterende kunder og utvikle nye kunderelasjoner  identifisere forretningsmuligheter og bidra til økt aktivitet og vekst  utarbeide tilbud og følge opp økonomi, fremdrift og kvalitet i oppdragene  sikre gode leveranser innen HMS, kvalitet og kundetilfredshet  samarbeide med serviceleder, avdelingssjef og Bravidas øvrige fagmiljøer      Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi tror du har erfaring fra rør- eller VVS-bransjen og god forståelse for hvordan markedet fungerer. Du trenger ikke å være den fremste fagspesialisten, men du må kjenne faget godt nok til å forstå kundene, oppdragene og medarbeidernes hverdag.  Du kan allerede være serviceleder, prosjektleder, bas, faglig leder eller ha en annen relevant rolle. Det viktigste er at du ønsker å ta mer ansvar og motiveres av å skape resultater sammen med andre.  Vi ser gjerne at du har:    fagbrev, teknisk fagskole eller annen relevant teknisk bakgrunn  erfaring fra rør-, VVS- eller teknisk entreprenørvirksomhet  god kjennskap til markedet på Sørlandet  et relevant kundenettverk eller dokumentert evne til å utvikle gode kunderelasjoner  kommersiell forståelse og interesse for nye forretningsmuligheter  forståelse for økonomi, planlegging og lønnsom drift  førerkort kla
