Kundeutvikling: Skape og videreutvikle relasjoner med nye og eksisterende kunder.  Samarbeid: Jobbe tett med andre ledere og teamet for å levere helhetlige og verdiskapende løsninger. Personlige egenskaper:     Du har et ønske om å videreutvikle deg – både som leder og fagperson  Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og tar initiativ  Du trives med ansvar og skaper resultater gjennom samarbeid  Du har et godt nettverk og evner å skape sterke kunderelasjoner  Du er en god kommunikator både på norsk muntlig og skriftlig      Vi tilbyr     En nøkkelrolle i et solid selskap med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer  Gode utviklingsmuligheter – både faglig og karrieremessig  Konkurransedyktige betingelser, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger  Et sosialt og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og godt humør      Interessert? Du lernst nicht Theorie, sondern Handwerk: wie man Kunden liest, wie man Argumente baut, die überzeugen, wie man aus Recherche eine klare Empfehlung macht

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: At AppWork, we’ve built a simple, user-friendly PropTech platform that modernizes maintenance operations. Our platform brings everything into one easy-to-use platform so property managers, maintenance teams, and residents can all enjoy a smoother, more connected experience.  As a member of the AppWork team, you’ll be helping to build and deliver technology that solves real problems, makes communities run better, and creates happier teams and residents.   About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to help us ship our product to customers reliably, across three surfaces: web application portal that property managers and executives use every day, a mobile app that maintenance techs depend on in the field, and APIs that keep everything in sync.  You will build and own automated test coverage across web, mobile, and API, and work closely with engineers across AppWork's R&D squads to catch issues before they ever reach a customer. This is a senior, hands-on role: you'll plan and execute AppWork’s automation strategy.   What You'll Do     Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across our Web Portal (web), the Technician App (iOS and Android, including offline scenarios), and AppWork's backend APIs.  Partner with engineers across AppWork's R&D squads, covering maintenance operations, resident experience, and core infrastructure, to build testability into new features from day one.  Identify gaps in test coverage and prioritize automation work based on risk, usage, and customer impact rather than testing everything equally.  Investigate and reproduce bugs, document them clearly for engineering, and verify fixes before release, using automation.  Maintain and improve CI/CD test pipelines so failures are caught quickly and are easy to diagnose.  Test AppWork's integrations to confirm work orders and unit status sync correctly in both directions.  Contribute to test strategy for AppWork's growing AI features.  Champion quality across the team by advocating for testable designs, clear acceptance criteria, and a strong regression safety net as AppWork scales.     Qualifications     5+ years of experience in QA automation, with a track record of building and maintaining automated test suites from scratch.  Hands-on experience testing web applications and REST APIs.  Comfortable reading and writing code (JavaScript/TypeScript or similar) to build, debug, and maintain test automation.  Experience with modern test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines (for example Playwright, Cypress, Postman, and GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools).  A strong instinct for risk: you know which parts of a system need the deepest coverage and which can rely on lighter checks.  A clear communicator who can write bug reports and test plans that both engineers and non-technical stakeholders can follow. title: Local Tester - Qatari Nationality
description: Company Description  BlackNGreen is a global AI solutions provider focused on transforming how enterprises leverage artificial intelligence to solve complex business challenges. Since 2010, the company has grown into a team of over 350 professionals, serving 160+ clients across more than 100 countries in sectors such as Telecom, Banking, Government, Insurance, E‑commerce, and Travel. BlackNGreen has launched impactful products including Magic Voice, MobiBattle, SmartConnect AI, and Call Signature, which have redefined customer engagement for billions of users. Its latest innovation, EVA, is an end‑to‑end AI‑managed service that automates up to 83% of customer care interactions and can significantly reduce operational costs while delivering seamless, personalized support at scale. In this role, the Tester will design and execute test cases, perform functional, regression, and integration testing, and validate new features and enhancements across AI-powered products such as EVA. The Tester will log, track, and re-test defects, collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts, and help ensure that releases meet quality and performance standards. Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools, and familiarity with documenting test plans, test scenarios, and test reports.  Ability to analyze requirements and user journeys, identify edge cases, and validate end-to-end workflows in complex, enterprise-scale systems.  Exposure to automation testing tools or scripting (e.g., Selenium, REST API testing, or equivalent) is an advantage.  Understanding of telecom, banking, insurance, or customer care domains is beneficial, especially for testing AI-driven conversational solutions.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.  Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and provide clear, actionable feedback.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Tiiminvetäjä - Clas Ohlson Vantaa, Tammisto

Tulet osaksi lämminhenkistä ja avointa työyhteisöä, jossa vaalimme yrityskulttuurimme perustaa, Clas Ohlson henkeä. Me Clas Ohlsonilla arvostamme työtekijöitämme juuri sellaisina kuin he ovat. title: Quality Manager
description: Job Type  Full-time   Description    Come build quality on purpose.    Balanced Body  builds Pilates equipment the way a master craftsman builds anything — nothing leaves the shop until it's right. Every reformer, tower, and accessory that leaves our Sacramento facility carries a promise to studios and instructors around the world — and we're looking for the person who makes sure that promise never breaks.  Who We Are  Balanced Body has been the world's leading manufacturer of premium Pilates equipment since 1976. We're headquartered right here in Sacramento, California, and we build more than equipment — we build the tools that help people move better, feel better, and enjoy their lives more. That mission starts on our production floor, and it depends on the quality of everything we ship.  What You'll Do  This is a newly consolidated role — and a rare chance to build something from the ground up. Today, quality lives in pieces: incoming inspection here, in-process checks there, supplier quality somewhere else. We're bringing it all under one leader. As our Quality Manager, you'll be the single owner of quality across the entire flow, from the supplier's dock to the customer's door, turning quality decisions from one-off fire drills into a disciplined, criteria-driven system.  You'll be the voice of the customer inside our factory. Your standard isn't "does it match the drawing" — it's "would the customer be proud to own this."  Especially in year one, this is hands-on work. You'll be on the floor inspecting parts, writing the standards yourself, and working supplier floors directly — not just directing a team to do it. This is a player-coach role, not a seat where you lead exclusively through managers.  What You'll Own    Customer-facing quality: complaints, field failures, and warranty claims route through you — 8D reports, corrective actions, and closing the loop from field data back to the factory floor.  Standards and decisions: author the written acceptance criteria for every part family, chair the Material Review Board, and give inspectors and technicians a clear, consistent rulebook to work from.  The QMS: drive QT9 as a living system — CAPA pipeline, non-conforming product trends, audit readiness — and build the dashboard leadership actually looks at: cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, rework by supplier.  Supplier quality: one end-to-end process from supplier quality agreements through first article and incoming inspection, with structured improvement programs for your highest-impact suppliers. Most of our roughly 1,200 suppliers are small, local shops with little or no formal quality system — you'll spend real time on their floors helping them build the processes and controls they don't have yet, not just auditing against ones they already do.  Cross-functional leadership: a weekly quality/supply cadence with Supply Chain, and a team of inspectors, technicians, and supplier quality engineers who look to you for standar
